recipe.name: 100-Calorie Iced Protein Coffee
recipe.description: A five-minute iced coffee with 100 calories and 20g protein per glass. Blend the whey into a small coffee concentrate first for a smooth drink without visible clumps.
recipeIngredient: 1 tbsp instant coffee (2 glass batch — 1/2 tbsp per glass)
1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — 2 glass batch, 1/2 serving per glass)
4 tsp monk fruit / erythritol sweetener (2 glass batch — 2 tsp per glass)
4-6 tbsp cold or room-temperature water (start with 4 tbsp, add up to 2 more if the concentrate needs help moving)
1 cup fat-free ultra-filtered milk (2 glass batch — 1/2 cup per glass)

recipeInstructions.name: Add Coffee
recipeInstructions.text: 1 tbsp instant coffee (or 1/2 tbsp per glass) into a tall blending cup.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Whey
recipeInstructions.text: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate. Series-standard whey — any clean-tasting unflavored isolate.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Sweetener
recipeInstructions.text: 4 tsp monk fruit / erythritol sweetener. Sweet enough to drink without adjusting; not sweet enough to read as dessert.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Water
recipeInstructions.text: Start with 4 tbsp cold or room-temp water. Reserve 2 more tbsp — add only if the concentrate needs help moving. Too much water weakens the finished coffee.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Smooth
recipeInstructions.text: Submerge the immersion-blender head BEFORE turning it on (splatter control). Blend until smooth, lightly foamy, zero visible clumps. This is the technique differentiator — whey dissolves into the concentrate now, so the finished drink doesn't taste chalky.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Ice
recipeInstructions.text: Fill each glass with ice to the level you want.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Milk
recipeInstructions.text: Pour 1/2 cup fat-free ultra-filtered milk over the ice in each glass.

recipeInstructions.name: Stir + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Stir thoroughly to combine the concentrate with the ice + milk. Serve immediately.

recipe.name: 30/30 Muffin Mug Bowl
recipe.description: Two protein products, two 30-second microwave bursts, one warm mug. Adults only.
recipeIngredient: 1 Bootylicious High Protein Muffin (any flavor — S'mores, Cinnamon Bun, Double Chocolate, Birthday Cake, Blueberry, Chocolate Peanut Butter, etc.)
1/4 cup (~60 mL) Fairlife Fat-Free Ultra-Filtered Milk (cold)
1/2 of a Prime Bites Protein Brownie (any flavor — S'mores, Cookie Dough, Chocolate Glazed Donut, etc.)

recipeInstructions.name: Prep The Muffin
recipeInstructions.text: Open the Bootylicious cup. Loosen the muffin from the sides with a spoon — you want the milk to soak through, not pool at the top.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Milk
recipeInstructions.text: Pour ~1/4 cup of cold Fairlife Fat-Free Milk directly into the muffin cup. Stir lightly with a spoon — the milk should be visible soaking down into the muffin, not just sitting on top.

recipeInstructions.name: First 30 Seconds
recipeInstructions.text: Microwave 30 sec. This soaks the milk through the muffin and creates the soft cake-like texture. If you skip this and just microwave the whole stack at once, the muffin stays dense and the brownie just melts on top of a brick.

recipeInstructions.name: Add The Brownie
recipeInstructions.text: Break half of a Prime Bites brownie into 4-6 small chunks. Scatter across the top of the warm soaked muffin. Don't stir — the chunks should sit on the surface so they melt in place, creating defined pockets.

recipeInstructions.name: Second 30 Seconds
recipeInstructions.text: Microwave another 30 sec. The brownie chunks slightly melt + the marshmallow / filling (if any) gets gooey. Don't over-microwave — you want melt, not liquefaction.

recipeInstructions.name: Optional Stir
recipeInstructions.text: Leave layered for visible chocolate pockets (the better look) OR stir lightly for distributed chocolate (more uniform texture, less visual contrast).
EAT WARM. Spoon. Done.

recipe.name: 7-Minute Jammy Eggs & Cajun Chicken Sausage
recipe.description: Rest-day breakfast: 3 jammy 7-min eggs + 2 Cajun chicken sausages. ~370 cal / 44g protein. Filmed brunch shown is 4+3.
recipeIngredient: 3 large eggs (Happy Egg Heritage Breed blue carton used)
2 fully cooked Cajun chicken sausages (Bilinski's Organic Cajun Style Andouille used)
Creole seasoning to taste (Tony Chachere's in the footage)
Water — enough to submerge the eggs
Ice + cold water for the ice bath
BRUNCH VARIATION (shown in the video, ~520 cal / 63g protein): add 1 more egg and 1 more sausage. Same method.

recipeInstructions.name: Ice Bath First
recipeInstructions.text: Fill a bowl with ice and cold water and set it right next to the stove. Do this before the water boils so it's ready.

recipeInstructions.name: Boil
recipeInstructions.text: Bring enough water to fully submerge the eggs to a steady boil.

recipeInstructions.name: Lower + 7 Min
recipeInstructions.text: Carefully lower cold eggs into boiling water. Set a timer for exactly 7 minutes. Keep the boil steady the whole time.

recipeInstructions.name: Sausage in Parallel
recipeInstructions.text: While the eggs are on their timer, cook the chicken sausage per its package (air fryer, skillet, or oven — no universal time). It's fully cooked, so you're heating + browning.

recipeInstructions.name: Ice 5 Min
recipeInstructions.text: At exactly 7 min, transfer eggs straight to the ice bath. Leave 5 minutes — this stops the cook and loosens the shell.

recipeInstructions.name: Peel
recipeInstructions.text: Gently peel the eggs. Runny center, so handle carefully.

recipeInstructions.name: Halve + Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Halve each egg lengthwise with a sharp knife. Plate with the hot sausage.

recipeInstructions.name: Season + Eat
recipeInstructions.text: Finish with Creole seasoning to taste. Serve immediately while the yolks are still warm.

recipe.name: Beach Bum Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 2, Flavor 2 — blue protein Creami with graham cracker Respun through the pint, honey drizzle, and a Teddy Graham standing inside a peach ring like a beach bum on a float. ~340 cal / 42g protein whole pint.
recipeIngredient: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
A few drops blue food coloring
1 graham cracker (~65 cal, roughly 1 full sheet Honey Maid or equivalent)
1 Teddy Graham (the beach bum on the float)

recipeInstructions.name: Pour Milk
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk to a Creami pint (or blending vessel).

recipeInstructions.name: Add Sweetener
recipeInstructions.text: 2 tbsp monk fruit / erythritol sweetener. Series-standard sweetener.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Whey Isolate
recipeInstructions.text: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate. Aim for ~28g protein — brands vary, read the scoop.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Guar Gum
recipeInstructions.text: 1/8 tsp guar gum, LEVEL measure. Heaped = gummy texture. The single measurement in the base you have to get right.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Salt
recipeInstructions.text: 1 pinch salt. Series-standard base ingredients now all in the vessel.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Blue Food Color
recipeInstructions.text: A few drops of blue food coloring, added BEFORE the blend so it distributes evenly through the base pre-freeze. Start with 3-4 drops — you can always add more, harder to walk back neon blue.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Smooth
recipeInstructions.text: Immersion blender until completely smooth and evenly blue. Zero lumps, zero visible whey, uniform color.

FREEZE (24 HR) + REST 5 MIN + FIRST SPIN: Freeze the pint upright and level for a full 24 hours. Rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes — NO hot-water bath. Process on Regular Ice Cream, NOT Lite. The first spin may look powdery; that's expected because the Respin (with graham) finishes the texture.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Graham Cracker
recipeInstructions.text: Break one full graham cracker sheet into small pieces over the first-spin pint. Poke pieces into the surface — Respin distributes them through the whole pint.

recipeInstructions.name: Respin
recipeInstructions.text: Run one Respin cycle. This is the technique differentiator vs W2F1 (Pineapple Whip had no mix-in). Respin distributes the graham crumb throughout the pint AND finishes the powdery texture from the first spin.

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the finished pint into a bowl. Blue Creami with visible graham crumb pulled through.

recipeInstructions.name: Honey Drizzle
recipeInstructions.text: Drizzle 1 tsp honey over the scoops. Threads through the blue and picks up the floral note that connects to the peach-gummy garnish.

recipeInstructions.name: Peach Ring Float
recipeInstructions.text: Place one peach gummy ring on top of the scoops. This is the inner-tube shape for the Teddy.

recipeInstructions.name: Teddy Graham Garnish
recipeInstructions.text: Stand one Teddy Graham upright inside the peach ring — beach bum on the float. Serve immediately, before the Teddy softens.

recipe.name: Berry Limeade Cookie ft. NERDS Gummy Clusters Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 4, Flavor 2 — naturally purple mixed-berry + lime-Jell-O protein Creami pint, Rainbow NERDS Gummy Clusters Respin, and more candy on top. ~350 cal / 44g protein whole pint. No food coloring — color comes from the berries.
recipeIngredient: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
1/2 cup frozen mixed berries (Good & Gather Mixed Berry Blend filmed — any unsweetened frozen mixed berries work)
1 tsp regular lime Jell-O powder (NOT sugar-free — the recipe leverages regular Jell-O gelatin behavior with the guar gum)
1/3 labeled serving Rainbow NERDS Gummy Clusters, chopped small
1/3 labeled serving Rainbow NERDS Gummy Clusters, chopped small (the second 1/3 for the topping)

recipeInstructions.name: Pour Milk
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk to a blender.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Sweetener
recipeInstructions.text: 2 tbsp monk fruit / erythritol sweetener.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Whey Isolate
recipeInstructions.text: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Guar Gum
recipeInstructions.text: 1/8 tsp guar gum, LEVEL measure. Heaped = gummy.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Salt
recipeInstructions.text: 1 pinch salt.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Berries
recipeInstructions.text: 1/2 cup frozen mixed berries. Series-first — no prior CCC episode used whole frozen berries in the base. The purple color comes entirely from the berries; NO food coloring is used.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Lime Jell-o
recipeInstructions.text: 1 tsp REGULAR lime Jell-O powder (NOT sugar-free). Series-first — no prior CCC episode used gelatin dessert powder in the base. Regular Jell-O's gelatin behavior collaborates with the guar gum on texture; sub sugar-free and the texture math shifts.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Smooth
recipeInstructions.text: Blend until completely smooth and evenly purple. Zero visible berry chunks, uniform color from the berries.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour + Freeze (24 Hr)
recipeInstructions.text: Transfer to a Creami pint. Freeze upright and level for a full 24 hours. Do not exceed the max-fill line.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest 5 Min + First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Pull the pint from the freezer, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes — NO hot-water bath. Process on Regular Ice Cream, NOT Lite. The first spin may look grainy; expected because the Respin (with NERDS pieces) finishes the texture.

recipeInstructions.name: Chop Nerds
recipeInstructions.text: Chop 2/3 labeled serving of Rainbow NERDS Gummy Clusters into small pieces — half becomes the Respin mix-in, half becomes the post-scoop topping. Series-first: this is the first CCC ep to use CANDY (not a protein brownie or bar) as the Respin mix-in.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Mix-in + Respin
recipeInstructions.text: Poke 1/3 labeled serving of chopped NERDS (half of what you chopped) into the surface of the first-spin pint. Run one Respin cycle WITHOUT adding liquid. Respin distributes the candy pieces AND finishes the grainy texture from the first spin.

recipeInstructions.name: Respin Result
recipeInstructions.text: The finished Respin should show visible candy pieces distributed through the purple pint with a smooth, non-grainy Creami texture. If the texture still reads powdery, run a second Respin.

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the finished pint into a bowl. Naturally purple Creami with visible candy pieces pulled through.

recipeInstructions.name: Nerds Topping + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Scatter the remaining 1/3 labeled serving of chopped NERDS over the top. Serve immediately — candy stays crunchy against the creamy Creami, and the Jell-O-set texture holds a scoop. Whole pint = 1 serving at ~350 cal / 44g protein.

recipe.name: Birthday Cake Cookie ft. OREO Creami
recipe.description: Dark cocoa protein Creami with Oreo Thins and rainbow sprinkles. About 400 calories per finished pint and 40g protein from the base.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Combine 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk, 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener, 1 serving unflavored whey isolate, 1/8 tsp guar gum (level measure), Pinch of salt with 1 tbsp black cocoa, 2 Oreo Thins. Blend until smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Rest five minutes. Run Regular Ice Cream. If powdery, run a no-water Respin.

recipeInstructions.name: no Machine Mix-in
recipeInstructions.text: Keep the remaining Oreo Thins for the topping.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Top the spun pint with two more Oreo Thins and 1/2 tsp rainbow sprinkles. Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Biscoff Cookie Butter Protein Creami
recipe.description: Cookie-butter ice cream, biscuit crunch and a topping that firms up against the cold pint. About 300 calories and 28g protein, including both biscuits and topping.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate · 60 cal / 14g protein
Natural brown food coloring, as desired

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Blend milk, whey, syrup, emulsion, optional brown coloring, guar gum and salt. Keep below the compatible pint fill line.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze + Rest
recipeInstructions.text: Freeze upright and level for 24 hours. Rest five minutes; follow your machine manual.

recipeInstructions.name: Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Run Regular Ice Cream, then Respin without added liquid until creamy.

recipeInstructions.name: Biscuit
recipeInstructions.text: Add one Biscoff biscuit and Respin using the creator’s filmed method. Follow the instructions for your model.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop and top with half a tablespoon melted cookie butter and the remaining biscuit. The topping firms up against the cold ice cream.

recipe.name: Biscoff Skillet Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 1, Flavor 3 — cookie-butter protein Creami with 1 tsp Biscoff spread + LorAnn Cookie Butter emulsion + vanilla in the base, one Biscoff cookie through Mix-In, sugar-free cookie-butter syrup + LorAnn drizzle, and a second Biscoff cookie crushed on top. 340 cal / 42g protein whole pint.
recipeIngredient: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
1 tsp LorAnn Cookie Butter Bakery Emulsion
1 tsp Biscoff Creamy Cookie Butter spread
1 tsp LorAnn Cookie Butter Bakery Emulsion

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Base
recipeInstructions.text: Combine Fairlife 2% milk + monk fruit + whey isolate + guar gum + salt in the Creami pint or a blending vessel. Immersion blender until completely smooth. Zero lumps.

recipeInstructions.name: Flavor The Base
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 tsp LorAnn Cookie Butter Emulsion + 1 tsp vanilla + 1 tsp Biscoff spread. Blend again until fully incorporated — the spread should disappear into the base, no visible clumps.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze (24 Hr)
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint without exceeding the max-fill line. Freeze upright on a level surface for a full 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest + Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Pull pint from freezer, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes. Process on Regular Ice Cream, NOT Lite. If it comes out powdery, run one Respin BEFORE the cookie mix-in (not after).

recipeInstructions.name: Add Cookie + Mix-in
recipeInstructions.text: Make a narrow center well in the spun ice cream. Crumble ONE Biscoff cookie into the well. Run MIX-IN (not Respin — different machine cycle than W1F2).

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the finished Creami into a bowl.

recipeInstructions.name: Drizzle
recipeInstructions.text: Stir 1 pump sugar-free cookie-butter syrup + 1 tsp LorAnn Cookie Butter Emulsion together in a small bowl (this is the SECOND 1 tsp of emulsion — 2 tsp total per pint). Drizzle over the scoops. If the drizzle tastes too concentrated, add more syrup to balance.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish With Cookie Crumble
recipeInstructions.text: Crush the SECOND Biscoff cookie over the top after the drizzle. Serve immediately — the crumble softens fast in ice cream.

recipe.name: Bone Broth Rice
recipe.description: Swap water for bone broth: 8 meal-prep servings, about 9g protein each, with no extra cook time.
recipeIngredient: 2 cups long-grain white rice (basmati or jasmine — basmati separates better for fried rice)
4 cups chicken bone broth (protein and sodium vary by brand)

recipeInstructions.name: Rinse
recipeInstructions.text: Rinse 2 cups rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. Two minutes. This removes excess starch and is the single biggest factor between 'separate grains' and 'sticky mush.'

recipeInstructions.name: Combine
recipeInstructions.text: Add rinsed rice + 4 cups chicken bone broth to a heavy-bottom pot or rice cooker. Taste the broth before adding any salt.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook
recipeInstructions.text: Stovetop — bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and reduce to low. 18-20 minutes, lid stays on. Rice cooker — just hit the white rice button.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest
recipeInstructions.text: 10 minutes off heat, lid on. Don't skip — this is when the steam finishes the inside of each grain.

recipeInstructions.name: Fluff + Cool
recipeInstructions.text: Fork-fluff to break up clumps. For fried rice usage, spread on a sheet pan to cool fast, then fridge overnight (cold rice fries better than warm rice).

recipeInstructions.name: Store
recipeInstructions.text: Cool promptly in shallow airtight containers within 2 hours; refrigerate. 3-4 days per USDA leftovers guidance. Reheats fine in the microwave with a splash of water.

recipe.name: Brown Sugar Cinnamon Cookie Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 8, Flavor 3 — brown-sugar monk fruit + 1/4 tsp cinnamon in the base, 120 cal of a Legendary brown-sugar-cinnamon protein pastry split between mix-in and topping. 360 cal / 54g protein whole pint. Honest verdict: decent, but too cinnamon-heavy by the end for a non-cinnamon-guy.
recipeIngredient: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
1/4 tsp ground cinnamon (in the base — pre-freeze, not on top)
60 cal chopped brown-sugar-cinnamon protein pastry (Legendary filmed) — Respin mix-in
60 cal chopped brown-sugar-cinnamon protein pastry (Legendary filmed) — post-flattening topping

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Base
recipeInstructions.text: Combine 2% ultra-filtered milk + 2 tbsp brown-sugar monk fruit + 1 serving whey isolate + 1/8 tsp guar gum + pinch of salt + 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon. Immersion blender until completely smooth. Both flavor swaps (brown-sugar monk fruit AND cinnamon) go in pre-freeze so the base carries the pastry cue from bite one.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Cinnamon in The Base
recipeInstructions.text: 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon into the blender jar. This is the recipe's cinnamon dose — nothing extra on top later.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour + Freeze (24 Hr)
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for a full 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest 5 Min + First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Pull the pint, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes — no hot-water bath. Process on Regular Ice Cream, NOT Lite.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion 120 Cal Pastry
recipeInstructions.text: Measure 120 CALORIES WORTH of the Legendary brown-sugar-cinnamon protein pastry — this is the total allocation across BOTH the mix-in AND the topping. Not 120 cal in each. The creator-supplied 360-cal figure assumes the full pastry package label; measure by weight or by inspection to hit 120 cal.

recipeInstructions.name: Divide 50/50
recipeInstructions.text: Chop the 120-cal portion and divide it evenly — 60 cal for the Respin mix-in, 60 cal for the post-flattening topping.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Mix-in Half + No-liquid Respin
recipeInstructions.text: Drop the first 60-cal half of chopped pastry onto the spun pint. Run Respin WITHOUT adding liquid. Pastry pockets stay distinct through the pint.

recipeInstructions.name: Respin Result
recipeInstructions.text: The finished Respin should show visible pastry pockets distributed through the brown-sugar-cinnamon Creami with a smooth, non-grainy texture. If the texture still reads powdery, run another Respin — still without adding liquid.

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop or Flatten Inside Pint
recipeInstructions.text: Flatten the Creami inside its pint (the finishing shot uses in-pint plating). Alternatively, scoop into a serving bowl if serving family-style.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Topping Half + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Scatter the remaining 60-cal half of chopped pastry across the flattened surface. Serve immediately — the pastry crumb is best crunchy against the cold Creami.

recipe.name: Butterfinger Peanut-Butter Protein Creami
recipe.description: Subtle PB2 peanut base with Butterfinger crunch. About 380 calories and 44g protein for the whole finished pint.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Blend the shared base with 1 tbsp PB2 powder until fully smooth. These amounts make one pint.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into one Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Rest about five minutes, then run Regular Ice Cream. If powdery, run a no-liquid Respin before mix-ins.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix-in
recipeInstructions.text: Add 10g Butterfinger baking bits to the spun pint and run Mix-In.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop and top with 10g more Butterfinger baking bits. Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Caesar Crunch Salad
recipe.description: Pre-cooked chicken + crushed protein chips + yogurt Caesar. 199 cal, 27g protein, 4 min build.
recipeIngredient: 6 oz Tanimura & Antle Artisan Sweet Gem Lettuce, chopped (or romaine hearts)
12 oz Soules Kitchen Fully Cooked Fajita Chicken Breast Strips, diced (6 oz per serving)
3 tbsp Bolthouse Farms Creamy Caesar Parmigiano dressing (1.5 portions per serving — yogurt-based, ~38 cal)
0.66 bag Quest Hot & Spicy Tortilla Style Protein Chips, crushed coarse (~21g per serving — replacing croutons)
Optional: 1-2 tsp Smoky Chipotle Crema drizzle [adult]

recipeInstructions.name: Chop Lettuce
recipeInstructions.text: 6 oz Sweet Gem (or romaine) into bite pieces. Big bowl.

recipeInstructions.name: Dice Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: 12 oz Soules Kitchen Fajita Chicken into 1/2-inch cubes. Pre-cooked, just chop and fold in cold OR microwave 30 sec if you want it warm.

recipeInstructions.name: Crush Chips
recipeInstructions.text: 0.66 of a Quest Hot & Spicy bag, coarse-crushed (zip-bag + rolling pin works in 30 sec). KEEP ASIDE — don't toss in yet.

recipeInstructions.name: Build Undressed
recipeInstructions.text: Combine lettuce + chicken in the bowl. Toss gently to distribute.

recipeInstructions.name: Dress Per Portion (not The Whole Bowl)
recipeInstructions.text: Spoon half the bowl into a serving bowl. Drizzle ~1.5 portions of Bolthouse Creamy Caesar. Toss until coated.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Top with crushed Quest chips (NOT pre-tossed — they go on TOP). Generous sprinkle Dan-O's Jalapeño Cheesoning. Optional: 1-2 tsp Smoky Chipotle Crema drizzle for adult heat.
SERVE IMMEDIATELY. Dressed salad with chips on top goes soggy in 5-10 min — don't pre-dress the bowl unless you're eating right away.

recipe.name: Caesar Crunch Wrap
recipe.description: A chopped chicken Caesar lunch rolled into one big wrap. About 475 calories and 50g protein for the whole wrap.
recipeIngredient: 2 Mission Carb Balance tortillas (140 calories total)
5 oz Real Good lightly breaded chicken breast fillet, weighed before air frying

recipeInstructions.name: Air-fry Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Weigh 5 oz of the fillet before cooking, then air-fry according to the package directions until cooked through. No added oil is included in the estimate.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Pile
recipeInstructions.text: Set out four romaine leaves. Add the cooked chicken, two Velveeta slices, and two tablespoons of homemade Caesar.

recipeInstructions.name: Chop
recipeInstructions.text: Use two knives to chop and mix the whole pile so the dressing reaches every bite.

recipeInstructions.name: Fill
recipeInstructions.text: Overlap both tortillas to make one large wrap. Move all of the chopped filling onto them.

recipeInstructions.name: Roll
recipeInstructions.text: Fold the tortillas around the filling and roll snugly.

recipeInstructions.name: Slice And Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Cut the wrap across. Both halves are one serving.

recipe.name: 160-Calorie Cajun Chicken Cheese Dog
recipe.description: Quick Lunches Ep. 1 — six minutes on Air Fry. 160 cal / 24g protein per dog. Keto bun + Bilinski's Cajun andouille + half a slice of Velveeta + mustard.
recipeIngredient: 1 Nature's Own Life Keto Soft White hot dog bun
1 Bilinski's Organic Cajun Style Andouille chicken sausage (fully cooked)

recipeInstructions.name: Cut Cheese
recipeInstructions.text: Cut or fold half a slice of Velveeta into narrow strips. Half a slice keeps the whole dog at 160 cal — resist the full slice.

recipeInstructions.name: Line Bun
recipeInstructions.text: Open the hot dog bun without tearing the hinge. Line the inside with the Velveeta strips so they sit directly under where the sausage lands.

recipeInstructions.name: Air Fry
recipeInstructions.text: Place the fully cooked chicken sausage in the air fryer and run Air Fry mode for 6 minutes, or until hot throughout. Do not invent a temperature — use your air fryer's Air Fry mode, appliance settings vary.

recipeInstructions.name: Assemble
recipeInstructions.text: Place the hot sausage directly into the cheese-lined bun. Its heat begins softening the Velveeta without a second cook step.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Add mustard to taste and serve immediately. The bun stays soft; the cheese melts under the sausage heat.

recipe.name: Cake Batter Blondie Cookie Creami
recipe.description: Brown-butter blondie protein Creami with white-chocolate-style chips and sprinkles. About 310 calories per finished pint and 40g protein from the base.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Combine 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk, 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener, 1 serving unflavored whey isolate, 1/8 tsp guar gum (level measure), Pinch of salt with 1/4 tsp brown-butter emulsion. Blend until smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Rest five minutes. Run Regular Ice Cream. If powdery, run a no-water Respin.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix-in
recipeInstructions.text: After the first spin, add 14g Lily's white-chocolate-style chips; run Mix-In.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Top the finished pint with 1/2 tsp rainbow sprinkles. Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Cannoli Cookie Creami
recipe.description: Crumbl Creami Cut Week 7 — Cannoli Cookie protein Creami with a brown-sugar base and the recipe-specific mix-ins.
recipeIngredient: 2 tbsp brown-sugar monk fruit / erythritol sweetener
1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
1/2 regular ice cream cone (blend INTO the base pre-freeze)
1/2 waffle cone (break in AFTER Regular Ice Cream cycle)

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Base
recipeInstructions.text: Combine Fairlife 2% milk + brown-sugar monk fruit + whey isolate + guar gum + salt + half a regular ice cream cone. Immersion blender until completely smooth. Brown-sugar sweetener is the Week 7 swap — matches the reference cookie's brown-sugar profile.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Regular Cone Before Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: The regular cone goes INTO the base pre-freeze so its flavor carries through every scoop. Don't sub the waffle cone here — waffle cone in the base loses its crunch.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour + Freeze (24 Hr)
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for a full 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest + Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Pull the pint, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes. Process on Regular Ice Cream cycle.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Waffle Cone After Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Break half a waffle cone into rough chunks. Make a narrow center well in the spun Creami, drop the chunks in.

recipeInstructions.name: Respin — no Liquid
recipeInstructions.text: Run Respin WITHOUT adding liquid. No-liquid Respin is what preserves the waffle-cone crunch; adding liquid softens the cone.

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the Respun Creami into a bowl.

recipeInstructions.name: Top With Chips + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Top with 1 tbsp Lily's chocolate chips. Eat immediately — waffle cone stays crunchy for about 2-3 minutes before the frozen scoop starts to soften it.

recipe.name: Twix Caramel Shortbread Protein Creami
recipe.description: A caramel and brown-butter protein Creami topped with chopped Twix. The updated whole-pint estimate is about 270 calories and 28g protein.
recipeIngredient: ½ serving unflavored whey isolate (label: 60 calories / 14g protein)
Zero-calorie caramel syrup, to top (amount not measured)
1 Twix bar (80 calories), chopped for topping

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Blend milk, half serving of whey, sweetener, guar gum, salt, caramel emulsion, and brown-butter emulsion until smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint without passing the max-fill line. Freeze upright on a level surface for 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest + Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Rest the pint on the counter for 5 minutes. Process on Regular Ice Cream. If needed, run Respin without adding liquid until creamy.

recipeInstructions.name: Drizzle
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop into a bowl and add zero-calorie caramel syrup to taste. Its amount is not measured.

recipeInstructions.name: Top + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Chop one Twix bar and add it over the top just before serving. Do not run a mix-in cycle.

recipe.name: Chili Crisp Sour Cream
recipe.description: Cool, creamy, lightly spicy. Two ingredients. Cross-links across the cookbook.
recipeIngredient: 2-3 tbsp Lee Kum Kee Chiu Chow Style Chili Crisp Oil

recipeInstructions.text: SPOON SOUR CREAM into a small bowl or ramekin.

ADD CHILI CRISP on top — 2 tbsp if you want a mild dip, 3 tbsp if you want the heat to lead. Lee Kum Kee Chiu Chow specifically because the shallot + garlic bits carry flavor; generic chili oil is too one-note.

FOLD GENTLY 3-4 TIMES with a spoon. STOP when you can still see orange chili oil streaks running through the white sour cream. Don't stir — fold. Homogenized = beige = looks like ranch. Streaked = chili crisp sour cream.
SERVE IMMEDIATELY or refrigerate up to 5 days. The streaks blur slightly after a few hours but the flavor holds.

recipe.name: Chipotle Ham Crunch Sandwich
recipe.description: Regular BBQ chips stay in the sandwich for crunch. About 285 calories and 24g protein per sandwich.
recipeIngredient: 2 slices Sola Sweet & Buttery Keto Bread (52g)
½ tbsp plain whipped cream cheese (5.5g)
11.46g creator chipotle crema / Liquid Chipotle Sauce (¼ serving in the creator's nested recipe)
½ oz regular Bettergoods Carolina Gold Style BBQ potato chips (14.17g)

recipeInstructions.name: Spread
recipeInstructions.text: Put plain whipped cream cheese on one slice of bread and chipotle crema on the other.

recipeInstructions.name: Layer
recipeInstructions.text: Add the 56g ham and one Velveeta slice, then top with shredded lettuce and ½ oz regular BBQ chips.

recipeInstructions.name: Close + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Close the sandwich, gently press, slice and eat fresh so the chips stay crunchy. The listed amounts make one sandwich; footage shows two being assembled.

recipe.name: Chipotle Queso Tacos
recipe.description: Three chipotle chicken and queso street tacos for one lunch. About 389 calories and 49g protein for the three-taco base, before optional toppings.
recipeIngredient: 3 La Banderita flour street-taco tortillas (66 g total)
6 oz (170 g) fully cooked Kirkland chargrilled chipotle chicken
1/2 serving (about 32 g) Split Plate high-protein queso

recipeInstructions.name: Mix Queso
recipeInstructions.text: Stir the Velveeta shreds into half a serving of high-protein queso until creamy.

recipeInstructions.name: Fill Tacos
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the queso-cheese mixture among three tortillas. Add the fully cooked chipotle chicken, dividing all 6 oz across the three.

recipeInstructions.name: Heat
recipeInstructions.text: Finish the assembled tacos in a 375°F oven for 10 minutes, as filmed. Alternatively, microwave or air-fry until hot; timing varies by appliance.

recipeInstructions.name: Serve Three Ways
recipeInstructions.text: Leave one plain, or top with pickled onion or Calabrian chili. The filmed trio shows one of each; combining onion and chili is a future idea, not a fourth filmed taco.

recipe.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake Creami
recipe.description: Cookie-cake protein Creami with chocolate chips and quick cocoa-maple fudge. About 340 calories per finished pint and 40g protein from the base.
recipeIngredient: 50 calories' worth of Hormbles Chormbles milk chocolate
1 tbsp Maple Grove Farms sugar-free maple syrup

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Combine 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk, 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener, 1 serving unflavored whey isolate, 1/8 tsp guar gum (level measure), Pinch of salt with 1/4 tsp butter extract, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 drop natural brown food coloring. Blend until smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Rest five minutes. Run Regular Ice Cream. If powdery, run a no-water Respin.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix-in
recipeInstructions.text: After the first spin, add 7g Lily's milk-chocolate chips and 50 calories' worth of Hormbles Chormbles milk chocolate; run Mix-In.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk the syrup and cocoa until smooth, then drizzle the fudge over the finished pint. Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Chocolate Cupcake Protein Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 10 Flavor 2 — Dutch-cocoa protein Creami with Little Bites fudge brownie pieces, marshmallow creme, and a zero-sugar chocolate syrup drizzle. About 395 calories and 42g protein for the complete pint.
recipeIngredient: 1 batch usual protein Creami base (240 cal / 40g protein)
1 tbsp Dutch-process cocoa powder (blend into base before freezing)
2 Entenmann's Little Bites Fudge Brownies (half the four-piece pouch)
1 tbsp Hershey's Zero Sugar Chocolate Syrup (drizzle; working estimate)

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Base
recipeInstructions.text: Blend 1 tablespoon Dutch cocoa into your usual protein Creami base until completely smooth with no cocoa clumps.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint without exceeding the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level overnight.

recipeInstructions.name: First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Rest the pint 5 minutes, then process on Regular Ice Cream. If it stays powdery, run one no-liquid Respin before the mix-in.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix-in The Brownies
recipeInstructions.text: Cut a center well, press in two Little Bites fudge brownies, and run Mix-In.

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop + Marshmallow
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the Creami into a bowl and top with 1 tablespoon Jet-Puffed marshmallow creme.

recipeInstructions.name: Drizzle + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Finish with a 1 tablespoon drizzle of Hershey's Zero Sugar Chocolate Syrup. Eat immediately for the intended texture.

recipe.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookie Protein Creami
recipe.description: A chocolate protein Creami with a HighKey cookie and Reese's Thin mixed through, finished with a peanut-butter drizzle. About 320 calories and 33g protein for the whole pint.
recipeIngredient: ½ serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (label: 60 calories / 14g protein)

recipeInstructions.name: Blend The Base
recipeInstructions.text: Blend the milk, half serving of whey, sweetener, guar gum, salt, and black cocoa until smooth. Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze Level
recipeInstructions.text: Freeze the filled pint upright and level for 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Process using the ice-cream cycle and instructions for your specific Creami. Respin as needed until creamy.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix in The Cookies
recipeInstructions.text: Break one HighKey sandwich cookie and one Reese's Thin into pieces. Add them to the spun base and run Mix-In.

recipeInstructions.name: Make The Drizzle
recipeInstructions.text: Stir the PBfit, water, and sugar-free maple syrup together until pourable. Drizzle over the finished Creami and serve the whole pint.

recipe.name: Chocolate Protein Brownie Bowl
recipe.description: Pumpkin for texture. Chocolate is the flavor.
recipeIngredient: 40g Lily's Milk Chocolate Style Baking Chips (10g per serving)

recipeInstructions.name: Mix Dry
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk PEScience protein, cookie butter powder, black cocoa, flour, monk sweetener, baking powder, and salt. Break up all cocoa clumps.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix Wet
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk pumpkin puree, Fairlife milk, and eggs until smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Build One Serving
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1/4 dry mix + 1/4 wet mix to a microwave-safe bowl. Stir until smooth. Fold in 10g Lily's chips.

recipeInstructions.name: Microwave
recipeInstructions.text: ~1 minute. Start checking at 50 seconds. Stop when top is just set but still soft — it keeps cooking.

recipeInstructions.name: Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Top with Ninja Creami protein pint scoop. Eat immediately.

recipe.name: Cinnamon Roll Cookie Creami
recipe.description: Vanilla-cinnamon protein ice cream, cereal crunch and a butter drizzle. About 310 calories and 28g protein for the whole finished pint.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 serving Unflavored whey isolate · 60 cal / 14g protein

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Blend milk, whey, sweetener, guar gum, salt, vanilla and 1/2 tsp cinnamon until smooth. Pour into the pint below its fill line.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze + Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Freeze flat and process following the instructions for your exact Creami machine and pint. Use its appropriate ice cream program and follow its guidance if a respin is needed.

recipeInstructions.name: Cereal Mix-in
recipeInstructions.text: Add 14g Cinnamon Toast Crunch and use the Mix-In function.

recipeInstructions.name: Butter Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Melt 1/2 tbsp butter. Stir in 1/2 tbsp sugar-free maple syrup and 1/4 tsp cinnamon. Drizzle the entire prepared mixture over the ice cream and eat cold.

recipe.name: Confetti Dunker Cookie Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 8, Flavor 2 — vanilla protein Creami base, 2 tsp rainbow sprinkles + 1/4 single-serve pound cake through a no-liquid Respin, and another 1/4 pound cake crumbled over the top. 350 cal / 42g protein whole pint. Honest verdict: sprinkles were confusing, soft pound cake absolutely worked.
recipeIngredient: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
1/4 single-serve pound cake (~40 cal — half of the 80-cal pound-cake allocation)
1/4 single-serve pound cake (~40 cal — the other half)

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Base
recipeInstructions.text: Combine 2% ultra-filtered milk + monk fruit sweetener + whey isolate + guar gum + pinch of salt. Immersion blender until completely smooth. NO extract or emulsion this week — series-standard 4-line base only; identity is carried by the mix-in and topping.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour + Freeze (24 Hr)
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for a full 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest 5 Min + First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Pull the pint, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes — no hot-water bath. Process on Regular Ice Cream, NOT Lite. Expect a smooth vanilla-adjacent base; the Respin (with sprinkles + cake) finishes the identity.

recipeInstructions.name: Measure 2 Tsp Sprinkles
recipeInstructions.text: 2 teaspoons of rainbow sprinkles measured out. This is the recipe's ONLY sprinkle dose — nothing extra goes on the topping.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Sprinkles to Spun Pint
recipeInstructions.text: Drop the 2 tsp rainbow sprinkles onto the spun pint. Series-first: this is the first CCC episode to use plain rainbow sprinkles as a Respin mix-in.

recipeInstructions.name: Divide 1 Single-serve Pound Cake
recipeInstructions.text: A single-serve pound cake is ~160 cal. Divide it into QUARTERS — one 1/4 (40 cal) goes into the Respin mix-in, another 1/4 (40 cal) becomes the post-Respin topping. The other HALF stays in the package (not used in this pint).

recipeInstructions.name: Add 1/4 Pound Cake + No-liquid Respin
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1/4 of the pound cake (40 cal) alongside the sprinkles on the spun pint. Run Respin WITHOUT adding liquid. Pound-cake pockets stay soft AND distinct; sprinkle-confetti distributes through the pint.

recipeInstructions.name: Respin Result
recipeInstructions.text: The finished Respin should show visible rainbow-sprinkle confetti + soft pound-cake pockets distributed through the Creami with a smooth, non-grainy texture. If the texture still reads powdery, run another Respin — still without adding liquid.

recipeInstructions.name: Keep in Pint + Crumble Topping
recipeInstructions.text: Keep the Creami inside the pint (this is a plate-in-pint serve, not a bowl scoop). Crumble the second 1/4 of pound cake (40 cal, the other half of the 80-cal total allocation) over the top. Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Cookie Butter Iced Proffee
recipe.description: Proffee Episode 2 — Ep 1's concentrate-first technique now carries cookie butter and Biscoff. 210 cal / 22g protein per glass (1:9.5 protein-to-cal), 5-minute build. Whey blends into a hot coffee concentrate with a crushed Biscoff cookie, then ice + fat-free ultra-filtered milk + cookie-butter rim + whipped topping + a second Biscoff crumble finish.
recipeIngredient: 1 Biscoff cookie, crushed (goes INTO the concentrate — 1 more for the top later)
1/2 serving unflavored whey isolate (~14g protein — adjust by brand)
2-3 tbsp hot water (hot but NOT boiling — start with 2 tbsp, add the third only if needed)
1 tsp cookie butter spread (for the rim — see step 5 for cleanest application)
1 Biscoff cookie, crushed (garnish over the whipped topping)

recipeInstructions.name: Crush First Biscoff
recipeInstructions.text: Crush 1 Biscoff cookie into the bottom of a tall blending cup. This cookie goes INSIDE the concentrate for spice depth throughout the drink; the second cookie stays whole for the garnish at the end.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Coffee + Whey + Sweetener
recipeInstructions.text: 1/2 tbsp instant coffee, 1/2 serving unflavored whey isolate, and 2 tsp monk fruit sweetener into the blending cup with the crushed Biscoff.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Hot Water
recipeInstructions.text: 2 tbsp hot (NOT boiling) water. Start with 2 tbsp; add the third only if the concentrate needs help moving. Hot water pulls flavor from the crushed Biscoff and dissolves the coffee faster than cold; not-quite-boiling protects the whey from denaturing.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Smooth
recipeInstructions.text: Submerge the immersion-blender head BEFORE turning it on (splatter control). Blend until the concentrate is smooth with zero visible protein clumps or Biscoff chunks. This is the Proffee-series technique differentiator — whey dissolves into the hot concentrate NOW, not into cold milk later.

recipeInstructions.name: Rim The Serving Glass (recommended)
recipeInstructions.text: Spread 1 tsp cookie butter around the rim of the SERVING glass while it's still empty — much cleaner than rimming a full drink. The filmed video builds the entire drink in one cup, which works but is harder to keep tidy. If following the video's one-cup method, rim carefully with the drink already in place.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Ice + Milk
recipeInstructions.text: Fill the rimmed serving glass with ice. Pour the concentrate over the ice, then add 1/2 cup Fairlife fat-free ultra-filtered milk. Fat-free is the macro-honesty pick — 2% pushes calories without adding protein.

recipeInstructions.name: Top With Whipped Topping
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 tbsp sugar-free whipped topping in a swirl over the drink.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Crush the second Biscoff cookie over the whipped topping. Serve immediately — the whipped topping softens against the cold drink after 1-2 minutes.

recipe.name: Cookie & Cream White Drop Marbled Protein Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 11 Flavor 2 — one protein Creami base split into a cocoa half and a vanilla half, spun separately, then folded together for a chocolate-and-vanilla marble with Oreo Thins and Lily's white chips through Mix-In and a melted white-chip drizzle. About 400 calories and 42g protein for the full combined batch.
recipeIngredient: 1 batch usual protein Creami base (240 cal / 40g protein), split evenly between two half-pints
1 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder (into the chocolate half before freezing)
1 tsp vanilla extract (into the vanilla half before freezing)

recipeInstructions.name: Split The Base
recipeInstructions.text: Split one usual protein Creami base evenly between two half-pint containers.

recipeInstructions.name: Flavor + Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: Blend 1 tablespoon cocoa into one half and 1 teaspoon vanilla into the other. Freeze both level overnight.

recipeInstructions.name: Spin Separately
recipeInstructions.text: Rest both containers 5 minutes, then process each half-pint on its own on Regular Ice Cream. If either stays powdery, run one no-liquid Respin before combining.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine + Marble
recipeInstructions.text: Combine the two first-spun halves and fold briefly for a loose chocolate-and-vanilla marble — a few folds only, or the two colors blend into one.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix-in
recipeInstructions.text: Add 5g Lily's white chips and 2 Oreo Thins to the combined pint and run Mix-In.

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop + Drizzle
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the combined pint into a bowl and drizzle 10g melted Lily's white chips for the white-drop finish. Eat immediately for the intended texture.

recipe.name: Cookies & Cream Cookie Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 8, Flavor 1 — vanilla protein Creami base, 3 low-cal chocolate sandwich cookies mixed in after the first spin, 10g Oreo dust on top. 350 cal / 42g protein whole pint. Deliberately classic — the point is it tastes exactly like cookies-and-cream should.
recipeIngredient: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
3 low-cal chocolate sandwich cookies (HighKey Original filmed, ~70 cal each)

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Base
recipeInstructions.text: Combine 2% ultra-filtered milk + monk fruit sweetener + whey isolate + guar gum + salt + 1 tsp vanilla extract. Immersion blender until completely smooth. Vanilla extract is the base's whole flavor carrier this week — no cocoa, no berries, no emulsions.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour + Freeze (24 Hr)
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for a full 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest 5 Min + First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Pull the pint, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes — no hot-water bath. Process on Regular Ice Cream, NOT Lite. The first spin should read as smooth vanilla; if it looks grainy, the Respin (with cookies) finishes the texture.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion 3 Cookies
recipeInstructions.text: Set aside 3 low-cal chocolate sandwich cookies (HighKey Original filmed, ~70 cal each). Whole cookies — don't crush ahead. The Respin does the breaking.

recipeInstructions.name: Add 3 Cookies + No-liquid Respin
recipeInstructions.text: Drop all 3 sandwich cookies onto the spun pint. Run Respin WITHOUT adding liquid. The Respin breaks the cookies into pieces AND distributes them through the pint. NO liquid before Respin — this is the whole reason the cookies stay as chunks rather than dissolving.

recipeInstructions.name: Respin Result
recipeInstructions.text: The finished Respin should show visible cookie pieces distributed through the vanilla pint with a smooth, non-grainy Creami texture. If the texture still reads powdery, run one more Respin — still without adding liquid.

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the finished pint into a bowl. Vanilla Creami with visible sandwich-cookie chunks pulled through.

recipeInstructions.name: Oreo Dust + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Finish with 10 grams of Oreo crumbs / dust over the top. 10 g is the exact figure included in the 350-cal total — measure, don't eyeball. Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Cookies & Cream Iced Proffee
recipe.description: Proffee Episode 6 — one HighKey sandwich cookie does double duty as the chocolate-syrup rim AND the crumb topping, with black cocoa carrying the dark-cookie flavor from inside the concentrate. 140 cal / 22g protein per glass, 5-minute build.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp sugar-free chocolate syrup (rim tack only — spread on a small plate, not into the glass)
1 HighKey Original sandwich cookie, broken up — part goes into the rim, part is reserved as the topping (almond-flour based; verify the current package for tree-nut allergen)
1 tbsp instant coffee (creator's strong-coffee dose; use 1/2 tbsp for a milder drink)
1 tsp black cocoa powder (the dark sandwich-cookie flavor — regular Dutch cocoa reads milder and browner)
1/2 serving unflavored whey isolate (~14g protein — adjust by brand)
2-3 tbsp hot water (hot but NOT boiling — start with 2 tbsp, add the third only if needed)
Reserved cookie crumbs from the cookie above (no second cookie needed)

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Cookie Rim
recipeInstructions.text: Spread 1 tsp sugar-free chocolate syrup on a small plate. Break the sandwich cookie into the syrup and RESERVE a spoonful of loose crumbs for the topping before you rim — once the crumbs are in the syrup they're too wet to sit on top of the drink. Press and rotate the glass rim through the remaining crumbs.

BUILD THE CONCENTRATE (into the rimmed glass): 1 tbsp instant coffee + 1 tsp black cocoa + 1/2 serving unflavored whey isolate + 2 tsp monk fruit sweetener. Blend the whey into the concentrate FIRST — this is the Proffee-series spine that prevents clumps.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Hot Water + Froth
recipeInstructions.text: 2 tbsp hot (not boiling) water. Submerge the frother head BEFORE turning it on for splatter control. Froth until the concentrate is completely smooth — black cocoa clumps harder than plain coffee, so give it a few extra seconds. Add the third tbsp only if it needs help moving.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Fill the glass with ice, pour in 1/2 cup Fairlife fat-free ultra-filtered milk, spoon the reserved cookie crumbs over the top, stir once, and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Cosmic Brownie Protein Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 10 Flavor 1 — black-cocoa protein Creami with Cookie Monster brownie pieces, a two-ingredient sugar-free maple fudge, and rainbow sprinkles. About 370 calories and 49g protein for the complete pint.
recipeIngredient: 1 batch usual protein Creami base (240 cal / 40g protein)
1 tbsp black cocoa powder (blend into base before freezing)
1/3 Prime Bites Cookie Monster protein brownie
1 1/2 tbsp Maple Grove Farms Sugar Free syrup

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Base
recipeInstructions.text: Blend 1 tablespoon black cocoa into your usual protein Creami base until completely smooth with no cocoa clumps.

recipeInstructions.name: Freeze
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint without exceeding the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level overnight.

recipeInstructions.name: First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Rest the pint 5 minutes, then process on Regular Ice Cream. If it stays powdery, run one no-liquid Respin before the mix-in.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix-in The Brownie
recipeInstructions.text: Cut a center well, press in one-third of the Cookie Monster brownie, and run Mix-In.

recipeInstructions.name: Make The Fudge
recipeInstructions.text: Stir 1.5 tablespoons Maple Grove Farms sugar-free syrup into 1.5 tablespoons Dutch-process cocoa until smooth and glossy.

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop + Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the Creami into a bowl, drizzle the fudge, and finish with about 1 teaspoon rainbow sprinkles. Eat immediately for the intended texture.

recipe.name: Creamy Cowboy Butter
recipe.description: Thick like softened compound butter. Cottage cheese, real butter and Parmesan; about 50 cal and 4g protein per 2 tbsp, estimated.
recipeIngredient: 2 tbsp whole ultra-filtered milk (Nurri used), plus a little more only as needed
½ oz (about 14 g) Parmesan, finely grated
½ tsp Dijon OR whole-grain mustard (½ tsp total)
½ tsp SPG (salt, pepper and garlic seasoning blend)

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Base
recipeInstructions.text: Add 100g cottage cheese, 1 tbsp softened butter, 2 tbsp whole ultra-filtered milk and ½ oz finely grated Parmesan to a small blender or food processor.

recipeInstructions.name: Add The Seasonings
recipeInstructions.text: Add ½ tsp each garlic powder, Dijon OR whole-grain mustard, Worcestershire, paprika, lemon juice, Italian seasoning and SPG. Add chili flakes only if you want heat.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Smooth
recipeInstructions.text: Blend, stopping to scrape the cup as needed, until the cottage-cheese curds are smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Check The Texture
recipeInstructions.text: Aim for thick and creamy, like softened compound butter. If it is too stiff to blend or spread, add milk a teaspoon at a time; stop before it becomes a thin pouring sauce.

recipeInstructions.name: Spread + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Spread over cooked steak or serve on the side. Serving size is 2 tbsp; the amount pictured on steak was not measured. Steak and sides have separate nutrition.

recipe.name: Creamy Chipotle Chicken Ditalini
recipe.description: A creamy, mild shared-pot chicken pasta for nine equal servings: about 468 calories and 41g protein per serving.
recipeIngredient: 6 cups (about 1,440g) Kirkland chicken sipping bone broth, including the blender portion
Garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to taste
Optional for adult bowls: chili flakes

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Blend the cottage cheese with a little of the measured bone broth until completely smooth and pourable. Keep this portion within the total six cups.

recipeInstructions.name: Simmer
recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large pan and season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Add dry ditalini and the remaining measured broth. Simmer and stir until the pasta is tender.

recipeInstructions.name: Heat Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Fold in diced precooked chipotle chicken and heat it through according to its package directions.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish Off Heat
recipeInstructions.text: Remove the pan from heat. Fold in the smooth cottage-cheese mixture and grated Parmesan until each piece is glossy and coated. Do not hard-boil the dairy finish.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the whole pot into nine equal servings. Keep the shared pot mild; add chili flakes only to adult bowls if desired.

recipe.name: Crème Brûlée Cookie Creami
recipe.description: Crumbl Creami Cut Week 7 — Crème Brûlée Cookie protein Creami with a brown-sugar base and the recipe-specific mix-ins.
recipeIngredient: 2 tbsp brown-sugar monk fruit / erythritol sweetener
1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
2 sugar-free hard caramels, crushed (add AFTER first spin — no-liquid Respin)
4 sugar-free hard caramels, melted + chilled thin on parchment for the glass shell
Sugar-free salted caramel syrup, light drizzle before the caramel glass lands

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Base
recipeInstructions.text: Combine 2% ultra-filtered milk + brown-sugar monk fruit + whey isolate + guar gum + salt. Immersion blender until completely smooth. Brown-sugar sweetener is the Week 7 swap — matches the reference cookie's brown-sugar profile.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour + Freeze (24 Hr)
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a Creami pint below the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level for a full 24 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest + Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Pull the pint, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes. Process on Regular Ice Cream cycle.

recipeInstructions.name: Crush 2 Caramels
recipeInstructions.text: Crush 2 of the 6 sugar-free hard caramels into rough chunks (bag + rolling pin or a mortar).

recipeInstructions.name: Add Crushed Caramels After Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Make a narrow center well in the spun Creami, drop the crushed 2 caramels in.

recipeInstructions.name: Respin — no Liquid
recipeInstructions.text: Run Respin WITHOUT adding liquid. No-liquid Respin preserves the crunchy caramel nuggets through the pint; liquid would dissolve them.

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the Respun Creami into a serving bowl.

recipeInstructions.name: Melt The Other 4 Caramels
recipeInstructions.text: Melt the remaining 4 hard caramels in a small saucepan over LOW heat. Stir gently — hard candy scorches fast.

recipeInstructions.name: Spread Thin + Chill Hard
recipeInstructions.text: Carefully pour the melted caramel into a thin sheet on parchment. Chill until completely hard — the sheet must be brittle enough to crack under a spoon, not tacky.

recipeInstructions.name: Place The Caramel Glass
recipeInstructions.text: Optional light sugar-free salted caramel syrup drizzle over the scoops. Land the chilled caramel glass on top.

recipeInstructions.name: Crack + Eat
recipeInstructions.text: Crack the glass with the back of a spoon immediately before eating. This is the payoff.

recipe.name: Crispy Chicken + Hot Honey Mustard
recipe.description: Quick Lunches Episode 9 — two ingredients, one air fryer, and lunch is handled. About 365 calories and 32g protein.
recipeIngredient: 6 oz Kirkland Signature Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Chunks
1 tbsp Trader Joe's Hot Honey Mustard

recipeInstructions.name: Measure
recipeInstructions.text: Portion 6 oz of frozen chicken chunks and arrange them in a single layer in the air-fryer basket.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook
recipeInstructions.text: Air fry according to the package directions, shaking once, until the chicken is hot and crisp.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Measure 1 tbsp hot honey mustard into a small bowl and serve it on the side. Dipping keeps the chicken crisp.

recipe.name: David Vanilla Cookies & Cream Hack
recipe.description: Half a pint of David Vanilla Bean + 3 crushed HighKey sandwich cookies = one large cookies-and-cream bowl. 175 cal / 16g protein. Three minutes, two ingredients, honest 8.5/10.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 pint David Vanilla Bean frozen dessert (~105 cal / 15g protein — half the current-label pint)
3 HighKey Original Sandwich Cookies (31g / ~70 cal / 1g protein per 3 cookies on the current label)

recipeInstructions.name: Portion Vanilla Base
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop half the David Vanilla Bean pint into a wide serving bowl. A kitchen scale helps you land at exactly 105 cal / 15g protein.

recipeInstructions.name: Crush Cookies
recipeInstructions.text: Hand-crush 3 HighKey Original Sandwich Cookies directly over the bowl. Keep a mix of fine crumbs and larger crunchy pieces — the crunch is doing the flavor work.

recipeInstructions.name: Fold + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Fold once or twice without crushing every piece. Serve immediately while the cookie pieces are still crisp — they soften fast in the ice cream.

recipe.name: Deli Dill Snack Box
recipe.description: Snack Box Series Ep. 8 — deli-plate energy at snack-box scale. 2.5 oz deli turkey + cubed Colby Jack + petite dill pickles + pretzel crisps. About 250 cal / 20g protein per box. Ep. 8 returns to shelf-stable proteins after Ep. 7's first-hot-protein Tropical Chicken. Make four at once for 2 kids × 2 days.
recipeIngredient: 2.5 oz deli turkey (or 3 oz for hungrier kids)
10 oz deli turkey (or 12 oz for the hungrier version)

recipeInstructions.name: Set up
recipeInstructions.text: Set out four divided snack boxes (4-compartment Bento-style — same format as Snack Box Series Ep. 1-7). Deli turkey is shelf-stable pre-open; no cooking needed. Ep. 8 returns to shelf-stable proteins after Ep. 7's cooked-fajita-chicken exception.

recipeInstructions.name: Turkey
recipeInstructions.text: Divide 10 oz deli turkey into 4 boxes — 2.5 oz per box. Any oven-roasted deli turkey works (Hillshire Farm Premium Carved shown; brand-neutral by default). For hungrier kids or adult mini-meal, bump to 3 oz per box (12 oz total).

recipeInstructions.name: Colby Jack
recipeInstructions.text: Cube one Colby Jack cheese stick per box and add to the second compartment. Cube size = 1/2-inch or smaller for young kids. Colby Jack is milder than sharp cheddar — kid-friendly by default. Uniform cube size = no compartment ends up with awkward pieces.

recipeInstructions.name: Pickles
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3-4 petite dill pickles per box to the third compartment (Mt. Olive Kosher Dill Petites shown). This is the flavor-identity moment — kids either love it or reject it, which is the caption's engagement hook. For under-4s, slice petites lengthwise to reduce choking risk; over 4s handle whole petites fine with supervision.

recipeInstructions.name: Pretzels
recipeInstructions.text: Add 0.75 oz pretzel crisps (Snack Factory Original shown) to the DRY compartment — critical to keep pretzels away from pickle moisture, else they soften in the sealed box within hours. Pretzel crisps are flat and thin so they hold better than round hard pretzels, but still separate compartments.

recipeInstructions.name: Lid + Chill
recipeInstructions.text: Snap lids on and refrigerate immediately. Assembled boxes hold up to 3 days for the turkey + cheese (deli turkey has wider cold-chain tolerance than Ep. 7's cooked chicken). Pretzels stay crunchy for 2-3 days if separated from pickle moisture in the box. For lunchboxes, pack with an ice pack.

recipe.name: Dubai-Style Chocolate Thin Sandwich Cookie Creami
recipe.description: CrumblCreamiCut Week 3, Flavor 2 — chocolate-pistachio protein Creami pint finished with a POST-SCOOP toasted-kataifi-and-pistachio-cream crunch topping. ~360 cal / 43g protein whole pint vs 810 cal for the Crumbl Dubai-Style Chocolate Thin Sandwich Cookie on the current Crumbl Davie nutrition listing.
recipeIngredient: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
1/2 tsp pistachio emulsion (publish-corrected — see rules below)
10g dry kataifi pastry strands (Greek shredded phyllo)

recipeInstructions.name: Pour Milk
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk to a Creami pint (or blending vessel).

recipeInstructions.name: Add Sweetener
recipeInstructions.text: 2 tbsp monk fruit / erythritol sweetener.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Whey Isolate
recipeInstructions.text: 1 serving unflavored whey isolate.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Guar Gum
recipeInstructions.text: 1/8 tsp guar gum, LEVEL measure. Heaped = gummy.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Salt
recipeInstructions.text: 1 pinch salt.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Dutch Cocoa
recipeInstructions.text: 1 tbsp Dutch-process cocoa powder. Standard Dutch cocoa (not black cocoa — that's W3F1 Mallow's carrier). Dutch cocoa gives a milk-chocolate depth that plays well with the pistachio emulsion.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Pistachio Emulsion
recipeInstructions.text: 1/2 tsp pistachio emulsion. PUBLISH-CORRECTED AMOUNT — the filmed batch used 1 tsp and read too strong (the pistachio drowned the chocolate). 1/2 tsp is the revised recommendation: readable chocolate base + subtle pistachio backbone that lets the kataifi topping carry the primary pistachio identity. Series-first: no prior CCC episode used a flavor emulsion in the base.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Smooth
recipeInstructions.text: Immersion blender until completely smooth. Base should be a uniform mauve-tinted chocolate brown (the pistachio emulsion + Dutch cocoa mix together — do not expect deep-dark chocolate here). Zero lumps, zero visible whey.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour + Freeze (24 Hr)
recipeInstructions.text: Transfer to a Creami pint if you didn't build in the pint. Freeze upright and level for a full 24 hours. Do not exceed the max-fill line.

recipeInstructions.name: Measure Kataifi
recipeInstructions.text: 10g dry kataifi pastry strands. Kataifi is shredded Greek phyllo pastry — sold refrigerated or frozen in Middle-Eastern / Greek grocery aisles as thin thread-like pastry strands. 10g is roughly a small handful; measure by weight since strand volume varies wildly.

recipeInstructions.name: Dry-toast Kataifi
recipeInstructions.text: Add the 10g kataifi to an UNGREASED skillet over LOW heat. Stir frequently with a spatula until every strand is evenly golden and crisp. This takes 3-4 minutes. Low heat is critical — kataifi burns in under 30 seconds on medium. Series-first: no prior CCC episode used a toasted pastry crunch topping.

recipeInstructions.name: Coat With Pistachio Cream
recipeInstructions.text: Turn heat off. Add 1 tbsp pistachio cream directly to the still-warm toasted kataifi in the skillet. Stir until every strand is coated in pistachio cream. Warm skillet + warm pistachio cream = even coat; the pistachio cream loosens against the toasted strands and coats them without clumping. Set the coated kataifi mixture aside — it will crisp back up as it cools slightly.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest 5 Min + First Spin
recipeInstructions.text: Pull the frozen Creami pint from the freezer, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes — NO hot-water bath. Process on Regular Ice Cream, NOT Lite. The first spin may look grainy; expected because the no-liquid Respin finishes the texture.

recipeInstructions.name: No-liquid Respin
recipeInstructions.text: Run one Respin cycle with NO added liquid. No milk, no water — the base has enough moisture on its own. This is a texture-finish pass, not a mix-in incorporation pass (the topping stays out of the machine). Same cycle family as W1F1-W3F1, but this is the first ep where Respin is a texture-only pass (no mix-in going in).

recipeInstructions.name: Scoop
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop the finished pint into a bowl. Smooth chocolate-pistachio Creami with a mauve-brown tint. Ready for the topping.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Pistachio-kataifi Topping
recipeInstructions.text: Pile ALL of the pistachio-cream-coated toasted kataifi over the scoops. The topping is a POST-SCOOP GARNISH — NOT a machine mix-in. Adding kataifi to the pint before Respin would (a) crush the crunch into paste and (b) turn the Creami gummy from the pistachio cream. Keeping it as a post-scoop finish preserves the shatter-crunch texture and the pistachio-cream coat identity. Serve immediately.

recipeInstructions.name: Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Deep chocolate-pistachio Creami finished with a generous crown of toasted-kataifi-and-pistachio-cream crunch. Eat within 2-3 minutes of topping — kataifi softens fast against the cold Creami surface if it sits.

recipe.name: Electrolyte Watermelon Limeade
recipe.description: Fresh watermelon, tart lime, and electrolytes blended and strained into one cold summer drink.
recipeIngredient: 1 mini watermelon, rind removed and flesh cut into chunks

recipeInstructions.name: Blender
recipeInstructions.text: Add the watermelon chunks to a blender.

recipeInstructions.name: Lime
recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze in the juice from 2 limes.

recipeInstructions.name: Lmnt
recipeInstructions.text: Tear in 2 LMNT packets.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Blend until completely smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Strain
recipeInstructions.text: Strain through a fine-mesh strainer into a bowl or pitcher. The pulp stays behind so it drinks like juice, not a smoothie.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a carafe or glass and serve cold, over ice if you want.

recipe.name: Fast Food Breakfast Tacos
recipe.description: 41g protein, 403 cal, 8 minutes. The fast-food drive-through equivalent — built at home.
recipeIngredient: 1 serving 365 Organic Black Forest Uncured Ham, fine-diced (~70 cal, 11g protein)
1 serving Kraft Fat Free Shredded Cheddar (~45 cal, 9g protein)
3 Mission Zero Net Carbs Original tortillas (small/street-taco size, ~110 cal total, 7g protein)
1 serving Smoky Chipotle Crema (~38-40 cal, 2g protein)
1-2 tbsp pickled red onion OR fresh cilantro (pick one, not both)
Cooking spray or 1 tsp butter for the scramble pan

recipeInstructions.name: Warm Tortillas First
recipeInstructions.text: Stack 3 Mission Zero tortillas, wrap in a damp paper towel, microwave 10 seconds. OR pass each over an open gas flame 5 sec/side for char. Stiff cold tortillas = the #1 reason these taste like fitness food. Don't skip.

recipeInstructions.name: Fine-dice The Ham
recipeInstructions.text: Cut into pieces smaller than your fingernail. Big chunks distribute unevenly — fine dice means every bite gets ham. This is the difference between 'home cooking' and 'craveable fast food'.

recipeInstructions.name: Soft Scramble
recipeInstructions.text: Crack 2 eggs into a small bowl, whisk with a pinch of salt. Heat a nonstick pan on MEDIUM-LOW (not medium, not high), spray with cooking spray. Add eggs. Pull them slowly across the pan with a spatula — you want creamy, slightly underdone curds, not dry chunks. Off heat at 80% set — they finish from carryover. ~90 seconds total.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Ham + Cheese to Pan
recipeInstructions.text: Off heat, fold in the diced ham + 1 serving Kraft FF cheddar. Residual heat melts the cheese into the egg without overcooking it.

recipeInstructions.name: Assemble
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the scramble across the 3 warm tortillas. Don't dump — distribute evenly.

recipeInstructions.name: Sauce The Right Way
recipeInstructions.text: From a squeeze bottle, draw a thin ZIGZAG of Smoky Chipotle Crema across each taco. Not a dump in the middle.

recipeInstructions.name: Green Hit
recipeInstructions.text: Pinch of pickled red onion OR chopped cilantro across all three. This is what kills the beige-on-beige problem and makes the plate look intentional instead of desperate. Skip it and you've made fitness food.

recipeInstructions.name: Eat Handheld
recipeInstructions.text: Fold and bite. Eat within 60 sec — Mission Zero tortillas crack if they sit assembled and cold.

recipe.name: Fiesta Snack Box
recipe.description: Snack Box Series Ep. 10 — colorful post-lunch box with 365 Black Forest ham, Colby cheese, Gheelish tortilla dip chips, and mini sweet peppers. ~210 cal / 13g protein per box.
recipeIngredient: 8 slices (~5 1/3 oz) 365 Black Forest deli ham — 2 slices per box, ~40 cal per portion
4 Sargento Natural Colby-Jack cheese sticks — 1 stick cubed per box, ~80 cal per portion
3 oz Gheelish Original tortilla dip chips — 0.75 oz per box, ~80 cal per portion
Mini sweet peppers (red / yellow / orange mix) — seeded and cut into age-appropriate strips to fill each box

recipeInstructions.name: Set up
recipeInstructions.text: Line up 4 divided snack boxes. Buluker pastel 4-compartment boxes shown — the same set featured on Favorites → Snack Box Essentials.

recipeInstructions.name: Ham
recipeInstructions.text: Fold or cut 2 slices of 365 Black Forest deli ham into one compartment of each box (~5 1/3 oz total across all 4 boxes).

recipeInstructions.name: Colby Cubes
recipeInstructions.text: Cut each Sargento Natural Colby-Jack cheese stick into bite-size cubes and drop 1 stick's worth into the next compartment of each box.

recipeInstructions.name: Sweet Peppers
recipeInstructions.text: Seed and slice mini sweet peppers (red / yellow / orange) into age-appropriate strips. Fill one compartment of each box — the color story of the fiesta box.

recipeInstructions.name: Tortilla Dip Chips
recipeInstructions.text: Weigh 0.75 oz Gheelish Original tortilla dip chips into the remaining compartment of each box. Portion just before serving if you want maximum crunch — the chip compartment stays driest that way.

recipeInstructions.name: Seal + Chill
recipeInstructions.text: Snap lids on and refrigerate. Serve within 2 days. Transport with an ice pack for lunchbox use.

recipe.name: Golden Umami Stir-Fry Sauce
recipe.description: The six-ingredient pan sauce from Lomo Saltado — savory, tangy, garlicky, mildly spicy. Whisk once, pour into a hot pan with cooked protein or veg, reduce until glossy. 6 servings, ~25 cal / 3g protein each (estimated).
recipeIngredient: 2 tbsp Tari Amarillo or another aji amarillo sauce
1 stick pack (~15g) bone-broth powder — creator used Bare Bones

recipeInstructions.name: Combine The Liquids
recipeInstructions.text: Soy sauce, fish sauce, white-wine vinegar, aji amarillo sauce, and ginger-garlic paste into a measuring cup or small bowl.

recipeInstructions.name: Add The Bone-broth Powder
recipeInstructions.text: Tear in the full stick pack (~15g). This is the depth move — the broth powder turns a simple stir-fry sauce into something that reads roasted.

recipeInstructions.name: Whisk Smooth
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk until the bone-broth powder dissolves completely and the sauce is uniform and pourable. Should taste intense on its own.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour + Reduce in a Hot Pan
recipeInstructions.text: Pour into a hot pan holding cooked protein or vegetables. Toss over high heat and reduce until the food is evenly coated and glossy — not soupy.

recipe.name: Green Sauce Chipotle Chicken Mini Tacos
recipe.description: Quick Lunches Ep. 4 — two mini tacos: Kirkland chipotle chicken, high-protein cilantro-jalapeño ranch, on La Banderita Carb Counter tortillas. ~220 cal / 27g protein (est.) for both.
recipeIngredient: 2 La Banderita Carb Counter snack-size mini tortillas (~40 cal / 2g protein each)
4 oz Kirkland / Costco shortcut chipotle chicken (fully cooked)
1 tbsp High-Protein Cilantro-Jalapeño Ranch (1/2 tbsp per taco; cross-link to /cookbook/high-protein-cilantro-jalapeno-ranch)

recipeInstructions.name: Reheat Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Air-fry 4 oz fully cooked Kirkland chipotle chicken about 6 minutes, until hot and 165 F. Appliance settings vary — no temperature invented; use your air fryer's default reheat preset.

recipeInstructions.name: Divide The Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Lay out both La Banderita Carb Counter mini tortillas and divide the hot chicken evenly between them — about 2 oz per taco.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Green Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1/2 tablespoon of high-protein cilantro-jalapeño ranch to each taco, straight over the hot chicken.

recipeInstructions.name: Fold + Eat
recipeInstructions.text: Fold each mini taco and eat immediately while the chicken is hot and the tortilla is soft.

recipe.name: High-Protein Grillo's Pickle Dip
recipe.description: Viral Grillo's pickle dip, rebuilt protein-style. 10 servings, 110 cal / 16g protein per scoop. Packed back into the pickle tub for serving.
recipeIngredient: 450g Mulu High Protein Cottage Cheese, Small Curd 4% (1 tub, blended smooth)
5 tbsp Build the Body Protein Ranch Seasoning
3 oz Epic Hickory Smoked Uncured Bacon Bits (1 bag)
8 Grillo's Pickles Classic Dill Pickle Chips (from the tub — save the rest for snacking)
2 tbsp Grillo's pickle brine (from the tub)
A few pieces of garlic + sprigs of dill from the Grillo's tub

recipeInstructions.name: Drain + Reserve
recipeInstructions.text: Open the Grillo's tub. Pour off the brine into a small measuring cup (reserve 2 tbsp for the dip — the rest can go back in or be saved for other uses). Save the empty tub — that's the serving vessel.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Cottage Cheese
recipeInstructions.text: 450g Mulu cottage cheese into a food processor. Blend 30-45 sec until completely smooth — no curds visible. This is the move that turns the dip from chunky into creamy.

recipeInstructions.name: to Bowl
recipeInstructions.text: Transfer the blended cottage cheese to a mixing bowl. Should look like thick yogurt at this point.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Pickle-ranch Mix
recipeInstructions.text: Back into the (now-empty) food processor — 1/2 cup Siggi's 0% Plain Skyr + 4 Laughing Cow Light wedges + 2 tbsp reserved Grillo's brine + 8 pickle chips + a few pieces of garlic + sprigs of dill from the tub + 5 tbsp Build the Body Ranch Protein Seasoning. Blend until creamy but still pickle-forward (~30 sec). Should have visible pickle flecks but read as a sauce, not a chunky relish.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine
recipeInstructions.text: Pour the blended pickle-ranch mix into the bowl with the cottage cheese base. Fold gently with a spatula until fully combined and uniform.

recipeInstructions.name: Fold in Bacon
recipeInstructions.text: 3 oz Epic Hickory Smoked Bacon Bits into the bowl. Fold gently — visible chunks should remain (don't pulverize). Bacon is the salt + smoke + crunch finish.

recipeInstructions.name: Pack Back Into Tub
