recipeInstructions.text: Reach for a liquid water enhancer whose package is labeled zero calories — MiO Fruit Punch on camera. 'Zero' is per the printed serving and subject to label rounding; it is not fruit.

recipeInstructions.name: Add The Flavor
recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze the water enhancer over the packed snow just before eating so it stays fluffy instead of melting into slush.

recipeInstructions.name: Two Colors + Serve
recipeInstructions.text: For fun, add a second enhancer flavor on the other half for a two-color cup — the color is food dye, not fruit. Eat immediately while it's cold.

recipe.name: 10-Minute Steak, Egg & Cheese Breakfast Bowl
recipe.description: Chop the steak and chile and warm them in a lightly sprayed skillet. Rinse and drain the fat-free shredded cheddar, then add it with the eggs and a few pinches of seasoning salt. Stir until the eggs are just set and divide evenly between two bowls. Rinsing the cheese first helped this batch melt better for me. It's a high-protein breakfast, but with seasoned steak, cheese, and seasoning salt it isn't a low-sodium one.
recipeIngredient: 4.5 oz fully cooked thinly sliced steak
1 small red chile, finely chopped (jalapeno, serrano, or Thai chile also works)
2 oz Kraft fat-free shredded cheddar, rinsed and drained
A few pinches seasoning salt, to taste

recipeInstructions.name: Prep
recipeInstructions.text: Crack the 6 eggs into a bowl and set aside. Chop the steak and chile into small pieces.

recipeInstructions.name: Warm The Steak
recipeInstructions.text: Lightly spray a skillet and warm the steak and chile over medium heat. The steak is already cooked, so you're just heating it through.

recipeInstructions.name: Rinse The Cheese
recipeInstructions.text: Rinse the fat-free shredded cheddar in a fine-mesh strainer and drain it well. Washing off some of the coating helped this batch melt better for me.

recipeInstructions.name: Scramble
recipeInstructions.text: Add the eggs and rinsed cheese to the skillet, season with a few pinches of seasoning salt, and stir until the eggs are just set.

recipeInstructions.name: Divide
recipeInstructions.text: Split evenly between two bowls and serve hot.

recipe.keywords: breakfast, steak-and-eggs, high-protein, 10-minute, breakfast-bowl, quick, one-pan

recipe.name: 15-Minute Chicken Tikka Masala Split Plate
recipe.description: 540 cal / 50g protein per adult plate, 405 cal / 38g protein per kid plate. Serves 2 adults + 2 kids from one 36 oz twin-pack. Warm the sealed Sukhi's Costco tikka masala pouches in hot water 5-7 min while the rumali rotis thaw. Empty into a saucepan, cover, heat 5 min stirring once until steaming. REMOVE 3 SERVINGS (1.5 per kid) BEFORE adding chili — this is the split point. Stir 1 tsp Kashmiri chili into the remaining 4 adult servings and heat briefly to bloom. Adults get 2 servings + 2 rotis plated together. Kids get 1.5 servings + 1.5 rotis, chicken/gravy/rotis in separate compartments for self-dipping. Same tikka, same rotis, split at the pot — this is not scratch-made curry; it's a realistic busy-parent dinner strategy. HALAL claim requires verifying the specific Sukhi's package before publishing — ships pork-free only by default.
recipeIngredient: 1 package / 36 oz prepared chicken tikka masala (2 x 18 oz Sukhi's Costco pouches — seven 5 oz servings total)
Water, hot from the tap (for warming the sealed pouches)
1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder (stirred into the remaining 4 servings AFTER the kids' portions are out)

recipeInstructions.name: Warm The Pouches
recipeInstructions.text: Place the 2 sealed tikka masala pouches in a bowl of hot tap water. Let sit 5-7 min. THE PHYSICAL PACKAGE TAKES PRIORITY if the directions differ from this general guidance.

recipeInstructions.name: Empty Into a Saucepan
recipeInstructions.text: Discard the warming water. Cut open the pouches and empty the tikka masala into a saucepan.

recipeInstructions.name: Pan-heat Covered
recipeInstructions.text: Cover the saucepan and heat on medium-low for about 5 min, stirring once, until the chicken and sauce are steaming hot throughout.

recipeInstructions.name: Warm The Rotis
recipeInstructions.text: While the tikka heats, warm the frozen rotis one at a time in a dry pan 10-15 sec per side (or per the package). Stack under a clean towel to hold soft.

recipeInstructions.name: Split Point — Remove Kid Portions
recipeInstructions.text: Before adding any Kashmiri chili, spoon out 3 total tikka masala servings for the kids' plates (1.5 servings per kid). This is the non-negotiable step — spice doesn't come back out once it's in.

recipeInstructions.name: Stir in Kashmiri Chili
recipeInstructions.text: With the 4 adult servings still in the pan, sprinkle 1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder over the surface and stir to distribute. Heat 30-60 sec covered to bloom the spice.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate The Adult
recipeInstructions.text: Spoon 2 tikka masala servings onto or next to 2 warmed rumali rotis. Serve immediately. 540 cal / 50g protein.

recipe.keywords: chicken, tikka masala, indian, north-indian, weeknight, split-plate, stovetop, fridge-shortcut, freezer-shortcut, family-dinner, kid-approved, assembly, 15-min, emergency-dinner

recipe.name: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs + Cheesy Broccoli
recipe.description: Boneless chicken thighs seasoned two ways (Blackened Bloody Mary for adults, Original for kids) and cooked alongside frozen cheesy broccoli — all in the air fryer. Adult plate ~380 cal / 42g protein. Kid plate: chopped mild thigh + broccoli + a small roll.
recipeIngredient: 12 oz frozen broccoli florets (do not thaw)

recipeInstructions.name: Divide + Dry
recipeInstructions.text: Pat all 6 thighs completely dry. Divide 4 thighs into the adult bowl and 2 into the kid bowl.

recipeInstructions.name: Season Split
recipeInstructions.text: Season the 2 kid thighs with Dan-O's Original (mild). Season the 4 adult thighs with Outlaw Blackened Bloody Mary (bold). Light avocado oil spray on both portions, toss.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest
recipeInstructions.text: Cover both bowls and refrigerate a couple of hours so the seasoning grabs.

recipeInstructions.name: Prep Broccoli
recipeInstructions.text: Toss 12 oz frozen broccoli with light avocado oil spray + salt. Do NOT thaw. Cheesoning goes on AFTER cooking, not before.

recipeInstructions.name: Load Both Air Fryers
recipeInstructions.text: Mild thighs in one basket, blackened thighs in the other (or use one basket with a divider). Broccoli goes in a third basket / vessel. Two-air-fryer setup is the personal favorite here — but any air fryer with enough separated capacity works.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: 375°F, 20 min, flip halfway. Verify 165°F internal on the thickest piece.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Broccoli
recipeInstructions.text: 400°F, 15 min, shake / toss halfway. Goal: crispy charred edges.

recipeInstructions.name: Cheesoning Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Immediately sprinkle Dan-O's Cheesoning on hot broccoli. Toss while hot — this is the differentiator.

recipeInstructions.name: Slice + Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Slice 2 blackened thighs per adult. Add one-quarter of the cheesy broccoli. No bread on the adult plate.

recipe.keywords: air-fryer, chicken, broccoli, split-cook, easy, hands-off

recipe.name: Steak & Fries with Chimichurri
recipe.description: ~45g protein for ~620 cal. Bavette steak with SPG seasoning, seared 2-3 min per side. No-judge chimichurri from Spiceology seasoning. Checkers/Rally's fries air fried. Kids get pork patties + fries + carrots.
recipeIngredient: Checkers/Rally's frozen fries (~1 serving per person)

recipeInstructions.name: Fries First
recipeInstructions.text: Air fry at 400°F for 12-15 min. No oil, no spray. Shake halfway.

recipeInstructions.name: Sear Steak
recipeInstructions.text: Season bavette with SPG. High heat stainless pan + cooking spray. 2-3 min per side.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest
recipeInstructions.text: Pull steak, rest 5 minutes. Cook pork patties in the same pan, 5 min per side.

recipeInstructions.name: Chimichurri
recipeInstructions.text: Mix olive oil + Spiceology chimichurri seasoning + red wine vinegar + chili flakes. Let sit 5 min.

recipeInstructions.name: Slice
recipeInstructions.text: Cut steak thin against the grain.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Sliced bavette + fries. Spoon chimichurri over the steak — not on the fries.

recipe.keywords: steak, bavette, fries, chimichurri, split-cook, air-fryer, fast

recipe.name: Split Plate Buffalo Wing Night
recipe.description: Kinder's Buttery Buffalo wings from frozen — air fryer extra crispy, tossed aggressively in their included hot sauce, served with Protein Blue Cheese Crema, baby carrots, and Rudi's Three Cheese Texas Toast for the kid. Adults get sauced wings + chives garnish. Kids get naked (unsauced) wings + crema-as-dip + bread. Same air-fryer batch, two completely different experiences.
recipeIngredient: 1 bag Kinder's Buttery Buffalo Party Wings (19 oz frozen, includes buffalo sauce packet)
1 box Rudi's Three Cheese Texas Toast (4 thick slices — kid gets 1)
1 batch Protein Blue Cheese Crema (~8 servings, made ahead — gets better on day 2)
2 tbsp fresh chives or scallions, chopped (the visual fix)
1 slice Rudi's Three Cheese Texas Toast (toasted)
1 small ramekin Protein Blue Cheese Crema (OPTIONAL — as a dip, not a topping)

recipeInstructions.name: Make The Crema Ahead
recipeInstructions.text: 5 min prep + 10 min rest. Cottage cheese + 365 blue cheese + Fairlife + lemon + SPG → blend smooth → fold in chives + chunks. Fridge until serving. (See Protein Blue Cheese Crema in Cookbook.)

recipeInstructions.name: Air Fry Wings
recipeInstructions.text: From frozen, 400°F for 18-22 min. Single layer, shake basket halfway. Crispy = goal. Soggy = overcrowded.

recipeInstructions.name: Toast The Bread
recipeInstructions.text: Last 6-7 min of the wing cook, slide Rudi's Three Cheese Texas Toast into a toaster oven or air fryer at 400°F. Pull when cheese is melted and edges are golden.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest
recipeInstructions.text: Wings to a clean bowl. 1 minute. DO NOT skip — this is the move that prevents soggy sauced wings.

recipeInstructions.name: Pull Kid Wings First
recipeInstructions.text: Move 4-5 wings to kid tray BEFORE saucing. No going back once they're sauced.

recipeInstructions.name: Toss Aggressively
recipeInstructions.text: Adult wings in a bowl. Pour the included Kinder's buffalo sauce over. Tongs, toss HARD until every wing is glossy. This is not a delicate move.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Sauced wings on a round plate. Square ramekin of Protein Blue Cheese Crema beside. Pile of baby carrots. Chives scattered over the wings — the green is the fix.

recipe.keywords: wings, buffalo, chicken, air-fryer, freezer-to-plate, comfort, split-cook, high-protein, kid-friendly, weeknight

recipe.name: Busy-Day Steak Taco Plates
recipe.description: 420 cal / 40g protein per adult plate, 4 servings (2 adults + 2 kids). Adults get 1 1/3 labeled servings of Soules Kitchen carne-asada-style steak on 3 La Banderita Carb Counter street-taco tortillas + the included salsa roja + 1/2 serving Khloud Nacho Protein Chips. Kids get 2/3 labeled serving of the same steak on 2 regular Mission Street Taco flour tortillas + 1 Wholly Guacamole mini + 1/2 serving regular tortilla chips (deconstructed plate). One skillet cook. Split at the plate — portion, tortilla type, sauce, and chip. Emergency-dinner design — this is the alternative to DoorDash, not the family carne asada.
recipeIngredient: 1 family pack / 22 oz Soules Kitchen Street Taco Steak with Salsa Roja
6 La Banderita Carb Counter Street Taco tortillas (3 per adult)
Included Soules Kitchen salsa roja packets (divide across 2 adult plates)
1 serving Khloud Nacho Protein Chips (1/2 serving per adult)
4 Mission regular Street Taco flour tortillas (2 per kid)
1 serving regular tortilla chips (1/2 serving per kid)

recipeInstructions.name: Skillet + Steak
recipeInstructions.text: Nonstick skillet on medium-high. Add the full 22 oz Soules Kitchen steak (right from the package, no drain). Reserve the salsa roja packets.

recipeInstructions.name: Broth
recipeInstructions.text: Pour in 1/4 cup chicken bone broth (or water). Cover the skillet.

recipeInstructions.name: Heat
recipeInstructions.text: Medium-high, covered, 3-4 min. Stir once mid-way. Steak is FULLY COOKED — you're only reheating.

recipeInstructions.name: Tortillas Warm
recipeInstructions.text: While the steak heats, warm 6 La Banderita Carb Counter (adult) + 4 Mission regular street-taco (kid) tortillas. Wrap both stacks in a clean towel or tortilla warmer.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Empty the included salsa roja packets into a small ramekin per adult plate.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Steak
recipeInstructions.text: 1 1/3 servings steak (~7 oz) on the plate. Tortillas warm + folded next to it.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Chips
recipeInstructions.text: 1/2 serving Khloud Nacho Protein Chips beside the steak. Assemble tacos at the table.

recipe.keywords: beef, steak, tacos, split-cook, weeknight, high-protein, kid-approved, 10-minute, busy-parent, emergency-dinner, low-carb-adult

recipe.name: Caesar Crunch Pizza Night
recipe.description: 20-min weeknight where everyone gets the pizza they want. Adult plate: 1/3 of a Bettergoods Italian Wood-Fired Margherita Pizza + a full Caesar Crunch Salad — chopped Sweet Gem lettuce + diced Soules Kitchen Fajita Chicken (6 oz) + Bolthouse Farms Creamy Caesar + crushed Quest Hot & Spicy chips + Dan-O's Jalapeño Cheesoning + optional Smoky Chipotle Crema drizzle. Kid plate: one personal Red Baron Deep Dish (Pepperoni or Four Cheese — kid picks) + small undressed salad portion. Salad is built once in a big bowl; pizzas bake simultaneously. Total active time under 10 min.
recipeIngredient: 1 pack (8 oz) Tanimura & Antle Artisan Sweet Gem Lettuce, chopped
12 oz Soules Kitchen Fully Cooked Fajita Chicken, diced
1/2 bag Quest Hot & Spicy Tortilla Style Protein Chips, crushed coarse
2-3 tbsp Bolthouse Farms Creamy Caesar Parmigiano dressing
OPTIONAL: 1-2 tsp Smoky Chipotle Crema drizzle (cookbook)
1/3 Bettergoods Italian Wood-Fired Margherita Pizza (2 of 6 slices)
(NO Dan-O's Jalapeño Cheesoning — visible flecks deter)
1 personal Red Baron Deep Dish Pepperoni OR Four Cheese (whole, undivided)

recipeInstructions.text: PREHEAT OVEN to 400°F.

recipeInstructions.name: Mise en Place
recipeInstructions.text: Sweet Gem chopped into bite pieces, Soules chicken diced 1/2-inch cubes, Quest chips crushed coarse (zip-bag + rolling pin works).

recipeInstructions.name: Start Red Barons
recipeInstructions.text: 2 personal Red Baron Deep Dish pizzas on a sheet pan. 18-min timer.

recipeInstructions.name: Build Salad in Big Bowl
recipeInstructions.text: Lettuce + diced chicken in a large bowl. Toss gently. DO NOT dress yet. Keep chips aside.
ADD BETTERGOODS at the 6-8 min mark. Onto a separate sheet pan or pizza stone in the same oven. 14-16 min bake — should finish ~same time as the Red Barons.

recipeInstructions.name: Pizzas Done
recipeInstructions.text: Pull Bettergoods (golden, basil dark green not black) + Red Barons (cheese melted, crust deep brown). Let rest 2 min.
SLICE BETTERGOODS into 6 wedges. Each adult gets 2 slices = 1/3 of the pie.

recipeInstructions.name: Dress Adult Salad
recipeInstructions.text: Half the undressed salad into an adult bowl. Drizzle 2-3 tbsp Bolthouse Caesar. Toss. Sprinkle Dan-O's Jalapeño Cheesoning generously. Top with crushed Quest chips (don't pre-toss). Optional: 1-2 tsp Smoky Chipotle Crema drizzle.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Wide bowl with the dressed Caesar Crunch + 2 slices Bettergoods.

recipe.keywords: pizza, salad, split-pizza, freezer-to-plate, no-cook-protein, weeknight, kid-favorite, caesar

recipe.name: Carnitas Taco Plate
recipe.description: 565 cal / 30g protein / 29g fat / 42g net carbs per adult plate, 4 servings from 1 Del Real tray (2 adults at 5 oz carnitas + 2 kids at 2.5 oz). Del Real Slow-Cooked Carnitas dropped frozen into a stainless skillet, rendered fat drained after the initial sear, then shredded + re-braised with 1/4 cup Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth under a glass lid for 3 min. Mission Yellow Corn Tortillas (Super Soft) warmed in a dry skillet. Adults plate: white plate, carnitas in a small bowl, Wholly Guacamole Classic Mini in a ramekin, Mezzetta Pickled Red Onions in a deli cup, Lucky Dog Hot Sauce on the side, 3-4 tortillas to assemble. Kids plate: compartment tray — large compartment for tortillas (2-3), small compartment for carnitas, small compartment for Wholly mini. No onions, no hot sauce. Both assemble at the table.
recipeIngredient: 1 tray (15 oz) Del Real Slow-Cooked Carnitas
1/4 cup Kirkland Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth
10-14 Mission Yellow Corn Tortillas Super Soft (count: ~3.5 per adult + ~2.5 per kid + 2 extra in case of breakage)
4 Wholly Guacamole Classic Minis (1 cup per plate, adults AND kids)
2-4 tbsp Mezzetta Pickled Red Onions (1-2 tbsp per plate, in a small deli cup or ramekin)
Lucky Dog Hot Sauce, to taste (a few dashes per taco)
1 ramekin for the Wholly Guacamole mini (squeezed in)
1 small deli cup for the pickled onions
Stack of 3-4 warm Mission Yellow Corn Tortillas
1 compartment kid tray per child (3-4 compartments, like an EZPZ Happy Mat or similar)
Large compartment: stack of 2-3 warm Mission Yellow Corn Tortillas
Small compartment: 1 Wholly Guacamole Classic Mini (squeezed in)

recipeInstructions.name: Mise
recipeInstructions.text: Open Del Real tray, Wholly Guacamole minis on counter (1 per plate), Mission tortilla bag open, bone broth pouch ready, Mezzetta jar + Lucky Dog bottle out for adults.

recipeInstructions.name: Sear Phase
recipeInstructions.text: Stainless skillet over medium-high. Drop the Del Real carnitas straight from the tray into the dry hot pan (frozen blocks, not thawed). 2 min undisturbed for contact-sear on the bottom.

recipeInstructions.name: Drain Fat
recipeInstructions.text: Tip the pan, spoon out 2-3 tbsp of rendered fat into a heat-safe bowl. Discard (or save for cooking rice later). This is the calorie lever — skip it and the dish gains 80 cal/serving.

recipeInstructions.name: Shred + Braise
recipeInstructions.text: Tongs shred the meat into medium pieces (not fine). Pour in 1/4 cup Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth. Glass lid on. 2-3 min until the broth mostly evaporates — visible steam stops escaping the lid edge.

recipeInstructions.name: Dry The Surface
recipeInstructions.text: Lid off, 60 sec on medium. Stir once. Meat should look glossy-moist, not wet-pooled. Off heat.

recipeInstructions.name: Warm Tortillas
recipeInstructions.text: Dry skillet over medium. Stack of corn tortillas, 30 sec/side. Stack them under a clean towel as they come off to hold warm. Don't pre-warm more than 5 min ahead.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Plate
recipeInstructions.text: White dinner plate. Small bowl in the center — scoop 5 oz of the shredded carnitas. Ramekin alongside with the squeezed-in Wholly Guacamole mini. Deli cup with 1-2 tbsp pickled onions (let the brine show). Stack 3-4 warm tortillas next to the plate. Lucky Dog bottle on the side.

recipeInstructions.name: Assemble at The Table
recipeInstructions.text: One tortilla at a time. Carnitas first, guac smear, pickled onions on top, hot sauce dashes. Eat over the plate (corn tortillas drip). Repeat. 3-4 tacos per plate.

recipe.keywords: tacos, carnitas, pork, split-cook, build-your-own, weeknight, fastest, mexican, gluten-free

recipe.name: Cheeseburger Potato Waffle Meal Prep
recipe.description: One waffle-iron batch (6 waffles) + one lean-beef skillet + a 2:1 adult:kid portion split → 2 dinners for 4. Adult plate: 1 waffle + 5 oz raw-equivalent 93/7 beef + 1.5 slices Velveeta + Tari. Creator's kid plate: 1 regular bun + half a waffle + 2.5 oz beef + 3/4 slice Velveeta + ketchup. The waffle stays fun; the protein is built around it, not smuggled into it.
recipeIngredient: 840 g frozen shredded hash browns (thawed and squeezed dry)
240-300 g liquid egg whites (start at 240g; add 30g only if needed)
SPG to taste (creator used Dan-O's SPG)
Light avocado-oil spray for the iron
SPG or preferred burger seasoning to taste
5 oz raw-equivalent seasoned beef + 1.5 slices Velveeta (from portioned container)
2.5 oz raw-equivalent seasoned beef + 3/4 slice Velveeta (from portioned container)

recipeInstructions.name: Thaw + Squeeze The Hash Browns
recipeInstructions.text: Thaw 840g frozen shredded hash browns completely. Wrap in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze firmly until no more water drips out.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Corrected Waffle Mix
recipeInstructions.text: Combine the dry hash browns, 168g cheddar, 3 tbsp cornstarch, and SPG. Add 240g egg whites and mix. Squeeze a handful: if it holds together, stop. If it falls apart, add 30g more egg whites and retest. Do not exceed ~300g.

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat + Load The Iron
recipeInstructions.text: Fully preheat the waffle iron. Apply a light, even coat of avocado-oil spray. Divide the mixture into six equal portions.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Six Crisp Waffles
recipeInstructions.text: Add one portion, close firmly, cook 6-8 min per waffle until deeply golden and easy to release. If the iron resists opening, give it another minute. Repeat for all six.

recipeInstructions.name: Brown The Beef
recipeInstructions.text: Brown 2 lb 93/7 beef in a wide skillet, breaking it into small crumbles. Season with SPG. Add 1/2 cup bone broth; cook until the liquid has absorbed and the beef is moist but not wet.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion 2
recipeInstructions.text: 1 ACROSS EIGHT CONTAINERS: Divide the cooked beef so every adult container gets twice the beef of a kid container. Creator's raw allocation: 5 oz per adult / 2.5 oz per kid, with a small batch cushion.

recipeInstructions.name: Top With Cold Cheese + Store
recipeInstructions.text: 1.5 slices Velveeta on each adult beef portion; 3/4 slice on each kid portion. Keep the cheese cold in the container — it melts on reheat.

recipeInstructions.name: Reheat
recipeInstructions.text: Microwave the adult beef-and-cheese container ~90 seconds until steaming. Air-fry one potato waffle 6-8 min until crisp.

recipeInstructions.name: Build + Tari
recipeInstructions.text: Stack the melted beef and cheese on the crisp waffle. Drizzle Tari to taste.

recipe.keywords: beef, potato-waffle, hash-brown, cheeseburger, meal-prep, viral, proteinized, family-dinner, split-plate, waffle-iron, batch-cook

recipe.name: Cheesy Spinach & Chicken Orzo
recipe.description: Caramelize onion in butter, cook regular orzo in chicken bone broth, then stir in spinach and cooked smoked pulled chicken. Off heat, fold in completely smooth blended cottage cheese and lite mozzarella. Portion into eight full-size servings and top with cheddar; heat an individual portion before eating. One-eighth of the untopped batch is approximately 514 calories and 53g protein. A full portion with 1 tsp chili crunch is approximately 550 calories and 53g protein. Smaller kid portions do not use those adult estimates.
recipeIngredient: 464g dry regular orzo (eight logged servings; check your package serving weight)
Optional: 1 tsp chili crunch per adult portion, added after serving
Seasonings to taste (exact amount not recorded)

recipeInstructions.name: Caramelize The Onion
recipeInstructions.text: Cook the 300g chopped onion in 1 tbsp butter, stirring as needed until caramelized. Season to taste; an exact seasoning amount was not recorded.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook The Orzo
recipeInstructions.text: Add 464g dry regular orzo and 4 cups chicken bone broth. Simmer, stirring, until the pasta is cooked. No pasta water was added to the filmed batch; the time depends on the pasta and pan.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Spinach And Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Stir in 340g chopped spinach, then 840g cooked smoked pulled chicken. Heat through.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend The Cheese Base
recipeInstructions.text: Blend 339g cottage cheese completely smooth. Take the orzo pan off the heat, then fold through the cottage cheese and 168g shredded lite mozzarella until creamy.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion And Top
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the shared mild pot into eight full-size portions and top with 84g shredded cheddar across the batch. The kids had smaller portions from this same pot; do not count eight adult portions plus extra kid portions.

recipeInstructions.name: Heat And Finish
recipeInstructions.text: The creator microwaved an individual portion for about two minutes immediately before eating. Adjust for the microwave and portion, stir, and heat refrigerated leftovers thoroughly. Add 1 tsp chili crunch to a full adult portion if desired; leave kid portions mild.

recipe.keywords: chicken, orzo, spinach, cottage-cheese, one-pot, high-protein, family-dinner, meal-prep

recipe.name: Chicken Alfredo Crunch Nests
recipe.description: Original recipe test — Episode 1 of Can I Make a Recipe Go Viral? Hash-brown cups pressed into a 12-cup muffin pan, roasted alongside a sheet of broccoli, filled with a thick cottage-cheese Alfredo folded through Costco chipotle chicken, and topped at the table with a cooled Parmesan-mozzarella lid that actually cracks. 12 nests = 2 dinners for 2 adults + 2 kids. Per nest: 130 cal / 12g protein. Adult plate (2 nests + lemon broccoli): ~340 cal / 28g protein estimated. Kid plate: the creator started each child with 1 nest based on appetite, plus broccoli and a small Alfredo dip.
recipeIngredient: 15 oz plain frozen shredded hash browns (thaw + squeeze very dry)
2 tsp avocado oil + 1-2 tsp for brushing the pan
12 oz Costco chipotle chicken (cooked, finely chopped)
1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp kosher salt
1 wedge lemon (zest or juice to finish)
One-fourth of the 20 oz lemon-broccoli batch
Fresh lemon zest or juice at the finish
Small dish of prepared Alfredo sauce (creator used Rao's) — for dipping

recipeInstructions.name: Heat + Prep
recipeInstructions.text: Oven 415 F, racks upper + lower thirds. Brush all 12 muffin cups with 1-2 tsp avocado oil.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake Lids
recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parm + mozz on parchment, divide into 12 loose 2 1/4-inch rounds. Bake 5-7 min until bubbling + deeply golden. Cool completely so they turn brittle.

recipeInstructions.name: Shell Mix
recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze thawed hash browns very dry in a clean towel. Combine with egg whites + Parm + cornstarch + oil + garlic + salt + pepper.

recipeInstructions.name: Press Shells
recipeInstructions.text: About 35g per cup. Thin across bottom + up shallow sides, visible rim.

recipeInstructions.name: Roast Shells + Broccoli
recipeInstructions.text: 20 oz broccoli tossed with oil + garlic + salt on a sheet pan next to the muffin pan. Rotate + swap racks at 12 min. Broccoli 18-22 min, shells 18-23 min.

recipeInstructions.name: Alfredo
recipeInstructions.text: Blend cottage cheese + milk + Parm + cornstarch + spices until mostly smooth. Warm over medium-low, stirring, until steaming + thick. Fold in chopped chipotle chicken. Do not boil.

recipeInstructions.name: Fill + Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Oven to 390 F. Spoon ~50g (level 1/4 cup) warm filling into each shell, rim exposed. Bake 6-8 min to 165 F.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest + Reveal
recipeInstructions.text: Rest 4 min. Loosen with a silicone/wooden utensil. Add cooled lids only at the table.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate The Adult
recipeInstructions.text: 2 nests + one-fourth of the broccoli. Finish broccoli with lemon.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Lids Last
recipeInstructions.text: Set cooled cheese lids on each nest at the table so they stay brittle.

recipe.keywords: chicken, alfredo, hash-browns, muffin-pan, cottage-cheese-alfredo, family-dinner, split-plate, meal-prep, two-night-plan, viral-recipe-test

recipe.name: Chicken Pot Pie
recipe.description: 520 cal / 30g protein per adult serving. 6 servings of filling (feeds 2 adults full + 2 kids half + leaves 2 servings reserved for next meal prep). Built around Kirkland chipotle-seasoned cooked chicken (18 oz) so the recipe is mostly vegetables + sauce + puff pastry — no raw-chicken prep. Mushrooms + carrots sweated in avocado-oil spray, flour roux cooked 1 min, vermouth deglaze, 3 cups Kirkland bone broth boiled to thicken, chicken + asparagus folded in. 4 oven-safe bowls filled, puff pastry top + egg wash, 425°F × 20 min until golden. Save the remaining filling + a second sheet of puff pastry for the next batch (meal-prep economy). Adult: 1 full bowl. Kid: 1/2 serving — rest first so the filling cools enough.
recipeIngredient: 18 oz Kirkland chipotle-seasoned cooked chicken, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces
1/4 cup Martini & Rossi Extra Dry Vermouth
3 cups Kirkland Organic Chicken Bone Broth
4-5 pinches kosher salt (chicken is already seasoned)
1 sheet Pepperidge Farm puff pastry (~250g, makes 4 tops)
~1 tbsp Chosen Foods avocado oil spray
1 full pot pie bowl (~12 oz filling + 1 puff pastry top)
1/2 pot pie bowl (~6 oz filling + 1/2 puff pastry top)

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat
recipeInstructions.text: Oven to 425°F. Spray a large skillet with avocado oil.

recipeInstructions.name: Mushrooms
recipeInstructions.text: Add mushrooms to the skillet. Cook ~3 min, stirring, until they release water and shrink.

recipeInstructions.name: Carrots
recipeInstructions.text: Add chopped carrots + 2 pinches kosher salt. Cook ~3 min more, stirring.

recipeInstructions.name: Flour Roux
recipeInstructions.text: Sprinkle 1 oz flour over the veg. Stir 1 minute (count to 60) to cook off the raw-flour taste.

recipeInstructions.name: Vermouth Deglaze
recipeInstructions.text: Pull the pan off the heat. Pour 1/4 cup vermouth, stir to slurry the roux. Back on heat.

recipeInstructions.name: Broth
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3 cups Kirkland bone broth. Bring to a boil, stirring, until the sauce thickens (~2 min).

recipeInstructions.name: Chicken + Asparagus
recipeInstructions.text: Fold in 18 oz chopped chipotle chicken + 4 oz asparagus. Simmer 3 min — asparagus turns bright green, chicken heats through.

recipeInstructions.name: Oil The Bowl Rims
recipeInstructions.text: Spray or brush 4 oven-safe bowl interiors AND rims with avocado oil so the pastry releases.

recipeInstructions.name: Fill Bowls
recipeInstructions.text: Scoop filling into 4 bowls (~12 oz each). Reserve remaining filling for next meal prep.

recipeInstructions.name: Puff Pastry
recipeInstructions.text: Roll the sheet lightly. Cut 4 tops sized for your bowls. Drape each over a bowl; press gently around the rim.

recipeInstructions.name: Vent + Egg Wash
recipeInstructions.text: Cut a 1-inch slit in the center of each top FIRST. Brush egg wash over the entire surface.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake 425°f · 20 Min
recipeInstructions.text: Until the pastry is deep golden + puffed. Tops crack slightly as they rise.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Portion
recipeInstructions.text: 1 full bowl. Pastry top intact. Crack with a spoon at the table — the spoon-through-the-crust moment is the viral payoff.

recipeInstructions.name: Eat While Hot
recipeInstructions.text: 520 cal / 30g protein. The filling is rich; the pastry adds texture contrast. Adult plate is generous — pair with a side salad if you want vegetables on the side.

recipe.keywords: chicken, pot-pie, casserole, family-batch, meal-prep, weeknight, high-protein, costco-shortcut, puff-pastry, kid-friendly

recipe.name: Chicken Smash Caesar Tacos
recipe.description: ~52g protein for ~510 cal (adult plate, incl. half a bag of Quest chips). One pound of 94/6 ground chicken smashed onto tortillas with Velveeta shreds inside. Caesar finish with romaine + homemade high-protein Caesar dressing. One batch makes 12 tacos — 8 La Banderita keto street tacos for two adults, 4 Mission flour street tacos for two kids. 15 minutes.
recipeIngredient: 3 oz Velveeta Original Shreds (mixed into chicken)
1/4 cup taco seasoning (labels vary — keep it in the background)
8 La Banderita Carb Counter keto street-taco tortillas (adults)
4 La Banderita Carb Counter keto street tacos (from the shared cook)
1 cup chopped romaine tossed with 1 tbsp homemade high-protein Caesar
2 Mission flour street tacos (from the shared cook), plain
Chips on the side (amount to preference)

recipeInstructions.name: Mix
recipeInstructions.text: Combine ground chicken, Velveeta shreds, salt, and taco seasoning. Don't overwork — keep it loose.

recipeInstructions.name: Smash
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the mixture evenly across all 12 tortillas and spread it thin to the edges — this is critical.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook
recipeInstructions.text: Chicken side down on a medium-hot griddle, 4-5 min until browned and the chicken reaches 165°F. Flip and toast the tortilla side 1-2 min.

recipeInstructions.name: Salad
recipeInstructions.text: Toss 2 cups romaine with 2 tbsp of the homemade high-protein Caesar (recipe on /cookbook/high-protein-caesar-dressing), split across the two adult plates.

recipeInstructions.name: Build
recipeInstructions.text: Plate 4 keto tacos per adult with the dressed romaine and half a bag of Quest chips.

recipe.keywords: tacos, chicken, caesar, smash, split-cook, keto-option, fast

recipe.name: Split-Protein Creamy Spinach Pasta
recipe.description: One-cook, two-protein dinner for two adults and two kids. Everyone gets regular pasta coated in a batch-prepped spinach + cottage-cheese green sauce. Adults get seared tri-tip; kids get bite-sized beef meatballs with a little Alfredo. The green sauce batch is portioned for six future family dinners, and 1 lb of tri-tip creates four adult portions (two now, two for the next adult meal). Adult plate is a rounded creator estimate at ~460 cal / 38g protein; kid macros are intentionally hidden until each current pasta / meatball / Alfredo / cottage-cheese / milk / broth label is checked.
recipeIngredient: 3 individual cups (5.3 oz each) low-fat cottage cheese
enough green sauce to lightly coat 4 pasta servings
1 lb tri-tip (divides into 4 portions — 2 now, 2 for next adult meal)
ghee or another high-heat cooking fat, as needed
4 oz fully cooked bite-sized beef meatballs (2 oz per kid)
prepared Alfredo sauce, enough to lightly coat (do NOT pool)

recipeInstructions.name: Blanch Spinach
recipeInstructions.text: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the 9 oz bag of spinach and blanch briefly, just until fully wilted.

recipeInstructions.name: Ice Bath + Squeeze
recipeInstructions.text: Immediately transfer spinach to ice water to stop the cooking. Drain thoroughly and squeeze out excess water — residual water thins the sauce.

recipeInstructions.name: Add to Blender
recipeInstructions.text: Add three low-fat cottage-cheese cups, 1/2 cup ultra-filtered milk, and 1/2 cup bone broth to a blender. Add the cooled, well-drained spinach.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Smooth
recipeInstructions.text: Blend until completely smooth and pale green.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion Bulk Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Set aside enough sauce to lightly coat four pasta servings. Portion the remainder into family-dinner containers — creator reports the batch covers ~6 family dinners in total.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook + Toss Pasta
recipeInstructions.text: Cook four package servings of regular pasta per the package. Drain, return to the pot, and toss with only enough green sauce to coat the pasta.

recipeInstructions.name: Season
recipeInstructions.text: Season tri-tip on all sides with preferred steak seasoning.

recipeInstructions.name: Sear
recipeInstructions.text: Heat a large skillet with a small amount of ghee, then sear the tri-tip until deeply browned on all sides.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest
recipeInstructions.text: Cook to preferred doneness (creator: medium-rare, ~130°F for meal-prep reheat headroom — see USDA guidance in executionRules for whole-cut minimum). Transfer to a board and rest at least 5 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Slice + Cube
recipeInstructions.text: Slice thin against the grain, then cut into bite-sized cubes.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Green pasta + one tri-tip portion per adult.

recipeInstructions.name: Heat Meatballs
recipeInstructions.text: Warm 4 oz bite-sized beef meatballs per package directions.

recipeInstructions.name: Coat + Divide
recipeInstructions.text: Add just enough Alfredo to lightly coat the meatballs, then divide into two 2 oz kid portions.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Same green pasta + 2 oz Alfredo-coated meatballs per kid. Kid macros intentionally hidden — the creator didn't measure the pasta/Alfredo/meatball combination against exact labels.

recipe.keywords: steak, meatballs, pasta, creamy, spinach, cottage-cheese, split-cook, batch-prep, meal-prep, hidden-vegetable

recipe.name: Split Plate Chili Hot Dogs
recipe.description: 510 cal / 58g protein per adult plate, 4 servings (2 adults + 2 kids). Adults get 1.5 loaded chili dogs on Nature's Own keto buns with red onion, banana peppers, and 1/2 slice Velveeta per dog. Kids get 1 deconstructed chili dog on a Ball Park regular bun + 0.5 beef dog on the side + optional yellow mustard — plated on a divided tray so they can build their own. Reusable 12-serving Hot Dog Chili Base: 2 lb 93/7 grass-fed ground beef browned with Spiceology BBQ rub, Dijon, Worcestershire, tomato paste, and bone broth — reduced until thick enough to stay on a dog. This family dinner uses 6 servings; the other 6 anchor a later chili mac / baked potato / fries night.
recipeIngredient: 6 beef hot dogs (Nathan's / Ball Park Angus / Kirkland uncured — pick one)
1 batch Hot Dog Chili Base (2 lb 93/7 ground beef + Spiceology BBQ rub or alternative seasoning + Dijon + Worcestershire + tomato paste + bone broth)
3 slices Velveeta Original (1/2 slice per dog)
3 Nature's Own Keto Hot Dog Buns (1.5 per adult plate)
Finely chopped red onion, to taste
2 Ball Park regular hot dog buns (1 per kid)
Yellow mustard, to taste (optional — only if they ask)

recipeInstructions.name: Chili Base
recipeInstructions.text: Make the Hot Dog Chili Base (or reheat 6 stored servings). Brown 2 lb 93/7 ground beef, season with 3 tbsp Spiceology BBQ rub (or the alternative blend), stir in Dijon + Worcestershire, add tomato paste + bone broth, reduce uncovered until the visible liquid is gone. Divide into 12 servings; use 6 tonight.

recipeInstructions.name: Score The Dogs
recipeInstructions.text: Shallow diagonal cuts on 6 beef dogs — 3-4 marks per dog, no more than 1/4 through. Char surface without splitting.

recipeInstructions.name: Air Fry
recipeInstructions.text: 400°F for ~7 min. Check early — air fryers vary. Pull when the scores have opened and the edges are lightly charred.

recipeInstructions.name: Warm Both Bun Stacks
recipeInstructions.text: 3 Nature's Own keto (adult) + 2 Ball Park regular (kid). 30 sec at 300°F in the air fryer after the dogs come out. Cold buns crack; warm buns cradle the dog.

recipeInstructions.name: 1/2 Velveeta Slice Per Bun
recipeInstructions.text: 6 buns × 1/2 slice = 3 slices total. Fold the slice INTO the bun before the dog — the hot chili melts it in seconds.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Toppings Prep
recipeInstructions.text: Finely chop red onion. Slice banana peppers (or use pre-jarred). Both stay raw — no cook time.

recipeInstructions.name: Assemble
recipeInstructions.text: 3 Nature's Own keto buns → 1/2 Velveeta slice each → hot dog → 1 serving chili spooned over each dog.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Scatter red onion + banana peppers over the adult chili dogs. Plate 1.5 dogs per adult (~510 cal / 58g protein).

recipe.keywords: hot-dogs, chili, beef, comfort, split-cook, batch-cook, family-dinner, keto-bun-adult, air-fryer, weeknight

recipe.name: Chili Mac and Cheese
recipe.description: ~380 cal / 39g protein per adult container. 8 meal-prep containers: 4 adult (2 oz dry Carbe Diem elbows + 1 full chili serving + one-quarter of the adult sauce build) + 4 kid (1.5 oz dry Barilla regular elbows + half a chili serving + one-quarter of the kid sauce build). Blended cottage-cheese sauce (cottage cheese + Fairlife + nutritional yeast + cheddar powder) split 2:1 into adult and kid pots. Velveeta melts in per pot (2 oz adult / 1 oz kid). Reserved Hot Dog Chili Base folds in (4 full servings adult pot / 2 full-serving equivalents split across 4 kid containers = half chili serving per kid). Bone broth loosens to creamy. Kid macros intentionally not published — cottage cheese fat percentage was not label-verified. Reheats to 165°F all week with a small splash of milk or bone broth if the sauce tightens.
recipeIngredient: 6 servings prepared Hot Dog Chili Base (~420-480 g total — the reserve from Chili Hot Dogs)
3 oz Velveeta Original (2 oz adult pot + 1 oz kid pot)
3/8 cup Kirkland chicken bone broth (1/4 cup adult pot + 1/8 cup kid pot)
8 oz dry Carbe Diem elbows (or Pete's higher-fiber elbows) — 2 oz per adult container
4 full servings Hot Dog Chili Base (~280-320 g total)
6 oz dry Barilla regular elbows — 1.5 oz per kid container
2 full-serving equivalents Hot Dog Chili Base (~140-160 g total = 1/2 serving per container)

recipeInstructions.name: Blend The Sauce Base
recipeInstructions.text: Cottage cheese + Fairlife into a blender until mostly smooth. Add nutritional yeast + cheddar powder. Blend again until completely smooth and pourable. If curd texture remains, blend 60 sec more.

recipeInstructions.name: Two Pots, Two Pastas
recipeInstructions.text: Cook 8 oz Carbe Diem elbows (adult) and 6 oz Barilla regular elbows (kid) in separate salted-water pots per each pasta's package directions. Drain both, return to their original pots.

recipeInstructions.name: Divide The Sauce 2
recipeInstructions.text: 1: Two parts of the blended sauce into the adult pot, one part into the kid pot. Adult pot carries more pasta and gets more sauce.

recipeInstructions.name: Melt Velveeta
recipeInstructions.text: 2 oz Velveeta into the adult pot + 1 oz into the kid pot. Stir over LOW heat until fully melted and glossy. Do NOT add the chili yet — Velveeta needs bare pasta + sauce to melt cleanly.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Reserved Chili
recipeInstructions.text: 4 full servings (~280-320 g) of Hot Dog Chili Base into the adult pot. 2 full-serving equivalents (~140-160 g) into the kid pot — this becomes half a chili serving in each of the 4 kid containers. Fold to combine.

recipeInstructions.name: Loosen + Fold
recipeInstructions.text: 1/4 cup bone broth into the adult pot, 1/8 cup into the kid pot. Fold over low heat until creamy and evenly combined. Sauce should coat the pasta glossy, not pool.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion 4+4 Containers
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the adult pot across 4 airtight containers (~2 oz dry pasta + 1 chili serving + one-quarter of the adult sauce build per container). Divide the kid pot across 4 airtight containers. Cool 20-30 min uncovered before sealing — critical for texture across the week.
ADULT CONTAINER = 2 oz dry Carbe Diem elbows cooked + 1 full chili serving + one-quarter of the adult pot's sauce build + 1/2 oz Velveeta melt-in equivalent. ~380 cal / 39g protein per container.

recipe.keywords: chili-mac, meal-prep, beef, pasta, chain-from, batch-cook, family-dinner, reheats, cottage-cheese-sauce, protein-pasta

recipe.name: Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas
recipe.description: ~40g protein for ~450 cal. Pre-cooked chicken with taco seasoning + bone broth. Adults: crispy quesadilla + fajitas + chipotle sauce. Kids: soft street tacos + melty cheese + mild sauce. 20 min.

recipeInstructions.name: Fajitas (adults Only)
recipeInstructions.text: Spray pan, cook sliced onion + peppers 2-3 min. Add taco seasoning + bone broth. Simmer until reduced.

recipeInstructions.name: Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Add pre-cooked chicken to fajita pan. Toss 1-2 min until coated and juicy.

recipeInstructions.name: Build
recipeInstructions.text: Tortilla → cheese → chicken + fajitas → cheese → tortilla. Medium heat, 4-5 min per side. Light press.

recipeInstructions.name: Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Slice, serve with chipotle sauce on the side.

recipe.keywords: chicken, quesadilla, tacos, chipotle, split-cook, fast, kid-friendly

recipe.name: Cilantro-Lime Rice Bowls with Chipotle Chicken & Fire-Roasted Corn
recipe.description: One shared cook, two family-friendly plates. Chargrilled chipotle-seasoned chicken reheats in the air fryer, fire-roasted corn boils in 5 min, and Bone Broth Rice is either freshly cooked or reheated from meal prep. Adults get their rice tossed with fresh cilantro + lime juice + salt and topped with 1 tbsp Tari Verde; kids get the same rice with butter and finished with 1/2 tbsp toum. Not two separate meals — one cook, two finishes. 472 cal / 43g protein per adult plate. Kid macros intentionally not published: Tushar served 1/2 rice serving + 3 oz chicken + 2 oz corn + 1/2 tbsp toum per tray, and appetite varies. USDA storage window: refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours; use within 3-4 days.
recipeIngredient: 3 prepared servings Bone Broth Rice (from the 8-serving base recipe)
18 oz fully cooked chargrilled chipotle-seasoned chicken
1-2 limes (for the corn seasoning and the adult rice finish)
2 prepared servings Bone Broth Rice (from the shared cook)
12 oz reheated chipotle chicken (6 oz per adult)
4 oz cooked fire-roasted corn (2 oz per adult)
2 tbsp Tari Verde (1 tbsp per adult, drizzled on top)
1 prepared serving Bone Broth Rice (split between two trays)
1 tbsp butter (divided across both rice portions)
6 oz reheated chipotle chicken (3 oz per tray)
4 oz cooked fire-roasted corn (2 oz per tray)
1 tbsp toum or preferred mayo-based sauce (1/2 tbsp per tray in Tushar's build)

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare The Bone Broth Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Cook a fresh batch (2 cups rice + 4 cups bone broth, 18-20 min covered on low + 10 min rest) OR reheat 3 stored servings until steaming hot.

recipeInstructions.name: Reheat The Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Air fryer 10 min at the package-recommended temperature. Confirm steaming hot throughout before serving.

recipeInstructions.name: Boil The Corn
recipeInstructions.text: 5 min in salted water. Drain, then season with fresh lime juice and salt to taste.

recipeInstructions.name: Toss Adult Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Combine 2 rice servings with chopped cilantro, lime juice, and salt to taste. Toss while the rice is still warm — the aroma opens up faster.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate Adult
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the cilantro-lime rice across two plates. Add 6 oz chicken and 2 oz corn to each. Drizzle 1 tbsp Tari Verde over the top of each plate — do not mix in.

recipeInstructions.name: Split The Kid Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Divide 1 rice serving across two trays. Add 1/2 tbsp butter per tray while the rice is warm; toss until melted.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate The Kid Trays
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3 oz chicken and 2 oz corn to each tray. Drizzle 1/2 tbsp toum over the chicken in each tray. ADJUST PORTIONS FOR YOUR OWN KIDS' APPETITES.

recipe.keywords: chicken, rice bowl, chipotle, cilantro-lime, tari-verde, toum, shortcut, assembly, weeknight, split-plate, family-dinner, kid-approved, bone-broth-rice

recipe.name: Creamy Beef Bacon Pasta
recipe.description: 350 cal / 27.8g protein / 14.9g fat / 42.7g carbs per adult serving, 6 servings batch. 20 slices Godshall's Beef Bacon diced and rendered crispy, fat drained — bacon goes into BOTH plates (kids love bacon; the split-cook lever is the sauce, not the protein). Adult sauce blends 1 tub Daisy cottage cheese + 4 Laughing Cow Light wedges + 3 servings Rao's Alfredo + 1/2 portion Kirkland chicken bone broth into a creamy base; adults eat it over Carbe Diem Penne with bacon folded in and fresh parsley on top. Kids eat regular wheat penne tossed with plain Rao's Alfredo straight from the jar + a share of the bacon — no blended sauce, no parsley. Two pots cook simultaneously. Reheats clean for 3-4 days with a splash of bone broth.
recipeIngredient: 2 packs Godshall's Beef Bacon (20 slices total, 10 oz × 2)
1 container (16 oz) Daisy Low-Fat Cottage Cheese
4 wedges Laughing Cow Light Spreadable Cheese
3 servings (~3/4 cup) Rao's Homemade Alfredo (for the blend)
1/2 cup Kirkland Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth (half a portion)
4 servings dry Carbe Diem Penne (~8 oz dry — adult pot)
~70% of the rendered bacon crumble (kid pot gets the other ~30%)
2 servings dry regular wheat penne (Barilla classic or any familiar penne, ~4 oz dry — kid pot)
~3/4 cup Rao's Homemade Alfredo (straight from the jar — NOT the blended sauce)
~30% of the rendered bacon crumble (the rest is for adults)

recipeInstructions.name: Prep
recipeInstructions.text: Dice 20 slices Godshall's Beef Bacon (stack + cross-cut into 1/2-inch pieces). Set two pots of salted water to boil. Chop a small handful of parsley for the adult plate.

recipeInstructions.name: Render Bacon
recipeInstructions.text: Diced bacon into a wide skillet over medium-high heat. 6-8 min until crisp. Pour into a strainer set over a bowl. Discard most of the rendered fat (reserve 1 tbsp in the pan if you want).

BLEND THE ADULT SAUCE (cold/warm, NOT hot): Food processor — full tub Daisy cottage cheese + 4 Laughing Cow Light wedges + 3 servings (~3/4 cup) Rao's Alfredo + 1/2 cup Kirkland bone broth. Blend 60 sec until completely smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Two Pastas Simultaneously
recipeInstructions.text: Pot 1: 4 servings dry Carbe Diem Penne (adult, ~8 oz dry). Pot 2: 2 servings dry regular wheat penne (kid, ~4 oz dry). Both 9-10 min al dente.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Build
recipeInstructions.text: Drained Carbe Diem back into its pot OFF heat. Pour in the blended sauce. Return to LOW heat. Stir 60 sec — should coat the back of a spoon, not slide off. Fold in ~70% of the crispy bacon (save ~30% for the kid pot).

recipeInstructions.name: Plate Adult
recipeInstructions.text: Wide bowl. Generous scoop. Sprinkle chopped parsley + cracked black pepper.

recipe.keywords: pasta, beef-bacon, alfredo, split-cook, protein-pasta, meal-prep, weeknight, comfort, pork-free

recipe.name: Creamy Sausage Spinach Pasta
recipe.description: Cook 3 lb of Falls Brand mild Italian sausage in one pan, drain the fat (this is the critical move — without it, the Alfredo turns oily), then split: half goes into Pete's protein rotini with wilted baby spinach for adults, half goes into Barilla mini penne for kids. Adults finish with chili flakes + Italian seasoning. 8 meal-prep servings at 510 cal / 39g protein each. Reheats well — Pete's pasta + Alfredo + bone broth splash holds up across the week where leaner meal preps go chalk by day 3.
recipeIngredient: 3 lb Falls Brand Mild Italian Sausage (the 24 oz / 1.5 lb tray, buy 2)
1 full jar Rao's Homemade Alfredo Sauce (~15 oz)
1 additional serving Rao's Alfredo (about 4 oz from a second jar, OR substitute 1/4 cup heavy cream + 2 tbsp Parmesan)
Up to 1/2 cup chicken bone broth (added slowly to loosen sauce as needed)
6 servings dry Pete's Pasta Rotini (about 12 oz dry — adult pot)
12 oz wilted baby spinach (from the shared step, all of it)
3 servings dry Barilla Mini Penne (about 6 oz dry — kid pot)

recipeInstructions.name: Brown The Sausage
recipeInstructions.text: All 3 lb in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Break apart finely with a meat masher (kid-bite size). 8-10 min until deeply browned and fond starts forming.

recipeInstructions.name: Drain The Fat (non-negotiable)
recipeInstructions.text: Pour the sausage into a strainer over a bowl. Discard the rendered grease. Return drained sausage to the pan. This step determines whether the meal prep stays creamy or turns oily by day 2.

recipeInstructions.name: Wilt Spinach Separately
recipeInstructions.text: 12 oz baby spinach in a separate pan over medium heat. 90 seconds, just until bright green. Drain, squeeze excess water. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Two Pastas Simultaneously
recipeInstructions.text: Pot 1: 6 servings dry Pete's Rotini, salted boiling water, 9-10 min al dente (adult). Pot 2: 3 servings dry Barilla Mini Penne, same timing (kid).

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Lower heat on the sausage pan. Add the full jar of Rao's + 1 extra serving. Stir until coated. If tight, splash bone broth (2 tbsp at a time, up to 1/2 cup total). Sauce should coat the back of a spoon.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Pot
recipeInstructions.text: Toss drained Pete's Rotini with 60% of the sausage-Alfredo from the shared pan. Fold in wilted spinach. Sprinkle a pinch of chili flakes + 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning. Toss until rotini grooves are coated.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate Adult
recipeInstructions.text: Generous scoop into a wide bowl. Rotini grooves catch the sauce + sausage + spinach. Optional: cracked black pepper + grated Parmesan.

recipe.keywords: pasta, sausage, spinach, alfredo, split-cook, protein-pasta, meal-prep, weeknight, comfort

recipe.name: Creamy Steak Noodles (No Cream)
recipe.description: ~31g protein for ~391 cal. Seared steak + egg noodles in a creamy sauce made from blended cottage cheese + Fairlife (no cream). Bettergoods beef bone broth for depth. Adults get chili flakes + parsley, kids get it plain.
recipeIngredient: 20 oz steak (flat iron or sirloin), seared whole then diced
1 cup Daisy Cottage Cheese (2%), blended with milk
Optional: pat of butter on top

recipeInstructions.name: Blend
recipeInstructions.text: Cottage cheese + Fairlife milk, 60 seconds on high until completely smooth. Set aside cold.

recipeInstructions.name: Noodles
recipeInstructions.text: Boil egg noodles to al dente. Drain, spray lightly to prevent sticking.

recipeInstructions.name: Sear
recipeInstructions.text: Season steak with half the salt + white pepper. High heat, 1-2 min per side. Remove, dice.

recipeInstructions.name: Roux
recipeInstructions.text: Same pan, medium heat. Melt butter, whisk in flour. Stir 90 sec until golden and nutty.

recipeInstructions.name: Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Slowly whisk in beef broth. Add Dijon, Worcestershire, garlic powder, onion powder, remaining salt + pepper. Simmer 5-6 min.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend in
recipeInstructions.text: Pull OFF heat. Slowly stir in the cottage cheese blend. Smooth and creamy.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine
recipeInstructions.text: Return steak to sauce on low heat. Add noodles. Toss gently 3-4 min.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Bowl of noodles + steak. Top with chili flakes, parsley, black pepper.

recipe.keywords: steak, noodles, pasta, creamy, cottage-cheese, split-cook, comfort, high-protein

recipe.name: Dan-O's Bone-In Chicken Thighs
recipe.description: Bone-in skin-on chicken thighs. Pat dry hard, season aggressively, bake uncovered at 425°F for about 35-40 minutes, and verify 165°F in the thickest thigh. Adults get Dan-O's Spicy + charred asparagus drizzled with Umami Lemon Heat Sauce. Kids get Dan-O's Original + plain asparagus + a small tortilla wrap on the side. The recipe is on the back of the bottle. The system is what makes it repeatable.
recipeIngredient: 8 bone-in skin-on chicken thighs (~4-5 oz each)
1-2 tbsp avocado or olive oil (just enough to coat)
Pinch of salt (Dan-O's is salted, but a small assist helps)
Dan-O's Spicy Seasoning (heavy coat — both sides)
1-2 tbsp Umami Lemon Heat Sauce (drizzle over asparagus)
Dan-O's Original Seasoning (heavy coat — both sides)
1 small flour tortilla per kid (cut in half), warmed

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat
recipeInstructions.text: Oven to 425°F. Convection if you have it.

recipeInstructions.name: Pat Dry
recipeInstructions.text: Paper towels, every thigh, both sides. Press hard. This is the most important step.

recipeInstructions.name: Oil
recipeInstructions.text: Drizzle oil, rub it in. Tiny pinch of salt on each thigh.

recipeInstructions.name: Asparagus Prep
recipeInstructions.text: Snap off woody ends. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper. Single layer on a sheet pan.

recipeInstructions.name: Season
recipeInstructions.text: Coat both sides of the adult thighs HEAVY with Dan-O's Spicy. You should barely see the chicken.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Skin-side up on the adult tray. 425°F, 35-40 min. Don't flip, don't open the oven before 30.

recipeInstructions.name: Asparagus
recipeInstructions.text: Roast the same time, same oven. 12-15 min until tender + slightly charred. Pull when thighs are at 30 min mark.

recipeInstructions.name: Make The Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: 3 minutes — mayo + lemon + soy + Dijon + chili oil. Whisk smooth, rest 5 min. (See Umami Lemon Heat Sauce in Cookbook.)

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: 2 thighs over charred asparagus, drizzle Umami Lemon Heat over the asparagus. Crack of pepper. Done.

recipe.keywords: chicken, thighs, bone-in, oven-baked, split-cook, low-effort, weeknight, no-marinade, worth-every-penny

recipe.name: Split Plate Emergency Kebab Night
recipe.description: Three frozen products + one fresh element. Air fryer the kebabs for char (5 min finish AFTER the heat-through step), microwave the rumali roti, slice the red onion + cucumber, splash green chutney. Adult plate: chicken kebab wrapped in rumali + onion-chutney salad. Kid divided tray: beef kebab + plain rumali + cucumber sticks. This is the formula — Tier 2 protein + Tier 3 carb + Tier 4 freshness — applied in 20 minutes.
recipeIngredient: 1 box Colonel Kababz Chicken Seekh Kabab (8 large, 11 oz frozen) [adult]
1 box Colonel Kababz Beef Seekh Kabab (8 large, 11 oz frozen) [kid]
1 pack Vadilal Quick Treat Rumali Roti (6 pieces, 240g frozen) — OR substitute Haldiram's Minute Khana Phulka Roti
Store-bought green chutney (cilantro-mint based) — any brand
2-3 tbsp green chutney (drizzle on salad + dip)
(Optional) tiny ramekin of green chutney as a dip if they ask

recipeInstructions.name: Air Fry Kebabs
recipeInstructions.text: Both boxes (chicken + beef) into the air fryer together, 400°F for 12 min total. Shake basket at 6 min. THE LAST 5 MIN gets you the char that matters — don't pull early.

recipeInstructions.name: Slice Onion + Salt
recipeInstructions.text: Paper-thin half-moons of red onion. Sprinkle a pinch of salt. Let sit 5 min — salt mellows the raw bite. (This is the Tier 4 move that punches above its weight.)
CUCUMBER STICKS (kid) + CUCUMBER SLICES (adult): Slice cucumber into sticks for the kid tray. Thin half-moons for the adult salad.

recipeInstructions.name: Warm Rumali
recipeInstructions.text: Wrap in damp paper towel. Microwave 30 sec total. Don't over-warm or it dries out.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Salad
recipeInstructions.text: Combine salted red onion + cucumber slices + 1 tbsp green chutney + tiny pinch more salt. Toss. This is the freshness anchor — without it, the plate is one-dimensional.

recipeInstructions.name: Wrap One Kebab
recipeInstructions.text: Take one chicken seekh, place it on a warm rumali, fold the rumali around it. THIS is the plate-interaction move that elevates the visual.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Wrapped kebab + 1-2 unwrapped chicken seekh on the side + folded rumali underneath + small ramekin of onion-cucumber-chutney salad. Optional: lime wedge.

recipe.keywords: kebab, seekh, indian, frozen, emergency-dinner, 20-min, air-fryer, no-cook, split-cook, rumali, halal

recipe.name: Fire-Grilled Chicken Thighs + Frozen Veggies
recipe.description: 460 cal / 45g protein per adult plate, 4 servings (2 adults + 2 kids). Adults get 2 grilled boneless skinless chicken thighs coated in a paprika + cumin + brown sugar + cayenne rub, plus 1 serving of skillet-crisped frozen vegetables (potato + green bean blend). Kids get 1 chopped thigh, 1/2 serving veggies, a piece of bread, and a dip they like (garlic mayo / Alfredo / secret sauce). Split at the plate — same rub, same grill, forks on portion + carb + sauce. Keep frozen veggies in your freezer at all times: no chopping, no waste, real weeknight leverage.
recipeIngredient: 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs (2 per adult + 1 per kid)
1 bag frozen vegetable blend (~3 servings — Birds Eye Blue Endeavors Garlic Herb baby-potato + green-bean blend shown; sub any freezer-staple blend)
2 slices bread OR 2 dinner rolls (soft + familiar)
2 tbsp dip of choice (garlic mayo, Alfredo, Smoky Chipotle Crema, Money Mustard, or bottled — pick the one kid trusts)

recipeInstructions.name: Mix Rub
recipeInstructions.text: Combine paprika + garlic powder + onion powder + oregano + cumin + salt + brown sugar + cayenne in a small bowl. Makes ~3 tbsp = enough for 6 thighs.

recipeInstructions.name: Season Thighs
recipeInstructions.text: Pat 6 thighs dry with paper towel. Light spray of avocado oil. Sprinkle rub over both sides + edges. Rub in with gloved hands.

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat Grill
recipeInstructions.text: Full-flame preheat 5-10 min until grates hit 500°F+. Oil the grates lightly with spray.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Veggies
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat a skillet with 1 tbsp oil on medium-high 2 min. Dump the frozen blend in — no thawing. 6-8 min until hot + lightly browned. Season lightly if the blend is plain.

recipeInstructions.name: Grill Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Thighs onto the hot grill. 5-6 min per side, one flip. Chase char lines — visible dark grill marks + juices sizzling on the top surface.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest + Slice
recipeInstructions.text: Off the grill onto a cutting board, tent loosely with foil 3-5 min. Then slice against the grain into strips.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Plate
recipeInstructions.text: 2 sliced thighs + 1 serving frozen veggies. Bare — the rub + char is the flavor. Optional squeeze of lemon if you have one.

recipe.keywords: chicken, thighs, grill, frozen-veggies, split-cook, weeknight, high-protein, kid-approved, freezer-staple, medium-carb

recipe.name: Freezer Backup Chicken Mole Tacos
recipe.description: This package documents one adult four-taco base: Mission white corn street-taco tortillas, Trader Joe's Chicken Mole and 28.5g Wholly Guacamole Mild, finished with pickled red onions to taste. The creator's log rounds to about 450 calories and 30g protein before the unweighed onions. The footage shows other family portions and presentations, but their quantities and macros are not specified here.
recipeIngredient: 4 Mission Street Tacos white corn tortillas
Pickled red onions, to taste (not weighed; excluded from the macro log)

recipeInstructions.name: Heat The Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Heat 186.2g chicken mole following the directions on its package. Do not use the creator-reported 15-minute timing as a substitute for the package's heating instructions.

recipeInstructions.name: Warm The Tortillas
recipeInstructions.text: Warm four small white corn tortillas following the package directions, keeping them covered so they stay pliable.

recipeInstructions.name: Assemble Four Tacos
recipeInstructions.text: Spread 28.5g guacamole across the tortillas, divide the hot chicken evenly among them, and finish with pickled red onions to taste. Serve fresh.

recipe.keywords: chicken, mole, tacos, freezer-backup, weeknight, family-dinner, assembly

recipe.name: Freezer Shortcut Beef Kebab Pitas
recipe.description: ~400 cal / 30g protein per adult plate, 4 servings (2 adults + 2 kids). Adults get a loaded pita: quick tzatziki (0% Greek yogurt + drained shredded cucumber + frozen garlic + lemon), shredded iceberg, halved cherry tomatoes, pickled red onion, 2 fully-cooked Mediterranean beef kebabs air-fried 7-8 min, Shuug Original Harissa. Kids get a tray with pita wedges, salad, ~2 tbsp hummus, and 1 kebab to start (offer more per appetite — the photographed 7-year-old asked for a second). Frozen garlic is the no-waste shortcut. Kid macros intentionally not published — hummus quantity + kid appetite vary. HALAL / SOY-FREE / NUT-FREE label claims require verifying the specific kebab / hummus / pita packages before publishing.
recipeIngredient: 6 fully cooked Mediterranean beef kebabs (keep 2 more available for hungry kids — 8 total from a 24 oz Costco pack)
1 small 5.3 oz / 150g container plain 0% Greek yogurt
1/2 cucumber, shredded and squeezed VERY dry
Avocado oil spray (kebab air-fry + pita warm)
Shuug Original Harissa Hot Sauce, to taste
~2 tbsp prepared hummus per kid (sub tzatziki if the kid likes it; adult tray works either way)

recipeInstructions.name: Thaw
recipeInstructions.text: Thaw the sealed kebab pouch overnight in the fridge (do this the night before — day-of shortcut works for the tzatziki and assembly, not for the frozen protein).

recipeInstructions.name: Tzatziki — Yogurt
recipeInstructions.text: Empty the 5.3 oz Greek yogurt container into a bowl.

recipeInstructions.name: Tzatziki — Cucumber
recipeInstructions.text: Shred 1/2 cucumber, salt lightly, wait 5 min, then wring VERY dry in a clean tea towel. Add to the yogurt.

recipeInstructions.name: Tzatziki — Lemon + Garlic
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 tbsp lemon juice + 3-4 frozen garlic cubes (thawed) + salt to taste.

recipeInstructions.name: Tzatziki — Mix
recipeInstructions.text: Stir until thick and evenly combined. Refrigerate until plating.

recipeInstructions.name: Air Fry The Kebabs
recipeInstructions.text: Lightly mist the (thawed) kebabs with avocado oil and air fry 7-8 min per the CURRENT PACKAGE TEMPERATURE (physical package = source of truth; brands vary). Kebabs should be thoroughly hot with a light char at 8 min.

recipeInstructions.name: Warm The Pitas
recipeInstructions.text: Lightly mist and warm the pitas 20-30 sec per side (dry pan or air fryer). Cut 2 pitas into wedges for the kids' trays.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Adult Pita
recipeInstructions.text: Warm pita → generous smear of tzatziki → shredded iceberg → halved cherry tomatoes → pickled red onion → 2 air-fried beef kebabs → drizzle of Shuug to taste. Half-fold and eat immediately.

recipe.keywords: beef, kebab, pita, mediterranean, weeknight, split-plate, air-fryer, freezer-shortcut, family-dinner, kid-approved, assembly, 20-min

recipe.name: French Dip Polenta Dunkers
recipe.description: Episode 3 of Can I Make a Recipe Go Viral? — Tushar's original French dip, rebuilt on crisp polenta instead of bread. Slice a chilled tube of prepared polenta into 12 rounds, oil and pepper them, and oven-crisp at 475°F. Warm a package of pre-cooked au jus beef, save the juices, and build a dipping jus with an au jus packet and a bone-broth packet. Cap six crisp rounds with provolone and beef, bake to melt, then top with the remaining rounds. Serve two dunkers, 2/3 cup citrus-seasoned green beans, and a ramekin of jus per plate. Keep the jus on the side so the polenta stays crisp. About 450 cal / 40g protein per plate — a sodium-forward build from the packaged beef, packets, cheese, and seasoning, so taste before adding any salt.
recipeIngredient: 1 (18 oz) tube Ancient Harvest prepared traditional polenta, chilled
Avocado-oil spray or up to 2 tsp avocado oil
1 (15 oz) package Hormel Square Table Slow Simmered Beef Roast Au Jus
2 cups cooked green beans, divided into three 2/3-cup servings

recipeInstructions.name: Slice The Polenta
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 475°F. Pat the chilled polenta dry and slice it into 12 even rounds.

recipeInstructions.name: Oil + Season
recipeInstructions.text: Lightly coat both sides of the rounds with avocado oil and season with the black pepper. Arrange on a sheet pan and bake for 15 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Flip + Crisp
recipeInstructions.text: Flip every round and bake for 10 minutes more, until the surfaces and edges are structurally crisp.

recipeInstructions.name: Beef + Juices
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the Hormel beef per its package. Drain it over a bowl, save all the juices, and separate the beef into bite-size strands.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Jus
recipeInstructions.text: Combine the reserved juices with 2 cups water, the au jus packet, and the bone-broth packet. Heat until fully dissolved and steaming.

recipeInstructions.name: Assemble + Melt
recipeInstructions.text: Top six crisp rounds with one provolone slice each and divide the drained beef among them. Bake open-faced for 5 minutes, then cap with the remaining six rounds.

recipeInstructions.name: Beans + Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Cook the green beans until tender and season with the citrus blend. Serve two dunkers, 2/3 cup green beans, and a ramekin of jus per plate — keep the jus outside the dunkers so the polenta stays crisp.

recipe.keywords: french-dip, polenta, beef, au-jus, provolone, viral, high-protein, oven, dunkers

recipe.name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Drumsticks + Chipotle Corn
recipe.description: 350 cal / 30g protein per adult plate, 4 servings (2 adults at 2 drumsticks + 1 full ear corn; 2 kids at 1 drumstick + 1/2 ear corn + cucumber). 6 chicken drumsticks dry-rubbed with Dan-O's Cheesoning + baking powder + garlic powder + salt + paprika. 3 ears shucked corn roasted on the same wire-rack-over-sheet-pan setup. 425°F for ~40 min until drumsticks hit 175°F+ for tenderness and the skin is crisp-brown. Adult plate: 2 drumsticks + 1 full ear corn + 1 tbsp Smoky Chipotle Crema drizzle on the corn. Kid plate: 1 drumstick + 1/2 ear corn + cucumber sticks + 1/2 tbsp Chosen Foods mayo on the side.
recipeIngredient: 1 tbsp Smoky Chipotle Crema per adult (drizzled over the corn)
1/2 tbsp Chosen Foods Classic Mayo per kid (on the side, not on the chicken)
Cucumber sticks (1/2 small cucumber per kid, sliced into spears)

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat + Rack
recipeInstructions.text: Oven to 425°F. Set a wire rack over a rimmed sheet pan.

recipeInstructions.name: Pat + Rub
recipeInstructions.text: Pat all 6 drumsticks dry with paper towels — get the skin as dry as possible. In a small bowl mix the baking powder + garlic powder + salt + paprika + Dan-O's Cheesoning. Sprinkle the rub from a few inches up over the drumsticks, then pat it into the skin on all sides. Use your hands.

recipeInstructions.name: Rack The Pan
recipeInstructions.text: Place drumsticks on the wire rack 1 inch apart. Tuck the 3 ears of shucked corn alongside on the same rack. Don't crowd — every piece needs airflow.

recipeInstructions.name: Roast 425°f · 40 Min — no Flipping
recipeInstructions.text: Slide the pan into the middle rack. Don't open the oven for 35 minutes. At 35 min, probe the thickest drumstick at the bone — target 175°F+ for fall-off-bone tenderness (not 165°F). If under, give it 5 more minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Plate
recipeInstructions.text: White plate. 2 drumsticks + 1 full ear of corn. Drizzle 1 tbsp Smoky Chipotle Crema over the corn (NOT on the chicken — the parm rub is already loud).

recipeInstructions.name: Eat While Hot
recipeInstructions.text: Drumsticks are crispy at 5 min off the oven, chewy at 15 min. Don't let the plate sit. The chipotle crema is room-temp — pour cold straight from the squeeze bottle.

recipe.keywords: chicken, drumsticks, sheet-pan, split-cook, weeknight, high-protein, garlic-parm, corn, gluten-free, kid-friendly

recipe.name: Golden Garlic Rice Bowl with Steak
recipe.description: ONE cook, EIGHT bowls, TWO family dinners. Golden turmeric-garlic rice built on bone broth + 3 tbsp ghee + frozen garlic cubes + frozen baby onions (no-waste shortcut). Thin-sliced sirloin seared from frozen in a hot skillet, broken into ribbons, then portioned — 6 oz per adult bowl / 3 oz per kid bowl. Adults get 2 tsp Tari Aji Amarillo (aji amarillo heat, adult-only — the label carries egg / soy / mustard). Kids get 2 tsp toum (mild garlic sauce, Mezete Toum currently vegan + gluten-free per the official page — verify the physical label). Sauce ONLY on the dinner being eaten now; second dinner refrigerates sauce-free and reheats first. ~520 cal / 45g protein per adult bowl (creator-approved rounded estimate; recheck packaged-product labels for label-verified macros). Kid macros not displayed — appetite + swap flexibility vary per kid. No garnish in the updated version.
recipeIngredient: 2 cups dry basmati rice, rinsed until water runs clear
~30g frozen garlic cubes (~1/2 pack Deep Quick Cubes)
~60g frozen baby onions (~1/2 pack Vadilal Red Baby Onions)
1.5 tsp salt (plus steak salt if needed)
36 oz frozen thin-sliced sirloin — six 6 oz pucks (filmed as a bulk 6-puck box)
2 tsp Tari Aji Amarillo Hot Sauce
(Tari carries egg / soy / mustard per current label — adult-only, verify label before publishing allergen-cleared claims)
2 tsp prepared toum (Mezete Toum, currently vegan + gluten-free per the official page; verify the physical label)
(Kid macros not displayed — appetite + swap flexibility vary meaningfully per kid)

recipeInstructions.name: Pulse Aromatics
recipeInstructions.text: Pulse ~30g frozen garlic cubes + ~60g frozen baby onions in a food processor 5-7 times until finely chopped but NOT pureed.

recipeInstructions.name: Sauté in Ghee
recipeInstructions.text: Melt 3 tbsp Kirkland ghee in a large pot over medium heat. Add the pulsed aromatics, cook until soft and fragrant (~2-3 min).

recipeInstructions.name: Add Broth
recipeInstructions.text: Pour in 4 cups chicken bone broth.

recipeInstructions.name: Bloom Turmeric + Season
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1.5 tsp turmeric + 1.5 tsp salt. Stir until evenly golden — this is the golden-rice color moment.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Rinsed Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Stir in 2 cups rinsed basmati and bring to a boil.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Reduce to low, cover, cook ~15 min (or per the rice package). Rest covered 5 min after cook, then fluff.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion 8 Equal Rice Servings
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the cooked rice evenly across 8 shallow containers — ~3/4 cup cooked rice per container. Same portion for adults + kids (the kid-request insight from the updated version).

recipeInstructions.name: Sear Steak Pucks
recipeInstructions.text: Heat an uncrowded skillet very hot. Sear the frozen sirloin pucks — let each side brown before breaking the meat into ribbons. 5-6 min per batch, uncrowded. Salt to taste.

recipeInstructions.name: Break Apart
recipeInstructions.text: Once both sides brown, break each puck into thin ribbons in the pan. Pull as soon as fully cooked — don't over-sear.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion Steak
recipeInstructions.text: 1 puck (6 oz) per adult bowl. 2 pucks split across the 4 kid bowls (~3 oz each). Place steak on top of rice in each container.

recipeInstructions.name: Sauce at Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Drizzle 2 tsp Tari over the hot adult bowl right before eating. Never fold into rice storage — Tari waters out overnight.

recipe.keywords: rice, steak, bowl, turmeric, garlic, split-cook, meal-prep, make-once-eat-twice, family-batch, tari, toum

recipe.name: Hailey-Inspired Chicken Meatballs
recipe.description: Inspired by Hailey Bieber's Instagram Stories dinner, this is The Split Plate's measured chicken-meatball version. The batch makes 20 meatballs. The saved nutrition tracker divides the complete plated batch into 6.67 servings; one tracked plate is about three meatballs with a proportional share of marinara, sourdough, cottage cheese, Parmesan, and oil. That plate is approximately 429 calories and 41g protein.
recipeIngredient: 220g Nancy's low-fat cottage cheese, blended smooth
28g Real Cereal organic corn flakes, finely crushed
Seasonings to taste (exact quantities were not recorded)
2 tbsp (27g) olive oil, divided between cooking and bread
27.5g additional Nancy's low-fat cottage cheese, to finish

recipeInstructions.name: Prep The Binder
recipeInstructions.text: Blend the 220g cottage cheese until smooth and crush the corn flakes into fine crumbs.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix Gently
recipeInstructions.text: Combine the ground chicken, blended cottage cheese, eggs, corn-flake crumbs, and seasonings. Mix just until combined; the exact seasoning quantities were not recorded.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion
recipeInstructions.text: Shape the mixture into 20 equal meatballs.

recipeInstructions.name: Brown
recipeInstructions.text: Heat some of the measured olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Brown the meatballs, turning carefully; work in batches if needed.

recipeInstructions.name: Simmer to Safe Temperature
recipeInstructions.text: Add the marinara and bring to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook until the center of each meatball reaches 165°F (74°C). Use a thermometer; an exact cooking time was not saved.

recipeInstructions.name: Toast The Bread
recipeInstructions.text: Cut the sourdough into serving pieces, brush with the remaining measured oil, and toast until crisp.

recipeInstructions.name: Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Plate the meatballs and sauce with toasted sourdough. Divide the finishing cottage cheese and Parmesan across the plates.

recipe.keywords: chicken, meatballs, cottage-cheese, marinara, sourdough, high-protein, family-dinner

recipe.name: Herb-Garlic Pork Chops + Cowboy Butter Drizzle
recipe.description: 4 boneless 6-oz pork loin chops marinated in olive oil + 8 garlic cloves + 2 tbsp soy + 1 tbsp Worcestershire + 1 tbsp Dijon + 1.5 tbsp fresh rosemary + 1.5 tbsp fresh thyme + smoked paprika + chili flakes + lemon. Pan-seared medium-high until deeply colored. Side: snap peas tossed with food-processed Kirkland Parmigiano Stravecchio + crushed Corn Chex (2 tbsp parm + 4 tbsp chex), roasted 18 min. Sauce: Cowboy Butter (Laughing Cow + bone broth + Parm + garlic + lemon + Dijon + Worcestershire + paprika + a pat of butter) — adults get parsley + chives + chili flakes folded in; kids get the plain cream base in their dip well. Adults eat the chop sliced over the peas with sauce drizzled in cross-hatches; kids eat diced pork + peas + sauce on the side.
recipeIngredient: 4 boneless pork loin chops, 1-inch thick (~6 oz each = 24 oz total)
2 cups fresh sugar snap peas, trimmed
2 tbsp food-processed Kirkland Parmigiano Stravecchio (from a wedge)
4 tbsp crushed Corn Chex (pulse in food processor)
Plain Cowboy Butter (1/3 of the batch, set aside BEFORE folding in herbs)

recipeInstructions.name: Pat + Dry (if Time)
recipeInstructions.text: Chops on a rack in the fridge uncovered for 1-2 hr. Surface dry = real sear.

recipeInstructions.name: Marinate
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk all marinade ingredients in a large bowl. Add chops, flip to coat. 30 min min, 2 hr ideal.

recipeInstructions.name: Prep The Crust
recipeInstructions.text: Food-process 2 oz Kirkland Parmigiano Stravecchio into coarse grated. Pulse 4 tbsp Corn Chex in the same processor into coarse crumbs.
PREHEAT OVEN 425°F. Toss snap peas with oil spray + Parm + crushed Chex + salt in a bowl, then spread on parchment-lined sheet pan.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake Peas
recipeInstructions.text: 18-22 min until deep golden + crispy edges.

recipeInstructions.name: Sear The Chops
recipeInstructions.text: Stainless or cast iron, medium-HIGH, 2 tsp oil. Lay chops away from you, DON'T MOVE for 4 min. Flip once. 3-4 min side 2. Pull at internal 145°F. Rest 5 min.

recipeInstructions.name: Slice The Chop
recipeInstructions.text: 1 chop per adult, sliced thin across the grain.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
