recipeInstructions.text: Sliced chop over crusted snap peas in a wide bowl. Drizzle adult Cowboy Butter (the parsley + chives + chili flakes one) cross-hatched over the top. DON'T POUR — the pattern is the visual.

recipe.keywords: pork-chops, pan-seared, cowboy-butter, low-carb, split-cook, weeknight, herb-marinade

recipe.name: High-Protein Beef & Potato Slop Bowl
recipe.description: A viral beef-and-potato bowl adapted for split-plate. Roast 24 oz diced Yukon Gold potatoes at 450°F for 40 min (toss halfway). Brown 24 oz 93/7 lean ground beef in a wide skillet with SPG in parallel. Split at plating: each adult bowl gets 8 oz raw-weight potatoes, 8 oz raw-weight beef, one serving of the linked High-Protein Chipotle Cheddar Sauce, and crunchy Mt. Olive jalapeños (~620 cal / 62g protein). The creator serves each young child half of the adult potato and beef portions, deconstructed, with a mild melted Velveeta drizzle and cucumber or carrot sticks — no jalapeños. Cook once; finish twice.
recipeIngredient: 24 oz Yukon Gold or yellow potatoes (diced, skin on)
SPG (salt, pepper, garlic powder) or preferred seasoning
2 servings High-Protein Chipotle Cheddar Sauce (cookbook: /cookbook/high-protein-chipotle-cheddar-sauce — one-quarter batch per adult)
Mt. Olive pickled jalapeño slices, to taste
Velveeta or mild melting cheese (as needed)
Fat-free ultra-filtered milk (a splash, only if needed to loosen the cheese)

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat + Parchment
recipeInstructions.text: Heat oven to 450°F. Line a large rimmed sheet pan with parchment.

recipeInstructions.name: Dice + Season Potatoes
recipeInstructions.text: Small, even dice with skin on. Spread on the sheet pan, light avocado-oil spray, SPG.

recipeInstructions.name: Roast 40 Min
recipeInstructions.text: Toss halfway (~20 min in) and redistribute. Continue until browned outside and tender inside.

recipeInstructions.name: Brown The Beef
recipeInstructions.text: Wide skillet, hot. Add beef, season with SPG. Smash, turn, crumble until browned and cooked through.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend Adult Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Prepare one full batch of High-Protein Chipotle Cheddar Sauce per the linked cookbook entry. Uses cottage cheese + cheddar powder + nutritional yeast + fat-free ultra-filtered milk + Smoky Chipotle Crema. This dinner uses 2 of its 4 servings.

recipeInstructions.name: Build Adult Bowl
recipeInstructions.text: 8 oz raw-weight potatoes + 8 oz raw-weight beef per adult bowl. Top with one sauce serving and crunchy pickled jalapeños.

recipe.keywords: beef, potatoes, bowl, chipotle, high-protein, split-plate, family-dinner, kid-approved, weeknight, viral-adaptation

recipe.name: High-Protein Weeknight Butter Chicken
recipe.description: Coat chicken thighs in tandoori masala and air-fry until 165°F, then chop. Blend cottage cheese with chicken bone broth until smooth. Bloom ginger-garlic paste in ghee, add marinara, garam masala, cumin, and paprika, then stir in the chicken and the blended cottage cheese. Finish with kasoori methi and simmer until cohesive. Plate the kids' portions first, then stir Kashmiri chilli into what's left for the adults. Serve with phulkas or rice.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 tsp salt (adjust if the masala already contains salt)
1/8 cup avocado oil (or 1/4 cup plain Greek yogurt as the binder)
Kashmiri chilli, to taste — adult servings only

recipeInstructions.name: Coat The Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Toss the chicken thighs with the tandoori masala, salt, and avocado oil (or Greek yogurt) until evenly coated.

recipeInstructions.name: Air Fry
recipeInstructions.text: Air fry at 400°F/205°C for about 15 minutes, turning halfway, until the thickest pieces reach 165°F/74°C. Rest briefly, then chop into bite-sized pieces.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend The Creamy Base
recipeInstructions.text: Blend the cottage cheese and chicken bone broth until completely smooth — this is what replaces the cream.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Melt the ghee in a wide pan. Cook the ginger-garlic paste briefly, then stir in the marinara, garam masala, cumin, and paprika.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine + Simmer
recipeInstructions.text: Stir in the chopped chicken and the blended cottage-cheese mixture. Add the kasoori methi and simmer until cohesive and glossy.

recipeInstructions.name: Split on Heat
recipeInstructions.text: Plate the kids' portions of the same base first. Then stir Kashmiri chilli into the remaining sauce for the adults. Serve with phulkas or rice.

recipe.keywords: butter-chicken, chicken-thighs, high-protein, cottage-cheese, air-fryer, family-dinner, indian, weeknight, kid-approved

recipe.name: High-Protein Halal Cart Chicken Rice Bowls
recipe.description: 550 cal / 50g protein / 22g fat / 34g net carbs per adult bowl, 4 servings (2 adults at 8 oz chicken + 3/4 cup rice; 2 kids at 4 oz chicken + 1/2 cup rice). Trader Joe's pre-seasoned shawarma chicken thighs (1.5 lb total) griddled in halal-cart-style edges. Basmati rice (1 cup uncooked) cooked in 1.5 cups Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth + 1 tbsp ghee + turmeric + cumin + garlic/onion powder + 1 Bare Bones Instant Bone Broth Powder stick — yellow rice with built-in protein lift. Adults plate: big white plate with yellow rice, chopped griddled chicken, shredded iceberg, diced Roma tomato, Mezete toum drizzle, Shuug Original Harissa drizzle. Kids plate: sage-green compartment tray with rice in one section, chicken (with toum drizzle) in another, lettuce + tomato in a side white bowl. No harissa on kid plate. Both plate at the same time, assemble at the table.
recipeIngredient: 1.5 lb Trader Joe's Shawarma-Style Chicken Thighs (or 1.5 lb boneless skinless thighs + DIY marinade — see substitutionNotes)
1.5 cups Kirkland Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth
1 Bare Bones Instant Bone Broth Powder stick (15g, chicken)
2 tbsp Mezete Toum (drizzle over chicken + rice)
1 tbsp Shuug Original Harissa Hot Sauce (drizzle over chicken only)
1 compartment kid tray per child (4-section tray, like EZPZ Happy Mat)
1 small white bowl per child (for lettuce + tomato)
1 tbsp Mezete Toum (drizzle over chicken only, NOT the rice)

recipeInstructions.name: Mise
recipeInstructions.text: Pull Trader Joe's shawarma chicken from fridge (let sit 10 min to take chill off). Rinse 1 cup basmati under cold water until water runs mostly clear. Measure 1.5 cups Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth, 1 tbsp ghee, spices (1.5 tsp salt / 0.5 tsp garlic powder / 0.5 tsp onion powder / 0.5 tsp cumin / 1 tsp turmeric), and the Bare Bones Instant Bone Broth stick. Set out Mezete toum + Shuug harissa.

recipeInstructions.name: Start The Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Rinsed basmati + 1.5 cups bone broth + ghee + Bare Bones powder + all the spices into a pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then drop to LOWEST heat, cover with a tight lid, simmer undisturbed 15 min. NO peeking — the steam is what cooks the rice.

recipeInstructions.name: Griddle The Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Griddle or large skillet over medium-high heat. Cooking spray. Chicken thighs in a single layer. 3-4 min undisturbed for the contact-sear, then flip. 2-3 min on second side. Chop into the pan with a spatula at the 5-min mark — halal-cart edges form on the chopped sides. Cook to 165°F internal, ~10 min total.

recipeInstructions.name: Prep The Cold Side
recipeInstructions.text: Dice 2 Roma tomatoes ~1/4-inch. Shred 1/2 head iceberg thin. Pinch of salt on the tomatoes only. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Rice Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Off heat at the 15-min mark. Let rest covered 10 min (this is non-negotiable — rest is when the steam finishes setting the grains). Fluff with a fork. Should be loose, separate, yellow, fragrant.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Plate
recipeInstructions.text: ~3/4 cup yellow rice mounded on one side of the plate. ~8 oz chopped halal-cart chicken next to it. Shredded iceberg + diced Roma alongside or on top. Mezete toum drizzle over the chicken AND rice (~2 tbsp). Shuug Original Harissa drizzle over the chicken only (~1 tbsp).

recipeInstructions.name: Eat Immediately
recipeInstructions.text: The contrast is the point — warm rice + crispy chopped chicken edges + cold lettuce + tomato + creamy toum + smoky harissa. Don't let it sit.

recipe.keywords: chicken, rice-bowl, halal-style, shawarma, split-cook, weeknight, high-protein, halal-cart, gluten-free, middle-eastern

recipe.name: High-Protein Pepperoni Mac Meal Prep
recipe.description: Cook 3 boxes of Annie's Super Mac shells and drain. Whisk all three cheese packets into 1 cup of whole milk, fold in the shells, then chop and fold in 4 servings of turkey pepperoni. Divide into 4 full servings and 4 slightly smaller servings for two family dinners. No butter and no separate kid meal — the same creamy pepperoni mac for everyone, portioned to appetite.
recipeIngredient: 3 boxes Annie's Super Mac Shells & White Cheddar (higher-protein line)
1 cup Nurri whole milk (or regular whole milk)
Light avocado-oil spray, optional — only if your pot needs it

recipeInstructions.name: Cook The Shells
recipeInstructions.text: Cook and drain the shells from all 3 boxes according to the package directions. Reserve the cheese packets.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Cheese Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk all three cheese packets into 1 cup whole milk until smooth. No butter — the milk and cheese powder carry the sauce.

recipeInstructions.name: Fold in The Shells
recipeInstructions.text: Fold the drained shells into the cheese sauce until every shell is coated and creamy.

recipeInstructions.name: Chop + Fold The Pepperoni
recipeInstructions.text: Chop 4 servings of turkey pepperoni and fold it through the mac and cheese so it's evenly distributed.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion Eight Servings
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the batch into 4 full servings and 4 slightly smaller servings — enough for two family dinners across two days. Size the smaller servings to your kids' appetites.

recipe.keywords: turkey-pepperoni, mac-and-cheese, boxed-mac, meal-prep, high-protein, family-dinner, one-pot, kid-approved, batch-cook

recipe.name: High-Protein Philly Cheesesteak Sliders
recipe.description: 470 cal / 40g protein per adult plate (3 Sola sliders), 4 servings (2 adults + 2 kids). Adults get Sola rolls (60 cal / high fiber) + smoky chipotle crema + Sargento thin provolone + fat-free mozzarella + Tari hot sauce. Kids get regular slider rolls + regular mayo + provolone + Primal Kitchen secret sauce. The filling is shared: 24 oz Gary's QuickSteak beef with the included Creole seasoning + 12 oz peppers/onions with taco seasoning + 1/3 cup bone broth to bring it together. Split at bread + cheese + sauce — same tray, two bakes.
recipeIngredient: 6 pucks / 24 oz Gary's QuickSteak beef (included Creole seasoning packet)
6 Sola rolls (~60 cal each / high fiber) — 3 per adult
1/2 serving per adult Smoky Chipotle Crema (cross-recipe — /cookbook/smoky-chipotle-crema)
1/2 serving Tari hot sauce (or any creamy hot sauce; Smoky Chipotle Crema doubles here)
6 slices Sargento thin provolone (kid side, top layer)
1/2 serving per kid Primal Kitchen secret sauce (or any kid-trusted bottled slider sauce)

recipeInstructions.name: Brown The Beef
recipeInstructions.text: HOT pan on medium-high. Drop 6 Gary's QuickSteak pucks in from frozen. 3-4 min per side. Sprinkle the included Creole seasoning as they soften.

recipeInstructions.name: Chop as it Cooks
recipeInstructions.text: Break the pucks into thin cheesesteak strips with the spatula while they brown. Set the fully-browned beef aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Peppers + Onions
recipeInstructions.text: Same pan, leftover beef fat. Add 12 oz peppers/onions + taco seasoning to taste. 5-6 min until softened + starting to brown.

recipeInstructions.name: Bone Broth Deglaze
recipeInstructions.text: 1/3 cup bone broth into the pan. Let it reduce ~2 min — light sauce, not soup.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine Filling
recipeInstructions.text: Return the beef to the pan. Stir with peppers/onions + bone-broth reduction. This is the shared filling.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Tray
recipeInstructions.text: Sola rolls on the adult side, regular slider rolls on the kid side. Bottom halves down.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Bottom
recipeInstructions.text: Spread Smoky Chipotle Crema across the 6 Sola roll bottoms.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Provolone
recipeInstructions.text: Layer 6 slices thin provolone across the adult Sola bottoms.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Filling + Mozz
recipeInstructions.text: Pile the beef/pepper/onion filling on the adult side. Top with 3 oz fat-free mozzarella.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Top Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Drizzle Tari hot sauce (or extra chipotle crema) across the adult filling. Cap with the Sola roll tops.

recipe.keywords: beef, sliders, cheesesteak, split-cook, weeknight, high-protein, kid-approved, one-pan, sheet-pan, medium-carb

recipe.name: High-Protein Taco Bowls
recipe.description: Estimated 500 cal / 61g protein / 17g fat / 7g net carbs per adult bowl. 2 lb raw 93/7 beef = 6 adult-equivalent servings (creator uses 4 adult + 4 half-size kid portions across two family dinners). Beef seasoned with Dan-O's TAC-O + salt, browned, divided evenly among 6 meal-prep containers. Moisture hack: 1 tbsp Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth per container so the beef stays moist through reheating. Cheese split by container: 1 oz Kraft Fat-Free Cheddar per adult container; ~1.5 Velveeta slices per shared kid container (split between two kids). Cold produce prepped separately: chopped romaine hearts + halved yellow cherry tomatoes. Adults plate: Quest Loaded Taco chips base in a wide bowl, reheated cheesy beef over the chips, romaine + yellow tomatoes, 1/2 Wholly Guacamole mini, Siete Habanero Botana Sauce to taste. Kids plate: compartment tray with regular tortilla chips, kid beef + Velveeta, 1 full Wholly mini, deconstructed veg on the side.
recipeIngredient: 1/3 cup Kirkland Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth
4 Wholly Guacamole Classic Minis (1 per plate)
2 bags Quest Loaded Taco Tortilla-Style Protein Chips (1 per adult bowl, 1.1 oz each)
2 oz Kraft Fat-Free Shredded Cheddar (1 oz per plate)
Simply Tostitos Organic Yellow Corn Tortilla Chips (~1 oz per kid)
1 oz Tillamook Medium Cheddar (0.5 oz per plate)
1 compartment kid tray per child (4-section tray, like EZPZ Happy Mat)
Small side bowl for lettuce + tomato

recipeInstructions.name: Mise
recipeInstructions.text: Spiceology Taco Seasoning out, 1.25 lb 93/7 beef in a stainless mixing bowl, Quest Loaded Taco chips bags out (2), Simply Tostitos Organic for kids, Kraft fat-free cheddar + Tillamook Medium cheddar shredded, 4 Wholly Guacamole minis, iceberg + Roma tomatoes ready, Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth pouch open.

recipeInstructions.name: Season Beef
recipeInstructions.text: 1.25 lb beef into the stainless mixing bowl. Add 2 tbsp Spiceology Taco Seasoning Blend + pinch of kosher salt. Mix with hands or a spatula until the seasoning is evenly distributed (1-2 min).

recipeInstructions.name: Dice + Shred
recipeInstructions.text: 2 Roma tomatoes diced ~1/4-inch. 1 head iceberg shredded thin (~3 cups). Combine in a small bowl with a pinch of salt. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Brown Beef
recipeInstructions.text: Stainless skillet over medium-high. Cooking spray. Seasoned beef in. Break up as it browns, 6-8 min until just cooked through. 93/7 is lean enough that you don't need to drain.

recipeInstructions.name: Bone Broth Braise
recipeInstructions.text: Pour 1/3 cup Kirkland Sipping Bone Broth into the beef. Reduce 60 sec on medium-high — the broth carries the seasoning back into the meat. THIS STEP IS NON-NEGOTIABLE for the cheese melt + flavor distribution.

recipeInstructions.name: Cheese Split by Zone
recipeInstructions.text: Push beef into two zones. ~70% adult-side: sprinkle 2 oz Kraft Fat-Free Shredded Cheddar. ~30% kid-side: sprinkle 1 oz Tillamook Medium Cheddar. Cover 60 sec. Cheese melts under the lid.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Bowl
recipeInstructions.text: Empty 1 bag Quest Loaded Taco chips into the bottom of a wide white bowl. Light crush with the back of a spoon (keep half-chips for texture). Spoon ~6 oz of the cheesy fat-free-cheddar beef from the adult zone over the chips.

recipeInstructions.name: Top The Adult Bowl
recipeInstructions.text: Scatter ~1 cup shredded iceberg + diced Roma tomato over the beef. Squeeze 1 Wholly Guacamole Classic Mini in the center as a dollop. Optional: hot sauce on the side (Lucky Dog, Cholula). Eat with a spoon, scoop through all layers.

recipe.keywords: beef, taco-bowl, high-protein, low-carb, split-cook, build-your-own, weeknight, fastest, pork-free, gluten-free, meal-prep

recipe.name: Indo-Chinese Chili Chicken
recipe.description: 400 cal / 35g protein per adult plate. Lightly breaded chicken chunks air-fried until crisp, then split: kid portions get cucumber, garlic bread, and yellow mustard on the side; adult portions hit a hot wok with peppers, onions, Jet Tila's Umami Punch, and a six-ingredient Indo-Chinese chili sauce. Tossed 45–75 seconds until glossy, then heat off.
recipeIngredient: 21 oz Kirkland Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Chunks (14 oz adult + 7 oz kid)
8 oz bell peppers + red onion (large pieces)
1 tbsp Spiceology Jet Tila's Umami Punch (split — 1/2 tbsp on veg, 1/2 tbsp on adult chicken)
1/2 tbsp Lao Gan Ma Fried Chili in Oil
7 oz reserved plain chicken (creator served 3.5 oz per child; adjust to appetite)
2 portions garlic bread (one per child, or adjust)

recipeInstructions.name: Air Fry
recipeInstructions.text: All 21 oz chicken at 400°F for 10-12 min (or follow the package). Shake halfway. Goal: crispy and hot through.

recipeInstructions.name: Reserve Kid Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Set aside 7 oz plain chunks (about 3.5 oz per child) BEFORE any seasoning, veg, or sauce. Everything after this point is adult-only.

recipeInstructions.name: Char Veg
recipeInstructions.text: Wok on high, light avocado spray. Cook peppers + onions 3-5 min until charred but still crisp.

recipeInstructions.name: Season Veg
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1/2 tbsp Umami Punch to the charred veg. Toss briefly.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Adult Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Add the remaining 14 oz air-fried chicken to the wok. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 tbsp Umami Punch.

recipeInstructions.name: Pour Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Pour the prepared six-ingredient sauce over the chicken + veg. No slurry.

recipeInstructions.name: Toss Until Glossy
recipeInstructions.text: Aggressive toss for 45-75 sec, just until everything is coated and shiny. Kill the heat the second it clings — do NOT simmer.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate Adults
recipeInstructions.text: 7 oz glossy chili chicken with veg per adult. Serve immediately.

recipe.keywords: chicken, indo-chinese, chili, wok, air-fryer, split-cook, glossy

recipe.name: Lomo Saltado Meal Prep
recipe.description: Lean stir-fry beef seared hard in a wok with red onion and yellow tomato, tossed in a six-ingredient sauce (soy, fish, vinegar, Tari Amarillo, ginger-garlic paste, bone-broth stick pack), then finished with green onion and crisp air-fried fries folded in right before serving. Rice cooks in bone broth. Adult bowl gets extra Tari; the creator's kid plate uses the same base with an appetite-based beef portion and either no heat or a touch of toum.
recipeIngredient: 1 stick pack Bare Bones bone-broth powder (~15g)
1/2 bunch green onions, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 cup dry rice + 2 cups bone broth
16 oz frozen fries (8 oz per four-person dinner, air-fried fresh)
Full adult-equivalent portion of beef + sauce
Fresh air-fried fries (mixed in or crisp on the side)
Extra Tari Amarillo drizzle to taste
Same bone-broth rice; optional pat of butter
Optional toum for a no-heat garlic finish

recipeInstructions.name: Cook The Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Combine 1 cup dry rice with 2 cups bone broth and cook using your normal pot method. Split across eight household portions.

recipeInstructions.name: Whisk The Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Combine soy, fish, vinegar, Tari Amarillo, ginger-garlic paste, and the bone-broth stick pack until smooth. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Trim + Season The Beef
recipeInstructions.text: Trim visible fat, pat dry, season with SPG. Lightly spray a wok or large skillet with avocado oil.

recipeInstructions.name: Hard-sear in Batches
recipeInstructions.text: Wok blazing hot. Sear the beef in 2-3 batches so it browns instead of steaming; remove to a bowl.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook The Veg
recipeInstructions.text: Add onion and tomato to the same wok. Stir-fry until the onion softens slightly and the tomato still holds shape.

recipeInstructions.name: Return Beef + Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Add the beef back, pour in the sauce, and toss over high heat until glossy. Add green onion.

recipeInstructions.name: Air-fry Fries + Fold in
recipeInstructions.text: Air-fry 8 oz frozen fries per four-person dinner. Fold into the wok immediately before serving.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate The Adult Bowl
recipeInstructions.text: Rice base, full adult-equivalent portion of the sauced beef, crisp fries either folded in or served on the side.

recipeInstructions.name: Extra Tari
recipeInstructions.text: Drizzle Tari Amarillo across the bowl to taste. This is the flavor everyone remembers.

recipe.keywords: beef, lomo-saltado, peruvian, stir-fry, meal-prep, sauce-hack, family-dinner, split-plate, wok, batch-cook

recipe.name: Meatball Parm Puff
recipe.description: Episode 2 of Can I Make a Recipe Go Viral? A puffed savory cottage-cheese-egg batter baked in a 12-inch cast-iron skillet, then topped with a full 30-meatball batch, thick marinara, mozzarella, and Parmesan, broiled until bubbly, and cut into six wedges. Adult plate: 1 wedge + 5 meatballs at ~530 cal / 52g protein estimated. The meatballs are the reusable Lean Beef Meatballs (30-piece) cookbook base — bake ahead or fresh. Kid plate: half a wedge + 2-3 meatballs, appetite-driven (not published).
recipeIngredient: 1/2 tsp garlic powder + salt + black pepper
1 tbsp avocado oil (for the hot skillet)
1 batch Lean Beef Meatballs (30 meatballs — from the cookbook base)
Optional: Calabrian chile or red pepper flakes (adult finish)

recipeInstructions.name: Bake The Meatballs
recipeInstructions.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Mix meatball ingredients gently and roll 30 balls. Bake 10-13 min until 160°F. Set aside. (Or use pre-baked from the fridge/freezer.)

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat The Skillet
recipeInstructions.text: Raise oven to 450°F and preheat a 12-inch cast-iron skillet for 10 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend The Puff
recipeInstructions.text: Blend 4 eggs + 1/2 cup egg whites + 1/2 cup cottage cheese + 1/2 cup 2% milk + 110 g flour + 1/4 cup Parm + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + salt + pepper until completely smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Puff Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 tbsp avocado oil to the hot skillet, pour in the batter, and bake 15-19 min. DO NOT open the oven for the first 14 min or the puff collapses.

recipeInstructions.name: Top + Broil
recipeInstructions.text: Top the baked puff with warmed marinara, 30 meatballs, mozzarella, and Parmesan. Broil 2-3 min until the cheese bubbles.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish + Wedge
recipeInstructions.text: Torn basil or parsley + optional Calabrian chile for adults. Cut into 6 wedges. Serve 1 wedge + 5 meatballs per adult plate; half wedges + 2-3 meatballs for kids.

recipe.keywords: beef, meatballs, marinara, cast-iron, puff, viral, family-dinner, split-plate, meal-prep

recipe.name: Mexican Rice Taco Bowls
recipe.description: Cook the rice in chicken bone broth, tomato sauce, avocado oil, Dan-O's SPG, and cumin, about 25 minutes. Brown the 93/7 beef with taco seasoning and salt. Cook the frozen fajita vegetables until soft. Divide the rice across 12 bowls — roughly 60% among six adult bowls, 40% among six kid bowls. Each adult bowl gets about 3/4 cup rice, 5 oz beef, vegetables, and 2 tbsp green sauce. The filmed kid bowl gets about 1/2 cup rice and 3 oz beef, vegetables optional. Refrigerate the extra dinners and reheat.
recipeIngredient: Taco seasoning and salt, to taste
High-Protein Cilantro Jalapeno Ranch (green sauce), 2 tbsp per adult bowl

recipeInstructions.name: Cook The Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Cook the rice with the bone broth, tomato sauce, avocado oil, Dan-O's SPG, and cumin until tender, about 25 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Brown The Beef
recipeInstructions.text: Brown the 93/7 ground beef with taco seasoning and salt to taste. With 93/7 there's little rendered fat, so no drain step is needed.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook The Vegetables
recipeInstructions.text: Cook the frozen fajita vegetable mix until soft and tender.

recipeInstructions.name: Divide The Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Divide the rice across 12 bowls — roughly 60% among six adult bowls and 40% among six kid bowls.

recipeInstructions.name: Build Adult Bowls
recipeInstructions.text: Each adult bowl gets about 3/4 cup rice, 5 oz beef, fajita vegetables, and 2 tbsp green sauce.

recipeInstructions.name: Build Kid Bowls
recipeInstructions.text: The filmed kid bowl gets about 1/2 cup rice and 3 oz beef. Vegetables are optional — build it for your table. Refrigerate the extra dinners and reheat.

recipe.keywords: taco-bowl, mexican-rice, ground-beef, high-protein, green-sauce, meal-prep, family-dinner, weeknight, kid-approved, build-your-own

recipe.name: Taco-Seasoned Air-Fryer Chicken Thighs
recipe.description: Fresh boneless chicken thighs seasoned for tacos and cooked in the air fryer. Portion 1.5 ounces of cooked chicken into each of four adult tacos. Serve each child 2 ounces of cooked chicken deconstructed with guacamole; brush the warm corn tortilla lightly with ghee when a dry tortilla would eat too firm. The recently made High-Protein Cilantro Jalapeño Ranch is an optional adult finish.
recipeIngredient: 1 1/2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, enough to yield at least 16 oz cooked
2 tbsp taco seasoning, or to taste
8 small corn tortillas for the two adult plates
2-4 additional small corn tortillas for the two kid plates, based on appetite
4 oz cooked taco-seasoned chicken total, 2 oz per child
2 individual guacamole portions, or guacamole to taste
Melted ghee for a very light tortilla brush

recipeInstructions.name: Season
recipeInstructions.text: Pat the thighs dry, coat with avocado oil, and season all over with taco seasoning.

recipeInstructions.name: Air-fry
recipeInstructions.text: Arrange in one layer. Air-fry at 390°F for about 14-18 minutes, turning once, until the thickest piece reaches at least 165°F. Appliance and thigh thickness change the timing.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest + Chop
recipeInstructions.text: Rest 5 minutes, then chop into bite-size pieces. Weigh the cooked chicken before building plates.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Onion-cilantro
recipeInstructions.text: Mix the diced onion, cilantro, lime, and salt. Rest 5 minutes to soften the raw-onion edge.

recipeInstructions.name: Assemble
recipeInstructions.text: Warm four tortillas per adult. Add 1.5 oz cooked chicken to each, then cilantro-onion and the optional green sauce.

recipe.keywords: tacos, chicken-thighs, air-fryer, weeknight, kid-friendly, deconstructed, split-cook

recipe.name: Outlaw BBQ Grilled Thighs + Smashed Potatoes
recipe.description: ~47g protein for ~540 calories. Boneless skinless thighs marinated in Dan-O's Outlaw Sweet & Tangy + chili crisp + light oil, grilled over medium-high until the edges char (not burn), then sliced for adults and diced for kids. Smashed potatoes from a Little Potato Co. tray — microwave 5 min, smash with jagged edges (NOT puréed), bake until deeply browned. Chili crisp sour cream sauce on the side for adults; plain Daisy Light for kids. Outdoor grill is ideal; cast iron grill pan or oven broiler with grill marks works.
recipeIngredient: 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (~2 lbs / 32 oz)
2-3 tbsp Dan-O's Outlaw Sweet & Tangy BBQ seasoning
2 tbsp Lee Kum Kee Chiu Chow Style Chili Crisp Oil
1 tray (1 lb) Little Potato Co. A Little Savory Herb (with seasoning packet)
2-3 tbsp Lee Kum Kee Chiu Chow Style Chili Crisp Oil
2 tbsp plain Daisy Light Sour Cream (no chili crisp)

recipeInstructions.name: Marinate The Thighs
recipeInstructions.text: Combine Dan-O's Outlaw + Lee Kum Kee Chili Crisp + light oil in a large bowl. Add chicken, toss to coat thoroughly. The color should be deeply orange-red. Refrigerate 30 min minimum, overnight ideal.

recipeInstructions.name: Microwave The Potatoes
recipeInstructions.text: Pierce the tray's vent (it's pre-vented). Microwave on high 5 min. The tray steams them through — no boiling required.

recipeInstructions.name: Smash + Season
recipeInstructions.text: Transfer potatoes to a parchment-lined sheet pan. Press each one ONCE with the base of a glass — leave jagged edges, do NOT purée. Spray with oil, sprinkle the seasoning packet (start with half, add more after baking if needed). Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat
recipeInstructions.text: Grill to medium-high (~450°F). Oven to 425°F.

recipeInstructions.name: Grill The Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Lay thighs out on the grates with space between. Close lid. 4-5 min per side, flip ONCE, char marks should be clear and dark. Internal temp 165°F when done.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake The Potatoes
recipeInstructions.text: Pop the sheet pan in at 425°F for 20-25 min, until deeply browned and crispy at the edges. The fluffy interior + crispy exterior contrast is the goal.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest The Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Off the grill onto a cutting board. Rest 3-5 min so the juices redistribute. Slicing immediately = pale interior with juices on the board, not in the meat.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Spoon Daisy Light Sour Cream into a small bowl. Add 2-3 tbsp Lee Kum Kee Chiu Chow Chili Crisp on top. Fold gently 3-4 times — STOP when you can still see orange streaks. Don't homogenize.

recipeInstructions.name: Slice The Thighs
recipeInstructions.text: 2 thighs per adult, cut across the grain into 1/2-inch slices. Lay over the smashed potatoes in a wide bowl. The grill marks should be visible.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Wide bowl. Sliced thigh + crispy smashed potatoes. Chili crisp sour cream on the side OR drizzled with the orange streaks visible. DON'T dump and mix.

recipe.keywords: grill, outdoor, chicken, potatoes, tamarind, chili crisp, sauce-anchored, split-cook, weeknight

recipe.name: Peruvian-Style Chicken Thighs with Roasted Corn
recipe.description: Marinate boneless, skinless chicken thighs in the Golden Umami Stir-Fry Sauce, then grill with corn on the upper rack until the thighs reach 165°F and the corn is browned. Plate two thighs, an ear of corn, and 2 tbsp of the High-Protein Cilantro Jalapeno Ranch for each adult. For the kids, chop one thigh bite-size and serve with corn and a familiar mild sauce or Alfredo. Refrigerate the second dinner and reheat to 165°F.
recipeIngredient: 12 boneless, skinless chicken thighs (about 4 oz raw each; ~3 lb total)
2 tbsp High-Protein Cilantro Jalapeno Ranch per adult plate (Powerup)
Familiar mild Mezzetta sauce or Alfredo, to taste — kid finish

recipeInstructions.name: Marinate
recipeInstructions.text: Add the chicken thighs and 2 servings of Golden Umami Stir-Fry Sauce to a zip-top bag (or jar). Seal and massage until evenly coated, then marinate refrigerated.

recipeInstructions.name: Heat The Grill
recipeInstructions.text: Arrange the corn on the upper rack and the marinated chicken on the main grates.

recipeInstructions.name: Grill + Baste
recipeInstructions.text: Turning and basting as needed, grill until the corn is browned and the thickest part of every thigh reaches 165°F/74°C.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Plates
recipeInstructions.text: Serve two thighs, one ear of corn, and 2 tbsp of the green sauce per adult plate.

recipeInstructions.name: Kid Plates
recipeInstructions.text: Chop one thigh into bite-sized pieces and serve with corn plus a familiar mild sauce or Alfredo.

recipeInstructions.name: Second Dinner
recipeInstructions.text: Refrigerate the second-dinner portions promptly and reheat to 165°F/74°C.

recipe.keywords: peruvian-style, grilled-chicken, chicken-thighs, roasted-corn, high-protein, green-sauce, grill, family-dinner, meal-prep, kid-approved

recipe.name: Pizza + Leftover Meatballs Dinner
recipe.description: The two-container weeknight assembly that turns pizza + leftover meatballs into a protein-dense family dinner. Bake pizza per its package, reheat leftover Lean Beef Meatballs covered in marinara, and portion by appetite. Adult plate: half a Yough! Mozzarella Cheese Pizza (330 cal / 20g protein per label) + 5 meatballs (285 cal / 34g protein) + 1/4 cup marinara (~50 cal / 1g protein) ≈ 665 cal / 55g protein estimated. Kid plate: Costco single-serve pizza + 2-3 leftover meatballs with marinara — the creator's tested build. This recipe only works if you already have the Lean Beef Meatballs (30-piece cookbook base) in the fridge or freezer.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 Yough! Mozzarella Cheese Pizza (or any thin frozen mozzarella pizza)
5 Lean Beef Meatballs (from the 30-piece cookbook base)
2-3 Lean Beef Meatballs, warmed in marinara
Small side of marinara for dipping

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat + Cook Pizzas
recipeInstructions.text: Bake the Yough! (or your frozen mozzarella pizza) per the package directions. Costco single-serve pizzas can go in the same oven side-by-side if timing matches.

recipeInstructions.name: Reheat Meatballs in Marinara
recipeInstructions.text: In a covered saucepan on the stovetop, warm 10 meatballs (5 per adult) with 1/2 cup marinara over medium heat 5-7 min until steaming through. Or microwave covered 60-90 sec per plate.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate Adults
recipeInstructions.text: Halve the baked Yough! pizza. Each adult plate gets 1/2 pizza + 5 meatballs + 1/4 cup marinara.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate Kids
recipeInstructions.text: One Costco single-serve pizza per kid. Add 2-3 meatballs with a spoon of marinara — portion by appetite. Extra marinara on the side for dipping.

recipe.keywords: pizza, meatballs, leftover-play, family-dinner, under-30, beef, high-protein

recipe.name: Pork Mince Lettuce Wraps
recipe.description: 32 oz of 95% lean ground pork browned with ginger garlic paste + green onion, then split: adult side gets fresh red chilies + fish sauce + lemon + sesame chili oil; kid side stays mild and gets a creamy sauce (olive oil + Herdez Avocado Cilantro + bone broth) stirred directly into the mince. Adults wrap in Tanimura & Antle Sweet Gem lettuce with Lift Drizzle on the side. Kids spoon into lettuce OR onto a slider roll — kid-format choice protects against the lettuce-rejection day.
recipeIngredient: 32 oz NY Style Sausage Co. 95% Lean Ground Pork (2 packs)
Chosen Foods Avocado Oil Spray (4 seconds = ~1 tbsp)
2 tbsp Verka Organic Ginger Garlic Paste
2 tsp Dynasty Sesame Chili Oil (Goma Rayu)
2 fresh red Thai chilies, finely chopped
Lift Drizzle: 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tbsp Kikkoman soy + 1 tbsp Red Boat fish sauce + 3 tbsp ReaLemon + 1/2 tsp Deep Coriander Powder + 2 chopped fresh red chilies (full recipe → )
Tanimura & Antle Artisan Sweet Gem Lettuce — separated into wrap-sized leaves
1 tbsp Herdez Taqueria Avocado Cilantro Sauce (mild creamy)
1 tbsp chicken bone broth (any brand — Kirkland or Bare Bones)
Tanimura & Antle Sweet Gem lettuce leaves OR dinner slider rolls

recipeInstructions.name: Heat Pan + Spray
recipeInstructions.text: Stainless steel pan over medium-high heat. Spray with Chosen Avocado Oil for 4 seconds.

recipeInstructions.name: Aromatics First
recipeInstructions.text: Add 2 tbsp Verka ginger garlic paste + 1 cup chopped green onion. Sauté 60-90 sec until fragrant. Don't brown — soften.

recipeInstructions.name: Add Pork + Brown
recipeInstructions.text: Add 32 oz ground pork. Spread in single layer. Don't stir for 90 sec — let crust form. Then break with spatula, brown the rest. 6-8 min total.

recipeInstructions.name: Shared Seasoning
recipeInstructions.text: Add 2 tbsp Red Boat fish sauce + 2 tsp Dynasty sesame chili oil + 3 tbsp ReaLemon + 4 pinches Dan-O's SPG. Stir to coat. Cook 60 sec.

recipeInstructions.name: Split Moment
recipeInstructions.text: Spoon ~1/4 of the pan (~250g cooked) into a deli container. THIS IS THE KID PORTION — set aside. After this, the rest of the pan gets chilies.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Finish
recipeInstructions.text: After the split, add 2 chopped fresh red Thai chilies to the remaining pork. Stir + cook 30 sec.

recipeInstructions.name: Build Lift Drizzle
recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, whisk 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tbsp Kikkoman soy + 1 tbsp Red Boat fish sauce + 3 tbsp ReaLemon + 1/2 tsp Deep Coriander Powder + 2 chopped chilies. Stir until coriander dissolves.

recipeInstructions.name: Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Plate adult mince in a bowl. Lift Drizzle in a separate small bowl with a spoon. Tanimura & Antle Sweet Gem leaves on a paper-towel-lined platter. Build at the table — leaf, spoon of mince, spoon of drizzle.

recipe.keywords: lettuce-wraps, pork, se-asian, fish-sauce, low-carb, split-cook, weeknight, one-pan

recipe.name: High-Protein Smash Burgers + Fries
recipe.description: 490 cal / 51g protein per adult plate, 4 servings (2 adults + 2 kids). Adults get a Bettergoods Keto bun with 2 x 3 oz 93/7 smashed patties, 2 Velveeta slices, an In-N-Out-style spread (mustard + mayo + ketchup + pickle juice + harissa + chopped pickles), and 1 full serving Rally's Famous Fries with extra sauce for dipping. Kids get a Marketside Brioche Slider Roll with 1 x 3 oz 80/20 smashed patty, 1 Velveeta slice, a bottled secret sauce, and a 1/2 serving of Rally's fries with ketchup. Same griddle timing, same salt-before-smash technique — the split is at the plate, not at the cook.
recipeIngredient: 6 Velveeta Original slices (4 for adult doubles, 2 for kid singles)
3 servings Rally's Famous Fries (2 for adults, 1 split across 2 kids)
Cooking spray or beef tallow for bun toast
12 oz 93/7 ground beef (4 x 3 oz patties, 2 patties per adult plate)
In-N-Out-style spread (~4 tbsp total, 2 tbsp per adult plate)
· 1 tbsp light mayo (Chosen Foods or Kraft Light)
· 1 tsp harissa (Shuug, NY Shuk, or any) — the twist
6 oz 80/20 ground beef (2 x 3 oz patties, 1 patty per kid plate)
Bottled secret/special sauce (Heinz, TJ's, or similar) — for the burger

recipeInstructions.name: Sauce First
recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl mix 1 tbsp mustard + 1 tbsp light mayo + 1 tbsp ketchup + 1 tbsp pickle juice + 1 tsp harissa + chopped pickles to taste. Set aside. Makes ~4 tbsp = 2 tbsp per adult plate (1 tbsp on burger, 1 tbsp for fry dip).

recipeInstructions.name: Fries
recipeInstructions.text: Rally's Famous Fries into the air fryer at 400°F for 15 min. Start these BEFORE the burgers — they finish within 2 min of the burgers.

recipeInstructions.name: Portion
recipeInstructions.text: 12 oz 93/7 beef into 4 x 3 oz balls for adults. 6 oz 80/20 beef into 2 x 3 oz balls for kids. Loose balls — don't compress.

recipeInstructions.name: Griddle Hot
recipeInstructions.text: Cast iron or flat-top on medium-high 4-5 min. Test: water droplet skitters + evaporates in 2 sec.

recipeInstructions.name: Salt + Smash
recipeInstructions.text: Beef balls onto the hot griddle — adult 93/7 on one side, kid 80/20 on the other. Pinch of salt on each within 5 seconds. Smash flat with a spatula + parchment to ~1/4-inch thick. Lacy edges = flavor.

recipeInstructions.name: Mustard Flip
recipeInstructions.text: 2-3 min undisturbed for the crust. Small blob of mustard on the raw top of each patty. Flip. 90 sec on the second side.

recipeInstructions.name: Cheese
recipeInstructions.text: Velveeta slice on each patty immediately after the flip. Cover with a metal bowl or the pan lid for 30 sec to trap steam + melt fast.

recipeInstructions.name: Toast Buns
recipeInstructions.text: Keto buns + brioche sliders cut-side down on the griddle in the beef fat, 30-45 sec until golden.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Build
recipeInstructions.text: Toasted keto bun bottom + 1 tbsp spread + 2 stacked 93/7 patties (each with Velveeta) + optional pickle chips + toasted keto bun top. Plate with 1 serving Rally's fries + 1 tbsp extra spread on the side for fry dipping.

recipeInstructions.name: Eat Immediately
recipeInstructions.text: Smash burgers lose their crust fast when they sit. Bite through the sauce → cheese → double patty → keto bun in one motion.

recipe.keywords: beef, smash-burger, burger-night, split-cook, weeknight, high-protein, griddle, in-n-out-style, kid-approved, medium-carb

recipe.name: Spicy Beef & Broccoli Rice Bowls
recipe.description: ~45g protein for ~500 calories. Bone broth rice + seared beef strips + charred broccoli in a soy-sesame glaze. Adults get chili oil and sriracha. Kids get mini meatballs or grass-fed beef sausage in a mild soy coat. 25 minutes, meal preps through the week.
recipeIngredient: 2 cups Roli Roti Butcher's Bone Broth
2 tbsp soy sauce (or tamari + splash dark soy)
1.25 lb beef (tri-tip / flank / sirloin), sliced thin

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Rice
recipeInstructions.text: Cook 1:2 ratio with bone broth instead of water. Fluff and set aside. This is your flavor foundation — don't skip.

recipeInstructions.name: Prep Beef
recipeInstructions.text: Slice thin against the grain. Toss with 1 tsp soy sauce + 1 tsp cornstarch for velveting. If you mess this up → chewy, game over.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Broccoli
recipeInstructions.text: High heat stir-fry or air fry. Goal: slightly charred edges, bright green, not mushy. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Sear Beef
recipeInstructions.text: Screaming hot pan. Don't overcrowd — do batches. Quick sear 1-2 min per batch.

recipeInstructions.name: Build Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Add soy sauce + beef broth + sesame oil + garlic + ginger to pan. Add chili oil or sriracha for heat. Simmer briefly.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine
recipeInstructions.text: Return broccoli, toss quickly. Keep it glossy, not soupy. Serve over bone broth rice. Top with sesame seeds and green onion.

recipe.keywords: meal-prep, stir-fry, rice-bowl, split-cook, high-volume

recipe.name: Spicy Chicken Sandwich
recipe.description: ~50g protein for ~540 cal (2 sandwiches). Kirkland chicken fillets air fried crispy, Bettergoods keto buns for adults, slider buns for kids. Add Liquid Chipotle or Money Mustard. 15 minutes.
recipeIngredient: 4 Kirkland Signature Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Fillets
4 Bettergoods Keto Friendly Hamburger Buns (50 cal each)
Liquid Chipotle Sauce OR Money Mustard (~1/2 serving per sandwich)

recipeInstructions.name: Cook
recipeInstructions.text: Air fry chicken fillets at 400°F for 10-12 min until crispy and heated through.

recipeInstructions.name: Toast Buns
recipeInstructions.text: Lightly toast all buns in a pan, 30 seconds butter side down.

recipeInstructions.name: Build
recipeInstructions.text: Sauce on bottom bun. Chicken fillet. Pickles + lettuce if using. Top bun. Serve 2 per plate.

recipe.keywords: chicken, sandwich, fast-food, air-fryer, split-cook, keto-option, fast

recipe.name: Spicy Fajita Chicken Gnocchi
recipe.description: ~35g protein for ~425 calories. Pan-fried gnocchi with golden crispy edges, a spicy cottage cheese cream sauce, and pre-cooked shredded chicken. Adults get chili oil and Dan-O's. Kids get Rao's Alfredo or a dry plate. 30 minutes, one workflow.

recipeInstructions.name: Crisp The Gnocchi
recipeInstructions.text: Medium-high heat, 2 tsp oil. Add gnocchi in a single layer. Cook 8-10 min, flipping occasionally. Goal: crispy outside, not soft. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Veg
recipeInstructions.text: Same pan, high heat. Add peppers + onions. Cook 4-5 min until lightly charred. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Crisp Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Add shredded chicken to pan. Let it sit — develop slight browning. Don't stir constantly.

recipeInstructions.name: Build Flavor Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Blend cottage cheese + milk until smooth. Add to adult pan. Mix in Dan-O's, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, chili oil. Simmer 2-3 min. Should look like a light creamy sauce, not thick paste.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine
recipeInstructions.text: Add gnocchi + veggies to adult pan. Toss lightly — should coat, not drown.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Lime squeeze + optional green onions. This completes the dish — don't skip.

recipe.keywords: crispy, creamy, chicken, gnocchi, signature, flagship, split-cook

recipe.name: Split Plate Spicy Protein Ramen Night
recipe.description: Adult plate: Heal Spot spicy protein ramen cooked in 1 cup chicken bone broth (broth absorbed into the noodles), tossed with both included spicy sauce packets until glossy, finished with a 6-min air-fried Bilinski's Cajun chicken sausage. Kid plate (creator's build): Maruchan chicken ramen with water + seasoning per package directions and a regular hot dog. Two spice levels, two protein tiers, one 15-minute cook. ~430 cal / 54g protein per adult (estimated). Kid macros intentionally not published.
recipeIngredient: 2 packages Heal Spot spicy protein ramen (both included sauce packets)
2 cups chicken bone broth (1 cup per package)
2 Bilinski's Cajun chicken sausages (1 per adult)
2 packages Maruchan chicken ramen (1 per child as served)
Water + seasoning packet per package directions
2 regular hot dogs (1 per child as served)
1 Heal Spot spicy protein ramen package (both packets included with the package)
1 Maruchan chicken ramen package (1 per child as served; adjust to appetite)
1 regular hot dog (air-fried 6 min alongside the Cajun sausage)

recipeInstructions.name: Air-fry 6 Min
recipeInstructions.text: Cajun chicken sausages and regular hot dogs together in the air fryer for 6 min per package guidance. Keep the two types separate — sausage is adult-only.

recipeInstructions.name: Bone Broth
recipeInstructions.text: Bring 2 cups chicken bone broth to a boil in a wide pan (1 cup per ramen package).

recipeInstructions.name: Noodles in
recipeInstructions.text: Add both Heal Spot noodle bricks. Turn and separate as they soften. Cook and toss until the broth is absorbed. Do not drain.

recipeInstructions.name: Included Sauce Only
recipeInstructions.text: Add both included spicy sauce packets. Toss until every noodle is evenly glossy. No soy sauce, no chili oil, no chili crisp.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate + Sausage
recipeInstructions.text: Serve each adult with one portion of spicy protein ramen and one 6-min Bilinski's Cajun chicken sausage on top or on the side.

recipe.keywords: ramen, spicy-protein-ramen, heal-spot, split-cook, fast, high-protein, noodles, 15-minute, family-dinner, kid-friendly

recipe.name: Tandoori Chicken Drumsticks
recipe.description: 60g protein for 525 cal on the adult plate. Skinless drumsticks marinated overnight in fat-free Greek yogurt + lemon + tandoori masala — full strength for adults, about one-sixth the masala for kids. Bake at 425°F, then broil until charred and 165°F. Adults get 3 drumsticks with cucumber and spicy Kashmiri-chili-and-lemon onions. Kids get 1 mild drumstick, cucumber, and about 200 calories of rice, naan, or bhatura.
recipeIngredient: 2/3 packet Shan or Everest Tandoori Masala
About 1/6 packet tandoori masala (stirred into the reserved yogurt-lemon base)
~200 cal of a familiar Indian carb — rice, naan, or bhatura

recipeInstructions.name: Prep
recipeInstructions.text: Pull the skin off, pat the drumsticks dry, cut 2-3 deep slits per piece — to the bone. Split into an adult pile (5-6) and a kid pile (3-4).

recipeInstructions.name: Base
recipeInstructions.text: Mix the fat-free Greek yogurt with the lemon juice. Pull out about a third for the kid bowl BEFORE any masala goes in.

recipeInstructions.name: Marinate Adult
recipeInstructions.text: Load 2/3 packet of tandoori masala into the remaining yogurt base. Massage deep into the slits until every piece is thickly coated.

recipeInstructions.name: Marinate Kid
recipeInstructions.text: Stir about one-sixth of the packet into the reserved base. Same flavor, quiet enough for a 5-year-old. Massage in.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest
recipeInstructions.text: Both bowls covered, overnight in the fridge. Minimum 6 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook
recipeInstructions.text: Space the drumsticks on a wire rack over a sheet pan — no touching. Bake 425°F 15-20 min, then broil 5-7 min per side. OR grill medium-high 10-15 min per side. Pull at 165°F internal with visible char.

recipeInstructions.name: Spicy Onions
recipeInstructions.text: Toss thin-sliced red onion with Kashmiri chili and a hard squeeze of lemon. Let it sit while the chicken rests — it slumps and turns bright red.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: 3 drumsticks per adult on a white plate. Tip the spicy onions on alongside, add sliced cucumber sprinkled with kala namak. 525 cal / 60g protein.

recipe.keywords: chicken, drumsticks, tandoori, indian, grill, oven, split-cook, meal-prep, high-protein, low-carb

recipe.name: Split Plate TKS Sweet Heat Chicken Bowl
recipe.description: Modular dinner that stacks three cookbook bases: Bone Broth Rice (made ahead Sunday, used cold for adult fried rice + warm for kid plain rice), Spicy Umami Fried Rice (adult side), and TKS Sauce (adult chicken glaze). 1 lb Crazy Cuizine chicken in the air fryer → split at the toss step: adult portion (5 oz each) goes into a hot dry pan with TKS Sauce for the cling; kid portion (3 oz each) gets pulled before saucing, plated plain. 20 minutes active time when rice is pre-made.
recipeIngredient: 1 lb Crazy Cuizine Mandarin Orange Chicken (frozen, air-fryer ready)
*** Throw away the included orange-sauce packet — that's the whole reason this recipe exists ***
Bone Broth Rice (need 2.5 servings of the 8-serving batch — adult fried rice uses 2, kid plain uses 0.5)
1/2 batch TKS Sauce (made while chicken cooks)
1 serving Spicy Umami Fried Rice (per adult) — made from cold bone broth rice
Half serving Bone Broth Rice (microwave 60 sec with a splash of water)
4-6 raw mini sweet peppers (Costco multicolor bag — red, orange, yellow)
Tiny ramekin of TKS Sauce on the side (most kids skip — sauce-as-dip pattern: it's there if they want to try it)

recipeInstructions.name: Air Fry Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: 1 lb Crazy Cuizine, 400°F, 9-12 min from frozen, single layer, shake basket at 6 min. Pull when crispy + golden + edges crackle.

recipeInstructions.name: Make The Tks Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: While chicken air-fries (you have ~10 min). Whisk ginger-garlic paste + sesame chili oil + rice vinegar + soy + Bare Bones packet + hot honey sriracha. Full method in TKS Sauce (Cookbook).

recipeInstructions.name: Make The Fried Rice
recipeInstructions.text: While chicken cooks, fry the cold bone broth rice with egg + sauce per the Spicy Umami Fried Rice method. Use 2 servings of cold bone broth rice for 2 adults. Full method in Spicy Umami Fried Rice (Cookbook).

recipeInstructions.name: Pull Kid Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: 6 oz (about half the cooked batch) onto the kid tray. No sauce yet. This is the split point.

recipeInstructions.name: Hot Dry Skillet
recipeInstructions.text: Medium-high heat, dry pan (no oil), screaming hot. Add the adult chicken (10 oz total, 5 oz per person).

recipeInstructions.name: Glaze
recipeInstructions.text: Pour half a batch of TKS Sauce AROUND THE EDGE of the pan — the hiss is the cue. Toss aggressively 60-90 sec until every piece is glossy. Off heat when standing liquid is gone.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate
recipeInstructions.text: Adult bowl — pile of Spicy Umami Fried Rice on one side, glossy TKS-glazed chicken on the other. Scatter scallions + sesame seeds across both. Real takeout dinner.

recipe.keywords: chicken, crazy-cuizine, fried-rice, tks-sauce, air-fryer, split-cook, modular, weeknight, freezer-to-plate

recipe.name: Viral Dumpling Lasagna, Proteinized
recipe.description: A leaner, higher-protein take on @april_eatz's viral dumpling lasagna (discovered via @smallersam). 51 wonton wrappers layered 15 / 9 / 12 / 15 with a 50/50 mix of 93/7 lean ground chicken and 95/5 lean ground pork, soy sauce, rice vinegar, umami seasoning, ginger-garlic paste, and scallions. Bake covered at 400 F for 30 min after pouring 1 cup chicken broth over the top. Rest 5-10 min, cut into 6 servings, drizzle soy and finish with scallions. Chili-garlic sauce ONLY on the adult section. Full serving = one-sixth of the pan at approximately 450 cal / 40g protein. Household batch: 2 adults + 2 kids for 2 dinners; kids get half servings adjusted for appetite in Tushar's build (kid macros intentionally not published). USDA storage: refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours; use within 4 days. Reheat covered with a splash of broth until center reads 165 F.
recipeIngredient: 1 bunch scallions, thinly sliced (half in filling, half reserved for garnish)
2 tbsp soy sauce (plus more for post-bake drizzle)
1 cup chicken broth (poured over the assembled top before covering)
Soy sauce, to taste (light drizzle over the whole pan post-bake)
Reserved scallions (garnish over the whole pan)
Chili-garlic sauce, to taste (adult section only; the split lives here)
No chili-garlic sauce — kid section stays mild.
1/2 full serving per kid tray, based on appetite.

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat + Prep
recipeInstructions.text: Heat oven to 400 F. Lightly spray the inside of a 4-quart 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray.

recipeInstructions.name: Mix The Filling
recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine ground chicken, ground pork, half the sliced scallions, 2 tbsp soy sauce, rice vinegar, umami seasoning, and ginger-garlic paste. Mix evenly without aggressively compacting the meat.

recipeInstructions.name: Layer 1 (bottom, 15 Wrappers)
recipeInstructions.text: Line the bottom of the dish with 15 dry wonton wrappers. DO NOT pre-wet. Spread 1/3 of the filling in a thin, edge-to-edge layer.

recipeInstructions.name: Layers 2 + 3
recipeInstructions.text: Add 9 more wrappers, then another 1/3 of the filling. Add 12 more wrappers, then the last 1/3 of the filling. Total so far = 36 wrappers.

recipeInstructions.name: Top Layer
recipeInstructions.text: Cover with the final 15 wrappers. Total = 51 wrappers across four layers (15 / 9 / 12 / 15).

recipeInstructions.name: Pour The Broth + Cover
recipeInstructions.text: Pour 1 cup chicken broth evenly over the top wrappers. Cover the dish tightly with foil — press the edges to seal.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake
recipeInstructions.text: 400 F for 30 min covered. Verify center reads 165 F (filling contains ground chicken). Rest 5-10 min before cutting.

recipeInstructions.name: Cut + Shared Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Score the pan into 6 equal full servings. Lightly drizzle soy sauce over the whole pan; scatter the reserved scallions across all six squares.

recipeInstructions.name: Adult Drizzle
recipeInstructions.text: Draw chili-garlic sauce ONLY across the adult section of the cut pan. Keep the kid section clean.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate Adult
recipeInstructions.text: Lift 1 full serving per adult plate. Extra chili-garlic on the side if desired.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate The Kid Trays
recipeInstructions.text: Lift a half serving from the kid section onto each tray. Tushar's build: 1/2 full serving per child based on appetite. Do not add chili-garlic sauce.

recipe.keywords: chicken, pork, wonton, dumpling, lasagna, viral, proteinized, layered-bake, family-dinner, split-plate, one-pan

recipe.name: Viral Proteinized Burger in a Bun
recipe.description: Inspired by @bymesika's viral burger-stuffed-bun format. The adult version uses two fully cooked 4 oz 93/7 beef patties, a weighed 250-calorie portion of Pillsbury crescent dough, Velveeta shreds stirred with a spoon of protein queso, optional chilies, and balsamic onion. The kid version uses one fully cooked 3 oz 80/20 patty and 1.5 Velveeta cheese slices inside enough dough to enclose it. Seal and bake at 375°F for about 20 minutes, until the dough is cooked and the filling hot. Adult burger: about 700 calories and 62g protein before onions; with one serving of sweet-potato fries: about 820 calories and 63g protein before onions or ketchup. The kid dough amount was not weighed, so no kid macro figure is shown.
recipeIngredient: Fully cooked ground-beef patties: four 4 oz raw-weight 93/7 patties for two adult burgers and two 3 oz raw-weight 80/20 patties for two kid burgers
Pillsbury Original Crescent Dough Sheet: two weighed 250-calorie portions for the adult burgers; enough to enclose two kid patties (kid dough not weighed)
1 yellow onion + 1 tsp avocado oil + 1 tsp balsamic vinegar + 1 tsp monk-fruit sweetener + salt, cooked down; add to taste
3 oz Velveeta Original Shreds (1.5 oz per adult burger)
2 tbsp homemade high-protein chipotle-style queso (1 tbsp per adult burger)
2 label servings (2.8 oz each) Jesse & Ben's Sweet Potato Tallow Fries, optional
3 Velveeta Original cheese slices for two kid burgers (1.5 slices each: 3/4 under and 3/4 above each patty)
Onion optional; Tushar's kids had none

recipeInstructions.name: Cook The Patties First
recipeInstructions.text: Shape two 4 oz 93/7 adult patties and one 3 oz 80/20 kid patty per kid burger, using raw weights. Fully cook and verify ground-beef doneness with a food thermometer before wrapping.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook The Optional Onion
recipeInstructions.text: Soften one sliced yellow onion in 1 tsp avocado oil; add 1 tsp balsamic, 1 tsp monk-fruit sweetener and salt. Cook until browned. Use as much as you like; onion is outside the stated macros.

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat And Portion Dough
recipeInstructions.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Weigh a 250-calorie portion of crescent dough for the adult burger and portion enough additional dough to enclose each kid patty. The kid portions were not weighed in the filmed cook.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Adult Burger
recipeInstructions.text: Stir the 1.5 oz Velveeta shreds with 1 tbsp protein queso. Layer some cheese mixture, the two fully cooked patties, optional chilies and onion, and the remaining cheese mixture inside the weighed dough.

recipeInstructions.name: Seal And Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Close all dough seams. Bake at 375°F for about 20 minutes, until the dough is fully baked and the filling hot. If serving fries, spread one 2.8 oz serving on parchment and bake per its package while the bun bakes. Cut open and serve.

recipeInstructions.name: Build The Kid Burger
recipeInstructions.text: Lay 3/4 cheese slice on the kid dough, add one fully cooked 3 oz 80/20 patty, then top with the other 3/4 slice. Skip onion for Tushar's filmed version.

recipeInstructions.name: Seal And Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Enclose the kid filling completely and bake alongside the adult burger at 375°F for about 20 minutes, until the dough is fully baked and the filling hot. Portion by appetite.

recipe.keywords: burger, beef, crescent-dough, high-protein, family-dinner, split-cook, viral

recipe.name: Viral Tomato Feta Chicken Pasta, Split Plate Style
recipe.description: The lockdown-era viral tomato-feta pasta adapted into a split-plate meal prep. One casserole roasts 600 g cherry and pear tomatoes with two 8 oz blocks of feta and Mediterranean seasoning at 400°F for 45 min. Air-fry 2 lb chicken thighs in parallel for 20 min. Mash the baked feta and tomatoes into a creamy sauce with visible tomato pieces, chop the chicken, and split 2:1 — ~2/3 of the sauce and chicken to a low-carb penne pot for the adults (2 oz dry per adult container), ~1/3 to a regular penne pot for the smaller portions (1.5 oz dry per container). Pack 6 adult containers plus 6 smaller containers = 3 family dinners for 2 adults + 2 kids. Adult macro headline is ~450 cal / 37g protein; smaller-portion macros intentionally not published — the creator serves 1/2 unit per kid and adjusts to appetite. Refrigerate up to 5 days.
recipeIngredient: 16 oz feta cheese (two 8 oz blocks — BLOCK feta only)
Mediterranean or Greek seasoning, to taste
Salt, to taste (season with awareness — feta + blends are already salty)
2 lb chicken thighs (pre-seasoned Mediterranean shortcut shown; plain thighs + Greek blend if not)
12 oz dry low-carb penne (Carbe Diem or Barilla Protein+) — 2 oz per adult container
9 oz dry regular penne (Barilla or similar) — 1.5 oz per smaller container

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 400°F.

recipeInstructions.name: Roast Tomatoes + Feta
recipeInstructions.text: Place 600 g whole tomatoes in a large casserole dish. Add 4 tbsp olive oil + Mediterranean seasoning + salt (light — feta will add more). Toss. Nestle both feta blocks among the tomatoes; drizzle the remaining oil over the feta and finish with a bit more seasoning if needed. Bake 45 min until the tomatoes have burst and the feta is soft and lightly browned.

recipeInstructions.name: Air-fry Chicken
recipeInstructions.text: While the casserole bakes, air-fry the chicken thighs for ~20 min. Air-fryer performance varies — verify a safe internal temperature on the thickest pieces before pulling. Rest briefly, then chop into bite-size pieces.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook Pastas Separately
recipeInstructions.text: 12 oz low-carb penne and 9 oz regular penne in two separate salted-water pots per each package's directions. Drain both, keep separate.

recipeInstructions.name: Mash The Sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Stir the baked feta and tomatoes right in the casserole until creamy with visible tomato pieces. Do not blend smooth — the texture is the point.

recipeInstructions.name: Split 2
recipeInstructions.text: 1: Move ~1/3 of the mashed sauce and ~1/3 of the chopped chicken into a separate mixing bowl. Leave ~2/3 in the casserole dish.

recipeInstructions.name: Fold
recipeInstructions.text: The low-carb penne into the main casserole with the remaining 2/3 sauce and 2/3 chopped chicken. Fold until evenly coated. Portion into 6 adult containers, 2 oz dry pasta equivalent per container.

recipe.keywords: chicken, pasta, feta, tomato, viral, meal-prep, split-plate, family-dinner, mediterranean, kid-approved, weeknight, batch-cook

recipe.name: Weeknight Picanha with Chimichurri & Frozen Greens
recipe.description: Approximately 480 cal / 40g protein per adult plate. 2 adult plates + 2 deconstructed kid plates. Adults get 6 oz salt-seared picanha, one label serving of Whole Foods Market European Greens with basil-and-garlic sauce, and one label serving of prepared chimichurri spooned over the steak. Kids get two Amylu chicken breakfast patties, half a serving of the same greens, and a toasted slider bun served separately so they can assemble a sandwich or eat the components independently. Two skillets, one cook, done in 25 minutes. Creator pull temp is 135°F for medium; USDA-recommended pull is 145°F + 3 min rest — both preserved on the page. Costco Fotis Fine Foods Chimichurri is the shortcut; the No-Judge Chimichurri cookbook entry is the homemade alternative.
recipeIngredient: 3 label servings Whole Foods Market European Greens with Basil & Garlic Sauce (1 per adult + 1/2 per kid)
12 oz picanha steaks total (6 oz per adult)
2 label servings prepared chimichurri (1 per adult — Fotis Fine Foods from Costco or the No-Judge Chimichurri cookbook version)
4 fully-cooked chicken breakfast patties (Amylu — 2 per kid)
2 slider buns (1 per kid, split + toasted)

recipeInstructions.name: Salt The Picanha
recipeInstructions.text: Season both sides of 12 oz picanha with salt. No other seasoning — the chimichurri carries the flavor.

recipeInstructions.name: Start The Greens
recipeInstructions.text: Add 3 label servings frozen European greens to a medium skillet. Cook per the package — usually 6-8 min at medium heat, stirring occasionally.

recipeInstructions.name: Sear The Picanha
recipeInstructions.text: Heat a second skillet on medium-high, coat lightly with avocado spray, add the picanha. Press briefly for full pan contact if needed. Sear + flip until browned and cooked to preferred doneness.

recipeInstructions.name: Doneness + Safety
recipeInstructions.text: Creator pulls at 135°F for medium (video honestly notes this cook landed closer to medium-well). USDA recommends whole beef steaks cook to 145°F + rest 3 min before slicing. Both are valid — present them as separate choices.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest + Slice
recipeInstructions.text: Transfer picanha to a board and rest 5+ min. Then slice thin against the grain.

recipeInstructions.name: Plate The Adult
recipeInstructions.text: 6 oz sliced picanha + 1 serving basil-garlic frozen greens.

recipeInstructions.name: Spoon The Chimichurri
recipeInstructions.text: 1 serving of prepared chimichurri over the sliced steak. Stir the jar thoroughly first — the oil separates during storage.

recipe.keywords: picanha, steak, beef, chimichurri, frozen-vegetables, costco-shortcut, split-cook, family-dinner, weeknight, under-30
